scripts.source:
//@version=6
indicator("200 MA Pack (SMA / EMA / SMMA / WMA) + VWAP", overlay=true)

// Length
length = 200

// Moving Averages
sma_200  = ta.sma(close, length)
ema_200  = ta.ema(close, length)
smma_200 = ta.rma(close, length)   // SMMA = RMA
wma_200  = ta.wma(close, length)

// VWAP
vwap_val = ta.vwap(hlc3)

// Plotting with custom colors
plot(wma_200,  title="WMA 200",  color=#388e3c, linewidth=2)
plot(smma_200, title="SMMA 200", color=#673AB7, linewidth=2)
plot(ema_200,  title="EMA 200",  color=color.white, linewidth=2)
plot(sma_200,  title="SMA 200",  color=#2962ff, linewidth=2)
plot(vwap_val, title="VWAP",     color=#ffeb3b, linewidth=2)

scripts.source:
// © informanerd
//@version=4

study("Auto Fibonacci and Gann Fan/Retracements Combo", "Auto Fibo & Gann Fan/Rets.", true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)

// inputs & definitions {

showExtrema = input(true, "Mark Extremum Points on the Chart                                                          ")

fiboGroup = "===============[ Fibonacci ]==============="
ffCount = input(1, "Show", minval = 0, inline = "FiboFan", group = fiboGroup)
ffStyle = input("Solid", "Fans", options = ["Dashed", "Dotted", "Solid"], inline = "FiboFan", group = fiboGroup)
showFFLabels = input(true, "Show Labels", inline = "FiboFan", group = fiboGroup)
frCount = input(1, "Show", minval = 0, inline = "FiboRet", group = fiboGroup)
frStyle = input("Dashed", "Retracements", options = ["Dashed", "Dotted", "Solid"], inline = "FiboRet", group = fiboGroup)
showFRLabels = input(true, "Show Labels", inline = "FiboRet", group = fiboGroup)
extendFR = input(true, "Extend the Most Recent Retracement Lines", group = fiboGroup)

gannGroup = "===============[ Gann ]==============="
gfCount = input(1, "Show", minval = 0, inline = "GannFan", group = gannGroup)
gfStyle = input("Solid", "Fans", options = ["Dashed", "Dotted", "Solid"], inline = "GannFan", group = gannGroup)
showGFLabels = input(true, "Show Labels", inline = "GannFan", group = gannGroup)
grCount = input(0, "Show", minval = 0, inline = "GannRet", group = gannGroup)
grStyle = input("Dotted", "Retracements", options = ["Dashed", "Dotted", "Solid"], inline = "GannRet", group = gannGroup)
showGRLabels = input(true, "Show Labels", inline = "GannRet", group = gannGroup)
extendGR = input(true, "Extend the Most Recent Retracement Lines", group = gannGroup)

colorsGroup = "===============[ Line Colors ]==============="
var fiboFanBearColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.red, 60), "FiboFan ↘   23.6:", inline = "FiboFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 40), "38.2:", inline = "FiboFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 0), "50.0:", inline = "FiboFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 40), "61.8:", inline = "FiboFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 60), "78.6:", inline = "FiboFan1", group = colorsGroup))
var fiboFanBullColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.green, 60), "FiboFan ↗   23.6:", inline = "FiboFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 40), "38.2:", inline = "FiboFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 0), "50.0:", inline = "FiboFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 40), "61.8:", inline = "FiboFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 60), "78.6:", inline = "FiboFan2", group = colorsGroup))
var fiboRetBearColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.red, 60), "FiboRet ↘   23.6:", inline = "FiboRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 40), "38.2:", inline = "FiboRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 0), "50.0:", inline = "FiboRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 40), "61.8:", inline = "FiboRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.red, 60), "78.6:", inline = "FiboRet1", group = colorsGroup))
var fiboRetBullColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.green, 60), "FiboRet ↗   23.6:", inline = "FiboRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 40), "38.2:", inline = "FiboRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 0), "50.0:", inline = "FiboRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 40), "61.8:", inline = "FiboRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.green, 60), "78.6:", inline = "FiboRet2", group = colorsGroup))
var gannFanBearColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 60), "GannFan ↘     4/1:", inline = "GannFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 40), "2/1:", inline = "GannFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 0), "1/1:", inline = "GannFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 40), "1/2:", inline = "GannFan1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 60), "1/4:", inline = "GannFan1", group = colorsGroup))
var gannFanBullColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.teal, 60), "GannFan ↗     4/1:", inline = "GannFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 40), "2/1:", inline = "GannFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 0), "1/1:", inline = "GannFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 40), "1/2:", inline = "GannFan2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 60), "1/4:", inline = "GannFan2", group = colorsGroup))
var gannRetBearColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 60), "GannRet ↘   12.5:", inline = "GannRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 40), "25.0:", inline = "GannRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 0), "50.0:", inline = "GannRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 40), "75.0:", inline = "GannRet1", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.maroon, 60), "87.5:", inline = "GannRet1", group = colorsGroup))
var gannRetBullColors = array.from(
     input(color.new(color.teal, 60), "GannRet ↗   12.5:", inline = "GannRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 40), "25.0:", inline = "GannRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 0), "50.0:", inline = "GannRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 40), "75.0:", inline = "GannRet2", group = colorsGroup),
     input(color.new(color.teal, 60), "87.5:", inline = "GannRet2", group = colorsGroup))

fiboRetLineStyle = frStyle == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : frStyle == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid
fiboFanLineStyle = ffStyle == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : ffStyle == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid
gannRetLineStyle = grStyle == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : grStyle == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid
gannFanLineStyle = gfStyle == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : gfStyle == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid

var float highPrice = na
var float highestPrice = na
var float lowPrice = na
var float lowestPrice = na
var highBar = 0
var highestBar = 0
var lowBar = 0
var lowestBar = 0
var waitingFor = ""

var chartScale = 1.
var scales = array.new_float()

fiboRatios = array.from(.236, .382, .5, .618, .786)
fiboRatioLabels = array.from("23.6", "38.2", "50", "61.8", "78.6")
gannFanRatios = array.from(15. / 90, 26.25 / 90, 45. / 90, 63.75 / 90, 75. / 90)
gannFanRatioLabels = array.from("4:1", "2:1", "1:1", "1:2", "1:4")
gannRetRatios = array.from(.125, .25, .5, .75, .875)
gannRetRatioLabels = array.from("12.5", "25", "50", "75", "87.5")

var fiboRet1 = array.new_line()
var fiboRet2 = array.new_line()
var fiboRet3 = array.new_line()
var fiboRet4 = array.new_line()
var fiboRet5 = array.new_line()
var fiboRet6 = array.new_line()
var fiboRet7 = array.new_line()
var gannRet1 = array.new_line()
var gannRet2 = array.new_line()
var gannRet3 = array.new_line()
var gannRet4 = array.new_line()
var gannRet5 = array.new_line()
var gannRet6 = array.new_line()
var gannRet7 = array.new_line()
var fiboFan1 = array.new_line()
var fiboFan2 = array.new_line()
var fiboFan3 = array.new_line()
var fiboFan4 = array.new_line()
var fiboFan5 = array.new_line()
var fiboFan6 = array.new_line()
var fiboFan7 = array.new_line()
var gannFan1 = array.new_line()
var gannFan2 = array.new_line()
var gannFan3 = array.new_line()
var gannFan4 = array.new_line()
var gannFan5 = array.new_line()
var gannFan6 = array.new_line()
var gannFan7 = array.new_line()

var fiboRetLabel1 = array.new_label()
var fiboRetLabel2 = array.new_label()
var fiboRetLabel3 = array.new_label()
var fiboRetLabel4 = array.new_label()
var fiboRetLabel5 = array.new_label()
var fiboFanLabel1 = array.new_label()
var fiboFanLabel2 = array.new_label()
var fiboFanLabel3 = array.new_label()
var fiboFanLabel4 = array.new_label()
var fiboFanLabel5 = array.new_label()
var gannRetLabel1 = array.new_label()
var gannRetLabel2 = array.new_label()
var gannRetLabel3 = array.new_label()
var gannRetLabel4 = array.new_label()
var gannRetLabel5 = array.new_label()
var gannFanLabel1 = array.new_label()
var gannFanLabel2 = array.new_label()
var gannFanLabel3 = array.new_label()
var gannFanLabel4 = array.new_label()
var gannFanLabel5 = array.new_label()

var fiboRetLabels = array.new_label(5, na)
var fiboFanLabels = array.new_label(5, na)
var gannRetLabels = array.new_label(5, na)
var gannFanLabels = array.new_label(5, na)

var fiboFanSlopes = array.new_float(5, na)
var gannFanSlopes = array.new_float(5, na)

//}
// find proper chart scale, highest and lowest pivots and draw line sets {

// functions
calcScale(bar1, price1, bar2, price2) =>
    if array.size(scales) == 100000
        array.shift(scales)
    array.push(scales, abs(price2 - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    array.median(scales)

isHigh() =>
    isHigh = false
    bar = bar_index
    price = high
    if close < open
        for i = 1 to 10
            if close[i] < open[i]
                break
            else
                bar := price < high[i] ? bar_index - i : bar
                price := max(price, high[i])
                if close[i] == open[i]
                    continue
                if close[i] > open[i]
                    isHigh := true
                    break
    [isHigh, bar, price]
isLow() =>
    isLow = false
    bar = bar_index
    price = low
    if close > open
        for i = 1 to 10
            if close[i] > open[i]
                break
            else
                bar := price > low[i] ? bar_index - i : bar
                price := min(price, low[i])
                if close[i] == open[i]
                    continue
                if close[i] < open[i]
                    isLow := true
                    break
    [isLow, bar, price]

showLabel(setType, labelArray, arrayIndex, x, y, text, colour) =>
    if (showFRLabels and setType == "fret") or (showGRLabels and setType == "gret") or (showFFLabels and setType == "ffan") or (showGFLabels and setType == "gfan")
        label.delete(array.get(labelArray, arrayIndex))
        array.set(labelArray, arrayIndex, label.new(x, y, text, color = na, textcolor = colour))

saveLastLabels(setType, labelArray) =>
    if setType == "fret"
        array.push(fiboRetLabel1, array.get(labelArray, 0))
        array.push(fiboRetLabel2, array.get(labelArray, 1))
        array.push(fiboRetLabel3, array.get(labelArray, 2))
        array.push(fiboRetLabel4, array.get(labelArray, 3))
        array.push(fiboRetLabel5, array.get(labelArray, 4))
    else if setType == "gret"
        array.push(gannRetLabel1, array.get(labelArray, 0))
        array.push(gannRetLabel2, array.get(labelArray, 1))
        array.push(gannRetLabel3, array.get(labelArray, 2))
        array.push(gannRetLabel4, array.get(labelArray, 3))
        array.push(gannRetLabel5, array.get(labelArray, 4))
    else if setType == "ffan"
        array.push(fiboFanLabel1, array.get(labelArray, 0))
        array.push(fiboFanLabel2, array.get(labelArray, 1))
        array.push(fiboFanLabel3, array.get(labelArray, 2))
        array.push(fiboFanLabel4, array.get(labelArray, 3))
        array.push(fiboFanLabel5, array.get(labelArray, 4))
    else if setType == "gfan"
        array.push(gannFanLabel1, array.get(labelArray, 0))
        array.push(gannFanLabel2, array.get(labelArray, 1))
        array.push(gannFanLabel3, array.get(labelArray, 2))
        array.push(gannFanLabel4, array.get(labelArray, 3))
        array.push(gannFanLabel5, array.get(labelArray, 4))
    for i = 0 to 4
        array.set(labelArray, i, na)

drawLineSet(setType, ratioArray, ratioLabelArray, labelArray, lineArray1, lineArray2, lineArray3, lineArray4, lineArray5, lineArray6, lineArray7, bar1, price1, bar2, price2, extend, bullColors, bearColors, style) =>
    colors = array.copy(price1 < price2 ? bullColors : bearColors)
    barRange = price1 < price2 ? bar1 - bar2 : bar2 - bar1
    priceRange = price1 - price2
    levelPrice = 0.
    array.push(lineArray1, line.new(bar1, price1, bar2, price1, extend = extend or setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? extend.right : extend.none, color = array.get(colors, 2), style = style))
    levelPrice := price1 - (setType != "gfan" ? priceRange * (1 - array.get(ratioArray, 0)) : barRange * tan(array.get(ratioArray, 0) * math.pi / 2) * chartScale)
    array.push(lineArray2, line.new(bar1, setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? price1 : levelPrice, bar2, levelPrice, extend = extend or setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? extend.right : extend.none, color = array.get(colors, 0), style = style))
    showLabel(setType, labelArray, 0, bar2, levelPrice, array.get(ratioLabelArray, 0), array.get(colors, 0))
    if setType == "ffan"
        array.set(fiboFanSlopes, 0, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    if setType == "gfan"
        array.set(gannFanSlopes, 0, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    levelPrice := price1 - (setType != "gfan" ? priceRange * (1 - array.get(ratioArray, 1)) : barRange * tan(array.get(ratioArray, 1) * math.pi / 2) * chartScale)
    array.push(lineArray3, line.new(bar1, setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? price1 : levelPrice, bar2, levelPrice, extend = extend or setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? extend.right : extend.none, color = array.get(colors, 1), style = style))
    showLabel(setType, labelArray, 1, bar2, levelPrice, array.get(ratioLabelArray, 1), array.get(colors, 1))
    if setType == "ffan"
        array.set(fiboFanSlopes, 1, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    if setType == "gfan"
        array.set(gannFanSlopes, 1, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    levelPrice := price1 - (setType != "gfan" ? priceRange * (1 - array.get(ratioArray, 2)) : barRange * tan(array.get(ratioArray, 2) * math.pi / 2) * chartScale)
    array.push(lineArray4, line.new(bar1, setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? price1 : levelPrice, bar2, levelPrice, extend = extend or setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? extend.right : extend.none, color = array.get(colors, 2), style = style))
    showLabel(setType, labelArray, 2, bar2, levelPrice, array.get(ratioLabelArray, 2), array.get(colors, 2))
    if setType == "ffan"
        array.set(fiboFanSlopes, 2, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    if setType == "gfan"
        array.set(gannFanSlopes, 2, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    levelPrice := price1 - (setType != "gfan" ? priceRange * (1 - array.get(ratioArray, 3)) : barRange * tan(array.get(ratioArray, 3) * math.pi / 2) * chartScale)
    array.push(lineArray5, line.new(bar1, setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? price1 : levelPrice, bar2, levelPrice, extend = extend or setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? extend.right : extend.none, color = array.get(colors, 3), style = style))
    showLabel(setType, labelArray, 3, bar2, levelPrice, array.get(ratioLabelArray, 3), array.get(colors, 3))
    if setType == "ffan"
        array.set(fiboFanSlopes, 3, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    if setType == "gfan"
        array.set(gannFanSlopes, 3, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    levelPrice := price1 - (setType != "gfan" ? priceRange * (1 - array.get(ratioArray, 4)) : barRange * tan(array.get(ratioArray, 4) * math.pi / 2) * chartScale)
    array.push(lineArray6, line.new(bar1, setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? price1 : levelPrice, bar2, levelPrice, extend = extend or setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? extend.right : extend.none, color = array.get(colors, 4), style = style))
    showLabel(setType, labelArray, 4, bar2, levelPrice, array.get(ratioLabelArray, 4), array.get(colors, 4))
    if setType == "ffan"
        array.set(fiboFanSlopes, 4, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    if setType == "gfan"
        array.set(gannFanSlopes, 4, (levelPrice - price1) / (bar2 - bar1))
    array.push(lineArray7, line.new(bar1, setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? price1 : price2, setType == "gfan" ? bar1 : bar2, price2, extend = extend or setType == "ffan" or setType == "gfan" ? extend.right : extend.none, color = array.get(colors, 2), style = style))

cutLastRets() =>
    index = array.size(fiboRet1) - 1
    if index > -1
        line.set_extend(array.get(fiboRet1, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(fiboRet2, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(fiboRet3, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(fiboRet4, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(fiboRet5, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(fiboRet6, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(fiboRet7, index), extend.none)
    index := array.size(gannRet1) - 1
    if index > -1
        line.set_extend(array.get(gannRet1, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(gannRet2, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(gannRet3, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(gannRet4, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(gannRet5, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(gannRet6, index), extend.none)
        line.set_extend(array.get(gannRet7, index), extend.none)

delUnneededLines() =>
    if array.size(fiboRet1) > frCount
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboRet1))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboRet2))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboRet3))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboRet4))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboRet5))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboRet6))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboRet7))
    if array.size(fiboRetLabel1) > frCount - 1 and frCount > 0
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboRetLabel1))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboRetLabel2))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboRetLabel3))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboRetLabel4))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboRetLabel5))
    if array.size(gannRet1) > grCount
        line.delete(array.shift(gannRet1))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannRet2))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannRet3))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannRet4))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannRet5))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannRet6))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannRet7))
    if array.size(gannRetLabel1) > grCount - 1 and grCount > 0
        label.delete(array.shift(gannRetLabel1))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannRetLabel2))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannRetLabel3))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannRetLabel4))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannRetLabel5))
    if array.size(fiboFan1) > ffCount
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboFan1))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboFan2))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboFan3))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboFan4))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboFan5))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboFan6))
        line.delete(array.shift(fiboFan7))
    if array.size(fiboFanLabel1) > ffCount - 1 and ffCount > 0
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboFanLabel1))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboFanLabel2))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboFanLabel3))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboFanLabel4))
        label.delete(array.shift(fiboFanLabel5))
    if array.size(gannFan1) > gfCount
        line.delete(array.shift(gannFan1))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannFan2))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannFan3))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannFan4))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannFan5))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannFan6))
        line.delete(array.shift(gannFan7))
    if array.size(gannFanLabel1) > gfCount - 1 and gfCount > 0
        label.delete(array.shift(gannFanLabel1))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannFanLabel2))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannFanLabel3))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannFanLabel4))
        label.delete(array.shift(gannFanLabel5))

// find highests and lowests and draw retracements and fans
[isH, hBar, hPrice] = isHigh()
if isH
    chartScale := calcScale(highBar, highPrice, hBar, hPrice)
    if waitingFor != "l" and hPrice < highPrice
        highestBar := highBar
        highestPrice := highPrice
        cutLastRets()
        if frCount > 0
            saveLastLabels("fret", fiboRetLabels)
            drawLineSet("fret", fiboRatios, fiboRatioLabels, fiboRetLabels, fiboRet1, fiboRet2, fiboRet3, fiboRet4, fiboRet5, fiboRet6, fiboRet7, lowestBar, lowestPrice, highestBar, highestPrice, extendFR, fiboRetBullColors, fiboRetBearColors, fiboRetLineStyle)
        if ffCount > 0
            saveLastLabels("ffan", fiboFanLabels)
            drawLineSet("ffan", fiboRatios, fiboRatioLabels, fiboFanLabels, fiboFan1, fiboFan2, fiboFan3, fiboFan4, fiboFan5, fiboFan6, fiboFan7, lowestBar, lowestPrice, highestBar, highestPrice, extendFR, fiboFanBullColors, fiboFanBearColors, fiboFanLineStyle)
        if grCount > 0

            drawLineSet("gret", gannRetRatios, gannRetRatioLabels, gannRetLabels, gannRet1, gannRet2, gannRet3, gannRet4, gannRet5, gannRet6, gannRet7, lowestBar, lowestPrice, highestBar, highestPrice, extendGR, gannRetBullColors, gannRetBearColors, gannRetLineStyle)

            drawLineSet("gfan", gannFanRatios, gannFanRatioLabels, gannFanLabels, gannFan1, gannFan2, gannFan3, gannFan4, gannFan5, gannFan6, gannFan7, highestBar, highestPrice, bar_index, low, extendGR, gannFanBullColors, gannFanBearColors, gannFanLineStyle)
        delUnneededLines()
        waitingFor := "l"
        if showExtrema
            label.new(highestBar, highestPrice, "")
    highBar := hBar
    highPrice := hPrice
[isL, lBar, lPrice] = isLow()
if isL
    chartScale := calcScale(lowBar, lowPrice, lBar, lPrice)
    if waitingFor != "h" and lPrice > lowPrice

        cutLastRets()
        if frCount > 0

        if gfCount > 0

        delUnneededLines()
        waitingFor := "h"
        if showExtrema
            label.new(lowestBar, lowestPrice, "", style = label.style_label_up)
    lowBar := lBar
    lowPrice := lPrice

// extend latest retracements
index = array.size(fiboRet1) - 1
if index > -1
    line.set_x2(array.get(fiboRet1, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(fiboRet2, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(fiboRet3, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(fiboRet4, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(fiboRet5, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(fiboRet6, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(fiboRet7, index), bar_index)
index := array.size(gannRet1) - 1
if index > -1
    line.set_x2(array.get(gannRet1, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(gannRet2, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(gannRet3, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(gannRet4, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(gannRet5, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(gannRet6, index), bar_index)
    line.set_x2(array.get(gannRet7, index), bar_index)

// relocate labels
for i = 0 to 4
    if showFRLabels
        label.set_x(array.get(fiboRetLabels, i), bar_index + 2)
    if showGRLabels
        label.set_x(array.get(gannRetLabels, i), bar_index + 2)
    if showFFLabels

        //label.set_y(gannFanLabel, label.get_y(gannFanLabel) + tan(array.get(gannFanRatios, i) * math.pi / 2) * chartScale * (waitingFor == "h" ? 1 : waitingFor == "l" ? -1 : 0))

//}

scripts.name: AVP Crypto Gate Panel (GO/WATCH/NO-TRADE) TEST 1

metadata.scriptName: AVP Crypto Gate Panel (GO/WATCH/NO-TRADE) TEST 1

scripts.source:
//@version=6
indicator("AVP Crypto Gate Panel (GO/WATCH/NO-TRADE)", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500)

//====================================================
// Inputs
//====================================================
profile      = input.string("Balanced", "Profile", options=["Sniper","Balanced","Aggressive"])
tf_bias1     = input.timeframe("240", "Bias TF #1 (4H)")
tf_bias2     = input.timeframe("D",   "Bias TF #2 (Daily)")
useMonthlyVW = input.bool(true, "Use Monthly Anchored VWAP (crypto 24/7)")
useWeeklyVW  = input.bool(true, "Use Weekly Anchored VWAP (crypto 24/7)")
atrLen       = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=5)
rangeLen     = input.int(40, "Range Window (for breakout)", minval=20)

pivotL = input.int(3, "Pivot Left", minval=1, maxval=10)
pivotR = input.int(3, "Pivot Right", minval=1, maxval=10)

showPanel    = input.bool(true, "Show Panel")

//====================================================
// Helpers (NO repaint MTF)
//====================================================
f_sec(_tf, _expr) =>
    request.security(syminfo.tickerid, _tf, _expr, barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

//====================================================
// Anchored VWAPs for 24/7 crypto (weekly/monthly)
//====================================================
f_anchored_vwap(_anchorTf) =>
    // newPeriod precisa ser series bool (comparação)
    newPeriod = ta.change(time(_anchorTf)) != 0

    var float cumPV = na
    var float cumV  = na
    var bool  init  = false

    if (not init) or newPeriod
        cumPV := hlc3 * volume
        cumV  := volume
        init  := true
    else
        cumPV += hlc3 * volume
        cumV  += volume

    cumPV / math.max(cumV, 1)

//====================================================
// Gate 1: Trend Bias (HTF)
//====================================================
ema200_4h = f_sec(tf_bias1, ta.ema(close, 200))
ema200_d  = f_sec(tf_bias2, ta.ema(close, 200))

wvwap = useWeeklyVW  ? f_anchored_vwap("W") : na
mvwap = useMonthlyVW ? f_anchored_vwap("M") : na

biasLong  = close > ema200_4h and close > ema200_d
biasShort = close < ema200_4h and close < ema200_d

vwapLong  = (not useWeeklyVW or close > wvwap) and (not useMonthlyVW or close > mvwap)
vwapShort = (not useWeeklyVW or close < wvwap) and (not useMonthlyVW or close < mvwap)

//====================================================
// Gate 2: Structure / Regime (A/B/C)
//====================================================
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotL, pivotR)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low,  pivotL, pivotR)

var float lastSwingHigh = na
var float lastSwingLow  = na

if not na(ph)
    lastSwingHigh := ph
if not na(pl)
    lastSwingLow  := pl

bosUp   = not na(lastSwingHigh) and close > lastSwingHigh
bosDown = not na(lastSwingLow)  and close < lastSwingLow

var int st = 0 // 1=up, -1=down, 0=unknown/range
if bosUp
    st := 1
else if bosDown
    st := -1

chochUp   = st == -1 and bosUp
chochDown = st == 1  and bosDown

atr = ta.atr(atrLen)
atrPct = atr / close
ema50 = ta.ema(close, 50)
trendFlat = math.abs(ta.change(ema50, 10)) / close < 0.005

isRange = (atrPct < 0.015) and trendFlat and (not bosUp) and (not bosDown)

modeA = (st == 1 and biasLong) or (st == -1 and biasShort)
modeB = isRange
modeC = chochUp or chochDown

//====================================================
// Gate 3: Trigger (1H breakout / retest / micro-structure)
//====================================================
rangeHigh = ta.highest(high, rangeLen)
rangeLow  = ta.lowest(low,  rangeLen)

breakUp   = close > rangeHigh[1] and close[1] <= rangeHigh[1]
breakDown = close < rangeLow[1]  and close[1] >= rangeLow[1]

retestUp   = low <= rangeHigh and close > rangeHigh
retestDown = high >= rangeLow and close < rangeLow

[stLine, stDir] = ta.supertrend(3.0, 10)
stOkLong  = stDir == 1
stOkShort = stDir == -1

triggerLong =
     profile == "Sniper"   ? (breakUp and retestUp) :
     profile == "Balanced" ? (breakUp or retestUp) :
                             (breakUp or retestUp)

triggerShort =
     profile == "Sniper"   ? (breakDown and retestDown) :
     profile == "Balanced" ? (breakDown or retestDown) :
                             (breakDown or retestDown)

//====================================================
// Gate 4: Momentum (MACD hist slope + RSI 50)
//====================================================
[macdLine, signalLine, hist] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
histSlope = hist - hist[1]

rsi = ta.rsi(close, 14)
momLong  = (hist > 0 and histSlope > 0) and (rsi >= 50)
momShort = (hist < 0 and histSlope < 0) and (rsi <= 50)

//====================================================
// Gate 5: Zones + Space (ATR distance to nearest swing level)
//====================================================
nearestRes = lastSwingHigh
nearestSup = lastSwingLow

distToResATR = not na(nearestRes) ? (nearestRes - close) / atr : na
distToSupATR = not na(nearestSup) ? (close - nearestSup) / atr : na

spaceLong  = not na(distToResATR) ? distToResATR >= 1.2 : true
spaceShort = not na(distToSupATR) ? distToSupATR >= 1.2 : true

//====================================================
// Scoring
//====================================================
int scoreLong  = 0
int scoreShort = 0

scoreLong  += biasLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += biasShort ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += vwapLong  ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += vwapShort ? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += (st == 1)  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += (st == -1) ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += (modeC and chochUp)   ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += (modeC and chochDown) ? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += triggerLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += triggerShort ? 2 : 0

scoreLong  += momLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += momShort ? 2 : 0

scoreLong  += spaceLong  ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += spaceShort ? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += stOkLong  ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += stOkShort ? 1 : 0

goTh    = profile == "Sniper"   ? 8 : profile == "Balanced" ? 7 : 6
watchTh = profile == "Sniper"   ? 7 : profile == "Balanced" ? 6 : 5

//====================================================
// Verdict / State / Quality / Mode (NO multiline ternary)
//====================================================
maxScore = math.max(scoreLong, scoreShort)

string verdict = "NO-TRADE"
if scoreLong >= scoreShort and scoreLong >= goTh
    verdict := "LONG"
else if scoreShort > scoreLong and scoreShort >= goTh
    verdict := "SHORT"

string state = "⛔ NO-TRADE"
if verdict != "NO-TRADE"
    state := "✅ GO"
else if maxScore >= watchTh
    state := "⚠️ WATCH"

string quality = "—"
if maxScore >= (goTh + 2)
    quality := "EXCELENTE"
else if maxScore >= goTh
    quality := "BOM"
else if maxScore >= watchTh
    quality := "REGULAR"

string mode = "A (CONTINUAÇÃO)"
if modeC
    mode := "C (REVERSÃO)"
else if modeB
    mode := "B (BREAKOUT)"

//====================================================
// Panel
//====================================================
var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 6, frame_width=1)

if barstate.islast and showPanel
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "VEREDITO: " + verdict)
    table.cell(t, 0, 1, "ESTADO: " + state)
    table.cell(t, 0, 2, "QUALIDADE: " + quality)
    table.cell(t, 0, 3, "MODO: " + mode)
    table.cell(t, 0, 4, "SCORES L/S: " + str.tostring(scoreLong) + " / " + str.tostring(scoreShort))
    table.cell(t, 0, 5, "ESPACO ATR (Res/Sup): " + str.tostring(distToResATR, "#.##") + " / " + str.tostring(distToSupATR, "#.##"))

// Debug (hidden)
plot(ema200_4h, "EMA200 4H", display=display.none)
plot(ema200_d,  "EMA200 D",  display=display.none)
plot(wvwap, "Weekly aVWAP", display=display.none)
plot(mvwap, "Monthly aVWAP", display=display.none)

//@version=6
indicator("AVP Crypto Gate Panel v3.5 (Stack + BOS Mode + Profile Presets)", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=50)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 1) Profiles & Timeframes
//====================================================
group_profile = "1) Profiles & Timeframes"

profile      = input.string("Balanced", "Profile", options=["Sniper","Balanced","Aggressive"], group=group_profile)

// Timeframes
tf_bias1     = input.timeframe("240", "Bias TF #1 (4H)", group=group_profile)
tf_bias2     = input.timeframe("D",   "Bias TF #2 (Daily)", group=group_profile)
tf_struct    = input.timeframe("240", "Structure TF (MTF swings)", group=group_profile)
autoStructTF  = input.bool(true, "Auto Structure TF (recommended)", group=group_profile)

autoTriggerTF = input.bool(true, "Auto Trigger TF (recommended)", group=group_profile)
tf_trigger   = input.timeframe("60",  "Trigger TF (manual)", group=group_profile)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 2) Core Parameters
//====================================================
group_core = "2) Core Parameters"

atrLen       = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=5, group=group_core)
rangeLen     = input.int(40, "Range Window (Trigger TF)", minval=20, group=group_core)
pivotL       = input.int(3,  "Pivot Left (Structure TF)", minval=1, maxval=10, group=group_core)
pivotR       = input.int(3,  "Pivot Right (Structure TF)", minval=1, maxval=10, group=group_core)

useWeeklyVW  = input.bool(true, "Use Weekly Anchored VWAP", group=group_core)
useMonthlyVW = input.bool(true, "Use Monthly Anchored VWAP", group=group_core)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 3) Gates & Thresholds
//====================================================
group_gates = "3) Gates & Thresholds (reset on Profile change)"

enableManualThresholds = input.bool(false, "Enable manual thresholds (advanced)", group=group_gates, tooltip="If OFF, GO/WATCH thresholds use the Profile presets. If ON, you can set them below. Effective values still reset when Profile changes.")
goTh_in   = input.int(8, "GO threshold", minval=1, maxval=20, group=group_gates)
watchTh_in= input.int(6, "WATCH threshold", minval=1, maxval=20, group=group_gates)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 4) Trigger Engine
//====================================================
group_trigger = "4) Trigger Engine (reset on Profile change)"

retestTolATR_in = input.float(0.2, "Retest tolerance (x ATR on trigger TF)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=group_trigger)
inPlayBars_in   = input.int(6, "IN_PLAY duration (trigger bars)", minval=1, group=group_trigger)
fakeoutBars_in  = input.int(3, "Fakeout window (trigger bars)", minval=1, group=group_trigger)

useMSSFilter = input.bool(true, "MSS Filter (ATR displacement)", group=group_trigger)
mssAtrMult   = input.float(0.6, "MSS min displacement (x ATR)", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=group_trigger)

stateHoldBars_in = input.int(8, "State color hold (bars)", minval=1, group=group_trigger)
flashBars_in     = input.int(6, "Fakeout flash bars", minval=1, group=group_trigger)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 5) Panel UI
//====================================================
group_panel = "5) Panel UI"

showPanel      = input.bool(true, "Show Panel", group=group_panel)
panelPos       = input.string("Top Right", "Panel position",
     options=["Top Right","Top Left","Bottom Right","Bottom Left","Middle Right","Middle Left","Top Center","Bottom Center"], group=group_panel)
panelCompact   = input.bool(true, "Panel Compact Mode (6 lines)", group=group_panel)
panelTextSize  = input.string("Small", "Panel text size", options=["Tiny","Small","Normal"], group=group_panel)

panelBgAlpha   = input.int(85, "Panel background alpha (0 opaque → 100 transparent)", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_panel)
panelTextAlpha = input.int(0,  "Panel text alpha (0 opaque → 100 transparent)", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_panel)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 6) Chart Visuals
//====================================================
group_vis = "6) Chart Visuals"

showBiasLines    = input.bool(true, "Show Bias Lines (EMA200 4H/D)", group=group_vis)
showAnchoredVWAP = input.bool(true, "Show Anchored VWAP (W/M)", group=group_vis)
showStructure    = input.bool(true, "Show Structure (levels + markers)", group=group_vis)
showTriggerBox   = input.bool(true, "Show Trigger Range (Lines/Fill)", group=group_vis)
fillRangeArea    = input.bool(false, "Fill Range Area (transparent)", group=group_vis)
showRangeLines   = input.bool(true, "Range Lines", group=group_vis)

paintGO          = input.bool(true, "Paint Background on GO", group=group_vis)
goBgAlpha        = input.int(92, "GO background tint alpha", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_vis)

showInPlayLine   = input.bool(true, "Show IN_PLAY level line", group=group_vis)

signalTextAlpha  = input.int(0,  "Marker text alpha (0 opaque → 100 transparent)", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_vis)
showSignalsOnlyWhenRelevant = input.bool(true, "Show markers only on WATCH/GO", group=group_vis)
markerSizeSmall = input.bool(false, "Marker size: Small (else Tiny)", group=group_vis)

// --- Marker stacking + BOS visibility (v3.5 package) ---
stackStepATR = input.float(0.35, "Marker stack step (x ATR)", minval=0.01, step=0.01, group=group_vis)
circleNudgeATR = input.float(0.20, "Circle nudge (x ATR)", minval=0.0, step=0.01, group=group_vis)
bosDisplayMode = input.string("Auto by Mode", "BOS Display Mode", options=["Auto by Mode","Always ON","Always OFF"], group=group_vis)
keepLastBosBars = input.int(50, "Keep last BOS bars (Auto by Mode)", minval=1, group=group_vis)
bosMinMoveATR = input.float(0.0, "BOS min move (x ATR) [anti-spam]", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=group_vis)

biasColor4H    = input.color(color.orange, "EMA200 4H color", group=group_vis)
biasColorD     = input.color(color.red,    "EMA200 D color", group=group_vis)
vwapColorW     = input.color(color.aqua,   "aVWAP Weekly color", group=group_vis)
vwapColorM     = input.color(color.purple, "aVWAP Monthly color", group=group_vis)

structResColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 0), "Structure RES line color", group=group_vis)
structSupColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 0), "Structure SUP line color", group=group_vis)
structLineStyle= input.string("Solid",  "Structure line style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], group=group_vis)

rangeNormalHi  = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "Range High normal", group=group_vis)
rangeNormalLo  = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "Range Low normal", group=group_vis)
rangeBreakHi   = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 0), "Range High on Break", group=group_vis)
rangeBreakLo   = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 0), "Range Low on Break", group=group_vis)
rangeRetHi     = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "Range High on Retest", group=group_vis)
rangeRetLo     = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "Range Low on Retest", group=group_vis)

rangeLineStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Range line style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], group=group_vis)

inPlayColor    = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "IN_PLAY line color", group=group_vis)
fakeoutColor   = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0), "Fakeout flash color", group=group_vis)

//====================================================
// Profile Presets (reset-on-profile-change behavior)
//====================================================
var string prevProfile = na

// Presets (effective when no manual override is active)
var float retestTolATR_p = na
var int   inPlayBars_p   = na
var int   fakeoutBars_p  = na
var int   stateHoldBars_p= na
var int   flashBars_p    = na
var int   goThPreset     = na
var int   watchThPreset  = na

// Manual override latch:
// - After a Profile switch: overrides are OFF (presets take over)
// - If you change any override input: overrides turn ON until next Profile switch
var bool overridesOn = false
var float last_retestTol = na
var int   last_inPlayBars = na
var int   last_fakeoutBars = na
var int   last_stateHold = na
var int   last_flashBars = na
var int   last_goTh = na
var int   last_watchTh = na

// Apply presets when profile changes (or first run)
profileChanged = na(prevProfile) or profile != prevProfile
if profileChanged
    overridesOn := false

    if profile == "Sniper"
        retestTolATR_p := 0.15
        inPlayBars_p   := 5
        fakeoutBars_p  := 3
        stateHoldBars_p:= 10
        flashBars_p    := 8
        goThPreset     := 9
        watchThPreset  := 7
    else if profile == "Aggressive"
        retestTolATR_p := 0.25
        inPlayBars_p   := 8
        fakeoutBars_p  := 2
        stateHoldBars_p:= 7
        flashBars_p    := 5
        goThPreset     := 7
        watchThPreset  := 5
    else
        // Balanced
        retestTolATR_p := 0.20
        inPlayBars_p   := 6
        fakeoutBars_p  := 3
        stateHoldBars_p:= 8
        flashBars_p    := 6
        goThPreset     := 8
        watchThPreset  := 6

    // Sync "last seen" inputs so switching profile doesn't instantly count as a manual edit
    last_retestTol := retestTolATR_in
    last_inPlayBars := inPlayBars_in
    last_fakeoutBars := fakeoutBars_in
    last_stateHold := stateHoldBars_in
    last_flashBars := flashBars_in
    last_goTh := goTh_in
    last_watchTh := watchTh_in

    prevProfile := profile

// Detect manual edits (latch ON)
if not overridesOn
    edited = (retestTolATR_in != last_retestTol) or (inPlayBars_in != last_inPlayBars) or (fakeoutBars_in != last_fakeoutBars) or (stateHoldBars_in != last_stateHold) or (flashBars_in != last_flashBars)
    edited := edited or (enableManualThresholds and ((goTh_in != last_goTh) or (watchTh_in != last_watchTh)))
    if edited
        overridesOn := true

// Update last seen inputs (always)
last_retestTol := retestTolATR_in
last_inPlayBars := inPlayBars_in
last_fakeoutBars := fakeoutBars_in
last_stateHold := stateHoldBars_in
last_flashBars := flashBars_in
last_goTh := goTh_in
last_watchTh := watchTh_in

// Effective values
retestTolATR = overridesOn ? retestTolATR_in : retestTolATR_p
inPlayBars   = overridesOn ? inPlayBars_in   : inPlayBars_p
fakeoutBars  = overridesOn ? fakeoutBars_in  : fakeoutBars_p
stateHoldBars= overridesOn ? stateHoldBars_in: stateHoldBars_p
flashBars    = overridesOn ? flashBars_in    : flashBars_p

goTh    = (enableManualThresholds and overridesOn) ? goTh_in : goThPreset
watchTh = (enableManualThresholds and overridesOn) ? watchTh_in : watchThPreset
//====================================================
// Helpers
//====================================================
f_sec(_tf, _expr) =>
    request.security(syminfo.tickerid, _tf, _expr, barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

string tf_trigger_eff = tf_trigger
if autoTriggerTF
    if timeframe.isintraday
        tf_trigger_eff := "60"
    else if timeframe.isdaily
        tf_trigger_eff := "240"
    else
        tf_trigger_eff := "D"

// Auto structure TF mapping
string tf_struct_eff = tf_struct
if autoStructTF
    if timeframe.isintraday
        tf_struct_eff := "240"
    else if timeframe.isdaily
        tf_struct_eff := "D"
    else if timeframe.isweekly
        tf_struct_eff := "W"
    else
        // monthly and higher
        tf_struct_eff := "M"

// Panel position mapping
pos = position.top_right
if panelPos == "Top Left"
    pos := position.top_left
else if panelPos == "Bottom Right"
    pos := position.bottom_right
else if panelPos == "Bottom Left"
    pos := position.bottom_left
else if panelPos == "Middle Right"
    pos := position.middle_right
else if panelPos == "Middle Left"
    pos := position.middle_left
else if panelPos == "Top Center"
    pos := position.top_center
else if panelPos == "Bottom Center"
    pos := position.bottom_center

pTextSize = panelTextSize == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : panelTextSize == "Normal" ? size.small : size.small
mSizeSmall = markerSizeSmall
f_lstyle(_s) =>
    _s == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : _s == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid

rngStyle = f_lstyle(rangeLineStyle)
stStyle  = f_lstyle(structLineStyle)

//====================================================
// Anchored VWAP
//====================================================
f_anchored_vwap(_anchorTf) =>
    pid = time(_anchorTf)
    var int lastPid = na
    var float cumPV = na
    var float cumV  = na
    newPeriod = na(lastPid) or pid != lastPid
    lastPid := pid
    if newPeriod or na(cumPV) or na(cumV)
        cumPV := hlc3 * volume
        cumV  := volume
    else
        cumPV += hlc3 * volume
        cumV  += volume
    cumPV / math.max(cumV, 1)

//====================================================
// Gate 1: Bias
//====================================================
ema200_4h = f_sec(tf_bias1, ta.ema(close, 200))
ema200_d  = f_sec(tf_bias2, ta.ema(close, 200))

wvwap = (useWeeklyVW  ? f_anchored_vwap("W") : na)
mvwap = (useMonthlyVW ? f_anchored_vwap("M") : na)

biasLong  = close > ema200_4h and close > ema200_d
biasShort = close < ema200_4h and close < ema200_d

vwapLong  = (not useWeeklyVW or close > wvwap) and (not useMonthlyVW or close > mvwap)
vwapShort = (not useWeeklyVW or close < wvwap) and (not useMonthlyVW or close < mvwap)

//====================================================
// Gate 2: Structure
//====================================================
ph_s = f_sec(tf_struct_eff, ta.pivothigh(high, pivotL, pivotR))
pl_s = f_sec(tf_struct_eff, ta.pivotlow(low,  pivotL, pivotR))

var float lastSwingHigh = na
var float lastSwingLow  = na
if not na(ph_s)
    lastSwingHigh := ph_s
if not na(pl_s)
    lastSwingLow := pl_s

bosUp   = not na(lastSwingHigh) and close > lastSwingHigh
bosDown = not na(lastSwingLow)  and close < lastSwingLow

var int st = 0
if bosUp
    st := 1
else if bosDown
    st := -1

chochUp_raw   = st == -1 and bosUp
chochDown_raw = st == 1  and bosDown

atr    = ta.atr(atrLen)
atrPct = atr / close
ema50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
trendFlat = math.abs(ta.change(ema50, 10)) / close < 0.005
isRange   = (atrPct < 0.015) and trendFlat and (not bosUp) and (not bosDown)

disp  = math.abs(close - close[1])
mssOk = disp >= (mssAtrMult * atr)

chochUp   = useMSSFilter ? (chochUp_raw and mssOk) : chochUp_raw
chochDown = useMSSFilter ? (chochDown_raw and mssOk) : chochDown_raw

modeB = isRange
modeC = chochUp or chochDown

bosUpEvt     = bosUp and not bosUp[1] and ((close - lastSwingHigh) >= (bosMinMoveATR * atr))
bosDownEvt   = bosDown and not bosDown[1] and ((lastSwingLow - close) >= (bosMinMoveATR * atr))
chochUpEvt   = chochUp and not chochUp[1]
chochDownEvt = chochDown and not chochDown[1]

string mssStatus = "—"
if useMSSFilter
    if chochUp_raw or chochDown_raw
        mssStatus := mssOk ? "PASS" : "BLOCK"
    else
        mssStatus := "IDLE"
else
    mssStatus := "OFF"

//====================================================
// Gate 3: Trigger + IN_PLAY + Fakeout
//====================================================
atr_t       = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.atr(atrLen))
rangeHigh_t = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.highest(high, rangeLen))
rangeLow_t  = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.lowest(low,  rangeLen))

close_t  = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, close)
high_t   = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, high)
low_t    = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, low)
time_t   = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, time)

rh_prev     = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.highest(high, rangeLen)[1])
rl_prev     = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.lowest(low,  rangeLen)[1])
close_prev  = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, close[1])

breakUp   = close_t > rh_prev and close_prev <= rh_prev
breakDown = close_t < rl_prev and close_prev >= rl_prev

tol = retestTolATR * atr_t
retestUp   = (low_t <= (rangeHigh_t + tol)) and (close_t > rangeHigh_t)
retestDown = (high_t >= (rangeLow_t - tol)) and (close_t < rangeLow_t)

breakUpEvt    = breakUp and not breakUp[1]
breakDownEvt  = breakDown and not breakDown[1]
retestUpEvt   = retestUp and not retestUp[1]
retestDownEvt = retestDown and not retestDown[1]

var int lastTrigTime = na
newTrigBar = na(lastTrigTime) or time_t != lastTrigTime
if newTrigBar
    lastTrigTime := time_t

var int   inDir = 0
var float inLvl = na
var int   inTTL = 0
var int   inFakeTTL = 0

if breakUpEvt or retestUpEvt
    inDir := 1
    inLvl := rangeHigh_t
    inTTL := inPlayBars
    inFakeTTL := fakeoutBars

if breakDownEvt or retestDownEvt
    inDir := -1
    inLvl := rangeLow_t
    inTTL := inPlayBars
    inFakeTTL := fakeoutBars

if newTrigBar
    if inTTL > 0
        inTTL -= 1
    if inFakeTTL > 0
        inFakeTTL -= 1
    if inTTL <= 0
        inDir := 0
        inLvl := na
        inFakeTTL := 0

fakeout = false
invalid = false

if inDir == 1 and not na(inLvl)
    if inFakeTTL > 0 and close_t < inLvl
        fakeout := true
    if close_t < inLvl
        invalid := true

if inDir == -1 and not na(inLvl)
    if inFakeTTL > 0 and close_t > inLvl
        fakeout := true
    if close_t > inLvl
        invalid := true

if invalid
    inDir := 0
    inLvl := na
    inTTL := 0
    inFakeTTL := 0

triggerLong  = (breakUp or retestUp) or (inDir == 1)
triggerShort = (breakDown or retestDown) or (inDir == -1)

string inPlayStatus = (inDir == 1) ? ("LONG(" + str.tostring(inTTL) + ")") : (inDir == -1) ? ("SHORT(" + str.tostring(inTTL) + ")") : "OFF"

//====================================================
// Gate 4: Momentum
//====================================================
[macdLine, signalLine, hist] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
histSlope = hist - hist[1]
rsi = ta.rsi(close, 14)

momLong  = (hist > 0 and histSlope > 0) and (rsi >= 50)
momShort = (hist < 0 and histSlope < 0) and (rsi <= 50)

//====================================================
// Gate 5: Zones + Space
//====================================================
nearestRes = lastSwingHigh
nearestSup = lastSwingLow

distToResATR = not na(nearestRes) ? math.abs(nearestRes - close) / atr : na
distToSupATR = not na(nearestSup) ? math.abs(close - nearestSup) / atr : na

spaceLong  = not na(nearestRes) ? ((nearestRes > close) and ((nearestRes - close) / atr >= 1.2)) : true
spaceShort = not na(nearestSup) ? ((nearestSup < close) and ((close - nearestSup) / atr >= 1.2)) : true

//====================================================
// Scoring
//====================================================
int scoreLong  = 0
int scoreShort = 0

scoreLong  += biasLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += biasShort ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += vwapLong  ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += vwapShort ? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += (st == 1)  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += (st == -1) ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += (modeC and chochUp)   ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += (modeC and chochDown) ? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += triggerLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += triggerShort ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += (inDir == 1) ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += (inDir == -1)? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += momLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += momShort ? 2 : 0

scoreLong  += spaceLong  ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += spaceShort ? 1 : 0

if fakeout
    scoreLong  := math.max(scoreLong - 2, 0)
    scoreShort := math.max(scoreShort - 2, 0)

conflict = (biasLong and st == -1) or (biasShort and st == 1)
conflictPenalty = profile == "Sniper" ? 2 : 1
if conflict
    scoreLong  := math.max(scoreLong  - conflictPenalty, 0)
    scoreShort := math.max(scoreShort - conflictPenalty, 0)

maxScore = math.max(scoreLong, scoreShort)

//====================================================
// Verdict / State / Quality / Mode
//====================================================
string verdict = "NO-TRADE"
if scoreLong >= scoreShort and scoreLong >= goTh
    verdict := "LONG"
else if scoreShort > scoreLong and scoreShort >= goTh
    verdict := "SHORT"

string state = "⛔ NO-TRADE"
if verdict != "NO-TRADE"
    state := "✅ GO"
else if maxScore >= watchTh
    state := "⚠️ WATCH"

string quality = "—"
if maxScore >= (goTh + 2)
    quality := "EXCELENTE"
else if maxScore >= goTh
    quality := "BOM"
else if maxScore >= watchTh
    quality := "REGULAR"

string mode = "A (CONTINUAÇÃO)"
if modeC
    mode := "C (REVERSÃO)"
else if modeB or breakUpEvt or breakDownEvt or retestUpEvt or retestDownEvt or (inDir != 0)
    mode := "B (BREAKOUT)"

relevant = (not showSignalsOnlyWhenRelevant) or (state != "⛔ NO-TRADE")

//====================================================
// Visuals
//====================================================
bgLong  = paintGO and verdict == "LONG"
bgShort = paintGO and verdict == "SHORT"
bgcolor(bgLong ? color.new(color.green, goBgAlpha) : na)
bgcolor(bgShort ? color.new(color.red, goBgAlpha) : na)

plot(showBiasLines ? ema200_4h : na, "EMA200 4H", linewidth=2, color=biasColor4H)
plot(showBiasLines ? ema200_d  : na, "EMA200 D",  linewidth=2, color=biasColorD)

plot(showAnchoredVWAP and useWeeklyVW  ? wvwap : na, "aVWAP Weekly", linewidth=1, color=vwapColorW)
plot(showAnchoredVWAP and useMonthlyVW ? mvwap : na, "aVWAP Monthly", linewidth=1, color=vwapColorM)

// Structure levels
var line lnRes = na
var line lnSup = na

if barstate.islast and showStructure
    if na(lnRes)
        lnRes := line.new(bar_index-200, nearestRes, bar_index, nearestRes, extend=extend.right, style=stStyle, color=structResColor)
    else
        line.set_xy1(lnRes, bar_index-200, nearestRes)
        line.set_xy2(lnRes, bar_index, nearestRes)
        line.set_extend(lnRes, extend.right)
        line.set_style(lnRes, stStyle)
        line.set_color(lnRes, structResColor)

    if na(lnSup)
        lnSup := line.new(bar_index-200, nearestSup, bar_index, nearestSup, extend=extend.right, style=stStyle, color=structSupColor)
    else
        line.set_xy1(lnSup, bar_index-200, nearestSup)
        line.set_xy2(lnSup, bar_index, nearestSup)
        line.set_extend(lnSup, extend.right)
        line.set_style(lnSup, stStyle)
        line.set_color(lnSup, structSupColor)
else if barstate.islast and not showStructure
    if not na(lnRes)
        line.delete(lnRes), lnRes := na
    if not na(lnSup)
        line.delete(lnSup), lnSup := na

// Markers

//====================================================
// Marker stacking helpers (B/C/K/R)
//====================================================
stackATR = atr * stackStepATR

// Active markers per bar (split above/below)
aboveB = bosUpEvt
aboveC = chochUpEvt
aboveK = breakUpEvt
aboveR = retestDownEvt
belowB = bosDownEvt
belowC = chochDownEvt
belowK = breakDownEvt
belowR = retestUpEvt

// Rank (1..n) for stacking
aboveRankB = 1
aboveRankC = (aboveB ? 1 : 0) + 1
aboveRankK = (aboveB ? 1 : 0) + (aboveC ? 1 : 0) + 1
aboveRankR = (aboveB ? 1 : 0) + (aboveC ? 1 : 0) + (aboveK ? 1 : 0) + 1
belowRankB = 1
belowRankC = (belowB ? 1 : 0) + 1
belowRankK = (belowB ? 1 : 0) + (belowC ? 1 : 0) + 1
belowRankR = (belowB ? 1 : 0) + (belowC ? 1 : 0) + (belowK ? 1 : 0) + 1

// Y for absolute placement
yAbove(_rank) => high + (stackATR * _rank)
yBelow(_rank) => low  - (stackATR * _rank)

// Helper: stacked markers via labels (Pine plotshape has no y=)
// We use label.style_none + unicode symbols to match the visual size of plotshape.
f_stackText(_cond, _y, _text, _txtColor, _size) =>
    if _cond
        label.new(bar_index, _y, _text,
          style=label.style_none,
          textcolor=_txtColor,
          color=color.new(color.black, 100),
          size=_size)


// BOS visibility gate
bosShow = bosDisplayMode == "Always ON" ? true : bosDisplayMode == "Always OFF" ? false : (modeB or modeC) ? (bar_index >= (last_bar_index - keepLastBosBars)) : true
f_stackText(showStructure and relevant and bosShow and bosUpEvt, yAbove(aboveRankB), "▲B", color.new(color.white, signalTextAlpha), size.small)
f_stackText(showStructure and relevant and bosShow and bosDownEvt, yBelow(belowRankB), "▼B", color.new(color.white, signalTextAlpha), size.small)
f_stackText(showStructure and relevant and chochUpEvt, yAbove(aboveRankC), "▲C", color.new(color.white, signalTextAlpha), size.small)
f_stackText(showStructure and relevant and chochDownEvt, yBelow(belowRankC), "▼C", color.new(color.white, signalTextAlpha), size.small)

// Range lines with state coloring (using preset stateHoldBars/flashBars)
var int rngState = 0
var int rngHold = 0
var int flashHold = 0

if breakUpEvt or breakDownEvt
    rngState := 1
    rngHold := stateHoldBars
if retestUpEvt or retestDownEvt
    rngState := 2
    rngHold := stateHoldBars

if rngHold > 0
    rngHold -= 1
if rngHold <= 0
    rngState := 0

if fakeout
    flashHold := flashBars
if flashHold > 0
    flashHold -= 1

hiCol = rngState == 1 ? rangeBreakHi : rngState == 2 ? rangeRetHi : rangeNormalHi
loCol = rngState == 1 ? rangeBreakLo : rngState == 2 ? rangeRetLo : rangeNormalLo
if flashHold > 0
    hiCol := fakeoutColor
    loCol := fakeoutColor

var line lnRH = na
var line lnRL = na
var box  bxRange = na

if barstate.islast and showTriggerBox
    leftBars = 120
    if showRangeLines
        if na(lnRH)
            lnRH := line.new(bar_index-leftBars, rangeHigh_t, bar_index, rangeHigh_t, extend=extend.right, style=rngStyle, color=hiCol)
        else
            line.set_xy1(lnRH, bar_index-leftBars, rangeHigh_t)
            line.set_xy2(lnRH, bar_index, rangeHigh_t)
            line.set_extend(lnRH, extend.right)
            line.set_style(lnRH, rngStyle)
            line.set_color(lnRH, hiCol)

        if na(lnRL)
            lnRL := line.new(bar_index-leftBars, rangeLow_t, bar_index, rangeLow_t, extend=extend.right, style=rngStyle, color=loCol)
        else
            line.set_xy1(lnRL, bar_index-leftBars, rangeLow_t)
            line.set_xy2(lnRL, bar_index, rangeLow_t)
            line.set_extend(lnRL, extend.right)
            line.set_style(lnRL, rngStyle)
            line.set_color(lnRL, loCol)

    if fillRangeArea
        if na(bxRange)
            bxRange := box.new(bar_index-leftBars, rangeHigh_t, bar_index, rangeLow_t)
        else
            box.set_lefttop(bxRange, bar_index-leftBars, rangeHigh_t)
            box.set_rightbottom(bxRange, bar_index, rangeLow_t)
        box.set_bgcolor(bxRange, color.new(hiCol, 92))
        box.set_border_color(bxRange, color.new(hiCol, 100))
    else
        if not na(bxRange)
            box.delete(bxRange), bxRange := na
else
    if not na(lnRH)
        line.delete(lnRH), lnRH := na
    if not na(lnRL)
        line.delete(lnRL), lnRL := na
    if not na(bxRange)
        box.delete(bxRange), bxRange := na

f_stackText(showTriggerBox and relevant and breakUpEvt, yAbove(aboveRankK) + (stackATR * circleNudgeATR), "●K", color.new(color.yellow, 0), (mSizeSmall ? size.small : size.tiny))
f_stackText(showTriggerBox and relevant and breakDownEvt, yBelow(belowRankK) - (stackATR * circleNudgeATR), "●K", color.new(color.yellow, 0), (mSizeSmall ? size.small : size.tiny))
f_stackText(showTriggerBox and relevant and retestUpEvt, yBelow(belowRankR) - (stackATR * circleNudgeATR), "●R", color.new(color.white, signalTextAlpha), (mSizeSmall ? size.small : size.tiny))
f_stackText(showTriggerBox and relevant and retestDownEvt, yAbove(aboveRankR) + (stackATR * circleNudgeATR), "●R", color.new(color.white, signalTextAlpha), (mSizeSmall ? size.small : size.tiny))

// IN_PLAY line
var line inLine = na
if showInPlayLine and barstate.islast
    if inDir != 0 and not na(inLvl)
        col = (flashHold > 0) ? fakeoutColor : inPlayColor
        if na(inLine)
            inLine := line.new(bar_index-200, inLvl, bar_index, inLvl, extend=extend.right, style=line.style_solid, color=col, width=2)
        else
            line.set_xy1(inLine, bar_index-200, inLvl)
            line.set_xy2(inLine, bar_index, inLvl)
            line.set_extend(inLine, extend.right)
            line.set_color(inLine, col)
            line.set_width(inLine, 2)
    else
        if not na(inLine)
            line.delete(inLine), inLine := na

//====================================================
// Panel (re-ordered by Gates + OK/NO)
//====================================================
var table t = table.new(pos, 1, 10, frame_width=1)
panelBg  = color.new(color.black, panelBgAlpha)
panelTxt = color.new(color.white, panelTextAlpha)

// Decide which side to evaluate OK/NO (prefer verdict, else bias)
sideLong  = verdict == "LONG"  or (verdict == "NO-TRADE" and biasLong and not biasShort)
sideShort = verdict == "SHORT" or (verdict == "NO-TRADE" and biasShort and not biasLong)

// Gate OK/NO strings
// Gate OK/NO strings (avoid na in ternaries for bool)
sOK = "OK"
sNO = "NO"
sNA = "—"

// aVWAP OK/NO
sAvwap = sideLong ? (vwapLong ? sOK : sNO) : sideShort ? (vwapShort ? sOK : sNO) : sNA
// Momentum OK/NO
sMom   = sideLong ? (momLong ? sOK : sNO) : sideShort ? (momShort ? sOK : sNO) : sNA
// Space OK/NO
sSpace = sideLong ? (spaceLong ? sOK : sNO) : sideShort ? (spaceShort ? sOK : sNO) : sNA
// Trigger OK/NO
sTrig  = (sideLong ? triggerLong : sideShort ? triggerShort : (inDir != 0)) ? sOK : sNO


// Trigger type (non-event)
trigType = breakUp or breakDown ? "BRK" : (retestUp or retestDown ? "RET" : "—")

// Conflict string
cStr = conflict ? ("YES(-" + str.tostring(conflictPenalty) + ")") : "NO"

// TF summary
tfLine = "PROFILE: " + profile + " | TriggerTF: " + tf_trigger_eff + " | BiasTF: " + tf_bias1 + "/" + tf_bias2 + " | StructTF: " + tf_struct_eff
mini = "B:" + (biasLong ? "LONG" : biasShort ? "SHORT" : "NEU") + " S:" + (st==1 ? "UP" : st==-1 ? "DOWN" : "—") + " T:" + ((sideLong ? triggerLong : sideShort ? triggerShort : (inDir != 0)) ? "ON" : "OFF") + " IP:" + (inDir!=0 ? "ON" : "OFF")

// Mini summary

if barstate.islast and showPanel
    if panelCompact
        // 6-line compact (gate order)
        table.cell(t, 0, 0, "PROFILE: " + profile + " | TF: " + tf_trigger_eff + " | VEREDITO: " + verdict + " | " + state + " | QUAL: " + quality, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 1, "MODO: " + mode + " | IN_PLAY: " + inPlayStatus + (fakeout ? " | FAKEOUT" : ""), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 2, "G1 Bias: " + (biasLong ? "LONG" : biasShort ? "SHORT" : "NEU") + " | aVWAP: " + sAvwap, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 3, "G2 Struct: " + (st==1 ? "UP" : st==-1 ? "DOWN" : "—") + " | MSS: " + mssStatus + " | Range: " + (modeB ? "YES" : "NO"), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 4, "G3 Trigger: " + trigType + " | Trig: " + sTrig + " | IN_PLAY: " + (inDir!=0 ? "ON" : "OFF"), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 5, "SCORES L/S: " + str.tostring(scoreLong) + " / " + str.tostring(scoreShort) + " | G4 Mom: " + sMom + " | G5 Space: " + sSpace, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        for r = 6 to 9
            table.cell(t, 0, r, "", text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
    else
        // Normal (10 lines) – canonic order: TF → verdict → G1..G5 → scores → conflict → mini
        table.cell(t, 0, 0, tfLine, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 1, "VEREDITO: " + verdict + " | " + state + " | QUAL: " + quality + " | MODO: " + mode, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 2, "G1 Bias: " + (biasLong ? "LONG" : biasShort ? "SHORT" : "NEU") + " | EMA200: " + (biasLong or biasShort ? "OK" : "—") + " | aVWAP: " + sAvwap, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 3, "G2 Struct: " + (st==1 ? "UP" : st==-1 ? "DOWN" : "—") + " | BOS/CHoCH: " + (bosUpEvt or bosDownEvt or chochUpEvt or chochDownEvt ? "EVENT" : "—") + " | MSS: " + mssStatus + " | Range: " + (modeB ? "YES" : "NO"), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 4, "G3 Trigger: " + trigType + " | Trig: " + sTrig + " | IN_PLAY: " + inPlayStatus + (fakeout ? " | FAKEOUT" : ""), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 5, "G4 Momentum: " + sMom + " | MACD/RSI: " + (sideLong ? (momLong ? "OK" : "NO") : sideShort ? (momShort ? "OK" : "NO") : "—"), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 6, "G5 Space ATR (Res/Sup): " + str.tostring(distToResATR, "#.##") + " / " + str.tostring(distToSupATR, "#.##") + " | Space: " + sSpace, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 7, "SCORES L/S: " + str.tostring(scoreLong) + " / " + str.tostring(scoreShort), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 8, "Conflict: " + cStr, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 9, mini, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
