scripts.source:
//@version=6
indicator("Liquidity Zones Tactical v0.2.2", shorttitle="LQZ v0.2.2", overlay=true, max_labels_count=200, max_lines_count=100, max_boxes_count=50)

//==================================================================================================
// Liquidity Zones Tactical v0.2.2
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Purpose:
// - Detect probable liquidity zones using equal highs/lows, sweeps, wick rejection, volume spike,
//   zone mitigation state, nearest liquidity above/below, and a proximity-aware score.
//
// Important limitation:
// - This script DOES NOT read real exchange order book / DOM / Level 2 data.
// - It estimates probable liquidity zones from chart structure and volume behavior.
//==================================================================================================

//==================================================================================================
// Groups
//==================================================================================================
groupProfile   = "1) Profile"
groupStructure = "2) Structure / Equal Highs-Lows"
groupSweep     = "3) Sweeps / Reclaim"
groupVolume    = "4) Volume / Absorption"
groupVisual    = "5) Visual"
groupPanel     = "6) Panel"
groupAlerts    = "7) Alerts"

//==================================================================================================
// Inputs — Profile
//==================================================================================================
visualMode = input.string("Clean", "Visual mode", options=["Ultra Clean", "Clean", "Standard", "Detailed"], group=groupProfile, display=display.none)
profile    = input.string("Balanced", "Sensitivity profile", options=["Sniper", "Balanced", "Aggressive"], group=groupProfile, display=display.none)

//==================================================================================================
// Inputs — Structure
//==================================================================================================
pivotL          = input.int(3, "Pivot left", minval=1, maxval=20, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
pivotR          = input.int(3, "Pivot right", minval=1, maxval=20, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
atrLen          = input.int(14, "ATR length", minval=1, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
manualTol       = input.bool(false, "Manual equal-level tolerance", group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
equalTolAtrIn   = input.float(0.12, "Equal level tolerance (x ATR)", minval=0.01, step=0.01, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
zoneHeightAtr   = input.float(0.18, "Zone half-height (x ATR)", minval=0.01, step=0.01, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
zoneForwardBars = input.int(80, "Extend zones forward (bars)", minval=5, maxval=500, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
maxZoneLifeBars = input.int(350, "Max zone life (bars)", minval=20, maxval=5000, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
invalidAtr      = input.float(0.35, "Invalidate after close beyond level (x ATR)", minval=0.01, step=0.01, group=groupStructure, display=display.none)
keepInvalidatedZones = input.bool(false, "Keep invalidated zones on chart", group=groupStructure, display=display.none)

//==================================================================================================
// Inputs — Sweeps
//==================================================================================================
signalOnClose   = input.bool(true, "Confirm sweep only on candle close", group=groupSweep, display=display.none)
reclaimMode     = input.string("Close back inside", "Sweep confirmation", options=["Close back inside", "Wick only"], group=groupSweep, display=display.none)
minWickRatioIn  = input.float(0.38, "Min rejection wick (% of range)", minval=0.05, maxval=0.95, step=0.01, group=groupSweep, display=display.none)

//==================================================================================================
// Inputs — Volume / Absorption
//==================================================================================================
volLen            = input.int(20, "Volume MA length", minval=1, group=groupVolume, display=display.none)
volMultIn         = input.float(1.50, "Volume spike multiplier", minval=0.10, step=0.05, group=groupVolume, display=display.none)
minPressurePctIn  = input.float(56.0, "Min pressure dominance (%)", minval=50.0, maxval=90.0, step=0.5, group=groupVolume, display=display.none)

//==================================================================================================
// Inputs — Visual
//==================================================================================================
showEqualLevels          = input.bool(true, "Show equal high/low levels", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showZones                = input.bool(true, "Show liquidity zones", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showSweepMarkers         = input.bool(true, "Show sweep markers", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showAbsorptionMarkers    = input.bool(true, "Show absorption markers", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showScoreLabels          = input.bool(false, "Show score labels on sweeps", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
scoreLabelLatestOnly     = input.bool(true, "Keep only latest score label per side", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
scoreLabelMinScore       = input.int(65, "Min score for score labels", minval=1, maxval=100, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
scoreLabelCooldownBars   = input.int(24, "Score label cooldown (bars)", minval=0, maxval=500, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

buyColor     = input.color(color.lime, "Buy-side color", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
sellColor    = input.color(color.red, "Sell-side color", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
neutralColor = input.color(color.gray, "Neutral color", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

zoneTransparency      = input.int(88, "Zone transparency", minval=0, maxval=100, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
mitigatedExtraFade    = input.int(6, "Extra fade on mitigated zone", minval=0, maxval=20, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
lineTransparency      = input.int(25, "Level line transparency", minval=0, maxval=100, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
mitigatedLineFade     = input.int(30, "Mitigated line extra fade", minval=0, maxval=70, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

//==================================================================================================
// Inputs — Panel
//==================================================================================================
showPanel      = input.bool(true, "Show panel", group=groupPanel, display=display.none)
panelPosS      = input.string("Bottom Right", "Panel position", options=["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left", "Middle Right", "Middle Left"], group=groupPanel, display=display.none)
panelTextSizeS = input.string("Small", "Panel text size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal"], group=groupPanel, display=display.none)
panelBgAlpha   = input.int(85, "Panel background alpha", minval=0, maxval=100, group=groupPanel, display=display.none)
panelTextAlpha = input.int(0, "Panel text alpha", minval=0, maxval=100, group=groupPanel, display=display.none)

//==================================================================================================
// Inputs — Alerts
//==================================================================================================
enableDynamicAlertCalls = input.bool(false, "Enable dynamic alert() calls", group=groupAlerts, display=display.none)
alertMinScore           = input.int(65, "Dynamic alert min score", minval=1, maxval=100, group=groupAlerts, display=display.none)
alertCooldownBars       = input.int(12, "Dynamic alert cooldown (bars)", minval=0, maxval=500, group=groupAlerts, display=display.none)

//==================================================================================================
// Profile presets
//==================================================================================================
float equalTolAtr    = equalTolAtrIn
float volMult        = volMultIn
float minWickRatio   = minWickRatioIn
float minPressurePct = minPressurePctIn

if not manualTol
    if profile == "Sniper"
        equalTolAtr    := 0.08
        volMult        := 1.75
        minWickRatio   := 0.42
        minPressurePct := 58.0
    else if profile == "Aggressive"
        equalTolAtr    := 0.18
        volMult        := 1.25
        minWickRatio   := 0.32
        minPressurePct := 54.0
    else
        equalTolAtr    := 0.12
        volMult        := 1.50
        minWickRatio   := 0.38
        minPressurePct := 56.0

//==================================================================================================
// Helpers
//==================================================================================================
f_pos(_s) =>
    _s == "Top Left" ? position.top_left :
     _s == "Bottom Right" ? position.bottom_right :
     _s == "Bottom Left" ? position.bottom_left :
     _s == "Middle Right" ? position.middle_right :
     _s == "Middle Left" ? position.middle_left :
     position.top_right

f_size(_s) =>
    _s == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : _s == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.small

f_profile_pt(_s) =>
    _s == "Sniper" ? "Sniper" :
     _s == "Aggressive" ? "Agressivo" :
     "Balanceado"

f_visual_pt(_s) =>
    _s == "Ultra Clean" ? "Ultra limpo" :
     _s == "Clean" ? "Limpo" :
     _s == "Standard" ? "Padrão" :
     "Detalhado"

f_quality(_score) =>
    _score >= 80 ? "Muito forte" :
     _score >= 65 ? "Forte" :
     _score >= 45 ? "Média" :
     _score >= 25 ? "Fraca" :
     "Sem leitura"

f_quality_short(_score) =>
    _score >= 80 ? "Muito forte" :
     _score >= 65 ? "Forte" :
     _score >= 45 ? "Média" :
     _score >= 25 ? "Fraca" :
     "—"

f_score_color(_score, _bull) =>
    _base = _bull ? buyColor : sellColor
    _score >= 65 ? color.new(_base, 0) :
     _score >= 45 ? color.new(_base, 25) :
     _score >= 25 ? color.new(_base, 45) :
     color.new(neutralColor, 20)

f_compact_price(_v) =>
    na(_v) ? "—" : str.tostring(_v, format.mintick)

f_state_short(_exists, _mitigated) =>
    _exists ? (_mitigated ? "Mitig." : "Ativa") : "—"

f_prox_points(_price, _level, _atr) =>
    if na(_level) or _atr <= 0
        0.0
    else
        _distAtr = math.abs(_price - _level) / _atr
        _distAtr <= 0.25 ? 25.0 :
         _distAtr <= 0.50 ? 18.0 :
         _distAtr <= 1.00 ? 10.0 :
         _distAtr <= 1.50 ? 5.0 :
         0.0

f_pick_min_na(_a, _b) =>
    na(_a) ? _b : na(_b) ? _a : math.min(_a, _b)

f_pick_max_na(_a, _b) =>
    na(_a) ? _b : na(_b) ? _a : math.max(_a, _b)

f_dist_atr_txt(_price, _level, _atr) =>
    na(_level) or _atr <= 0 ? "—" : str.tostring(math.abs(_price - _level) / _atr, "#.##") + " ATR"

displayNoStatus = display.all - display.status_line

//==================================================================================================
// Core calculations
//==================================================================================================
atr = ta.atr(atrLen)
ph  = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotL, pivotR)
pl  = ta.pivotlow(low, pivotL, pivotR)

rangeSafe      = math.max(high - low, syminfo.mintick)
upperWick      = high - math.max(open, close)
lowerWick      = math.min(open, close) - low
upperWickRatio = upperWick / rangeSafe
lowerWickRatio = lowerWick / rangeSafe

volSafe     = nz(volume, 0.0)
volMA       = ta.sma(volSafe, volLen)
volumeSpike = volMA > 0 and volSafe >= volMA * volMult

buyVol   = rangeSafe > 0 ? volSafe * (close - low) / rangeSafe : 0.0
sellVol  = rangeSafe > 0 ? volSafe * (high - close) / rangeSafe : 0.0
totalVol = buyVol + sellVol
buyPct   = totalVol > 0 ? 100.0 * buyVol / totalVol : 50.0
sellPct  = totalVol > 0 ? 100.0 * sellVol / totalVol : 50.0

upperReject   = upperWickRatio >= minWickRatio
lowerReject   = lowerWickRatio >= minWickRatio
buyDominance  = buyPct >= minPressurePct
sellDominance = sellPct >= minPressurePct

//==================================================================================================
// Persistent state
//==================================================================================================
var float lastSwingHigh = na
var int   lastSwingHighIndex = na
var float lastSwingLow = na
var int   lastSwingLowIndex = na

var float eqHighLevel = na
var int   eqHighBorn = na
var bool  eqHighExists = false
var bool  eqHighMitigated = false
var float sellZoneTop = na
var float sellZoneBottom = na
var line  eqHighLine = na
var box   sellZoneBox = na

var float eqLowLevel = na
var int   eqLowBorn = na
var bool  eqLowExists = false
var bool  eqLowMitigated = false
var float buyZoneTop = na
var float buyZoneBottom = na
var line  eqLowLine = na
var box   buyZoneBox = na

//==================================================================================================
// Equal highs / lows detection
//==================================================================================================
if not na(ph)
    curHighIndex = bar_index - pivotR
    tolHigh = nz(atr[pivotR], atr) * equalTolAtr
    if not na(lastSwingHigh) and math.abs(ph - lastSwingHigh) <= tolHigh
        eqHighLevel := (ph + lastSwingHigh) / 2.0
        eqHighBorn := curHighIndex
        eqHighExists := true
        eqHighMitigated := false

        zoneHalfH = nz(atr[pivotR], atr) * zoneHeightAtr
        sellZoneTop := eqHighLevel + zoneHalfH
        sellZoneBottom := eqHighLevel - zoneHalfH

        if not na(eqHighLine)
            line.delete(eqHighLine)
        if not na(sellZoneBox)
            box.delete(sellZoneBox)

        eqHighLine := line.new(
             x1=lastSwingHighIndex,
             y1=eqHighLevel,
             x2=curHighIndex,
             y2=eqHighLevel,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             extend=extend.right,
             color=color.new(sellColor, lineTransparency),
             style=line.style_dashed,
             width=1)

        sellZoneBox := box.new(
             left=lastSwingHighIndex,
             top=sellZoneTop,
             right=bar_index + zoneForwardBars,
             bottom=sellZoneBottom,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             bgcolor=color.new(sellColor, zoneTransparency),
             border_color=color.new(sellColor, 35))

    lastSwingHigh := ph
    lastSwingHighIndex := curHighIndex

if not na(pl)
    curLowIndex = bar_index - pivotR
    tolLow = nz(atr[pivotR], atr) * equalTolAtr
    if not na(lastSwingLow) and math.abs(pl - lastSwingLow) <= tolLow
        eqLowLevel := (pl + lastSwingLow) / 2.0
        eqLowBorn := curLowIndex
        eqLowExists := true
        eqLowMitigated := false

        zoneHalfL = nz(atr[pivotR], atr) * zoneHeightAtr
        buyZoneTop := eqLowLevel + zoneHalfL
        buyZoneBottom := eqLowLevel - zoneHalfL

        if not na(eqLowLine)
            line.delete(eqLowLine)
        if not na(buyZoneBox)
            box.delete(buyZoneBox)

        eqLowLine := line.new(
             x1=lastSwingLowIndex,
             y1=eqLowLevel,
             x2=curLowIndex,
             y2=eqLowLevel,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             extend=extend.right,
             color=color.new(buyColor, lineTransparency),
             style=line.style_dashed,
             width=1)

        buyZoneBox := box.new(
             left=lastSwingLowIndex,
             top=buyZoneTop,
             right=bar_index + zoneForwardBars,
             bottom=buyZoneBottom,
             xloc=xloc.bar_index,
             bgcolor=color.new(buyColor, zoneTransparency),
             border_color=color.new(buyColor, 35))

    lastSwingLow := pl
    lastSwingLowIndex := curLowIndex

//==================================================================================================
// Zone maintenance: extend, mitigation, invalidation
//==================================================================================================
if not na(sellZoneBox)
    box.set_right(sellZoneBox, bar_index + zoneForwardBars)

if not na(buyZoneBox)
    box.set_right(buyZoneBox, bar_index + zoneForwardBars)

sellTouched = eqHighExists and not na(sellZoneTop) and high >= sellZoneBottom and low <= sellZoneTop
buyTouched  = eqLowExists and not na(buyZoneTop) and high >= buyZoneBottom and low <= buyZoneTop

if sellTouched
    eqHighMitigated := true

if buyTouched
    eqLowMitigated := true

sellExpired = eqHighExists and not na(eqHighBorn) and bar_index - eqHighBorn > maxZoneLifeBars
buyExpired  = eqLowExists and not na(eqLowBorn) and bar_index - eqLowBorn > maxZoneLifeBars
sellInvalid = eqHighExists and not na(eqHighLevel) and close > eqHighLevel + atr * invalidAtr
buyInvalid  = eqLowExists and not na(eqLowLevel) and close < eqLowLevel - atr * invalidAtr

if sellExpired or sellInvalid
    eqHighExists := false
    eqHighMitigated := false
    if not keepInvalidatedZones
        if not na(eqHighLine)
            line.delete(eqHighLine)
            eqHighLine := na
        if not na(sellZoneBox)
            box.delete(sellZoneBox)
            sellZoneBox := na
        sellZoneTop := na
        sellZoneBottom := na

if buyExpired or buyInvalid
    eqLowExists := false
    eqLowMitigated := false
    if not keepInvalidatedZones
        if not na(eqLowLine)
            line.delete(eqLowLine)
            eqLowLine := na
        if not na(buyZoneBox)
            box.delete(buyZoneBox)
            buyZoneBox := na
        buyZoneTop := na
        buyZoneBottom := na

//==================================================================================================
// Zone styling: active vs mitigated
//==================================================================================================
if not na(sellZoneBox)
    sellBgAlpha = eqHighMitigated ? math.min(zoneTransparency + mitigatedExtraFade, 97) : zoneTransparency
    sellLineAlpha = eqHighMitigated ? math.min(lineTransparency + mitigatedLineFade, 95) : lineTransparency
    box.set_bgcolor(sellZoneBox, showZones ? color.new(sellColor, sellBgAlpha) : color.new(sellColor, 100))
    box.set_border_color(sellZoneBox, color.new(sellColor, eqHighMitigated ? 70 : 35))
    if not na(eqHighLine)
        line.set_color(eqHighLine, showEqualLevels and visualMode != "Ultra Clean" ? color.new(sellColor, sellLineAlpha) : color.new(sellColor, 100))

if not na(buyZoneBox)
    buyBgAlpha = eqLowMitigated ? math.min(zoneTransparency + mitigatedExtraFade, 97) : zoneTransparency
    buyLineAlpha = eqLowMitigated ? math.min(lineTransparency + mitigatedLineFade, 95) : lineTransparency
    box.set_bgcolor(buyZoneBox, showZones ? color.new(buyColor, buyBgAlpha) : color.new(buyColor, 100))
    box.set_border_color(buyZoneBox, color.new(buyColor, eqLowMitigated ? 70 : 35))
    if not na(eqLowLine)
        line.set_color(eqLowLine, showEqualLevels and visualMode != "Ultra Clean" ? color.new(buyColor, buyLineAlpha) : color.new(buyColor, 100))

//==================================================================================================
// Sweep logic
//==================================================================================================
sellReclaimOk = reclaimMode == "Close back inside" ? close < eqHighLevel : true
buyReclaimOk  = reclaimMode == "Close back inside" ? close > eqLowLevel : true

sweepHighRaw = eqHighExists and not na(eqHighLevel) and high > eqHighLevel + syminfo.mintick and sellReclaimOk
sweepLowRaw  = eqLowExists and not na(eqLowLevel) and low < eqLowLevel - syminfo.mintick and buyReclaimOk

sweepHigh = signalOnClose ? (sweepHighRaw and barstate.isconfirmed) : sweepHighRaw
sweepLow  = signalOnClose ? (sweepLowRaw and barstate.isconfirmed) : sweepLowRaw

bearAbsorption = sweepHigh and volumeSpike and upperReject and sellDominance
bullAbsorption = sweepLow and volumeSpike and lowerReject and buyDominance

//==================================================================================================
// Score with proximity
//==================================================================================================
buyProxPts  = eqLowExists ? f_prox_points(close, eqLowLevel, atr) : 0.0
sellProxPts = eqHighExists ? f_prox_points(close, eqHighLevel, atr) : 0.0

buyScoreRaw = 0.0
buyScoreRaw += eqLowExists ? 15.0 : 0.0
buyScoreRaw += eqLowMitigated ? 5.0 : 10.0
buyScoreRaw += sweepLow ? 25.0 : 0.0
buyScoreRaw += volumeSpike ? 8.0 : 0.0
buyScoreRaw += lowerReject ? 12.0 : 0.0
buyScoreRaw += buyDominance ? 10.0 : 0.0
buyScoreRaw += close > open ? 5.0 : 0.0
buyScoreRaw += not na(eqLowLevel) and close > eqLowLevel ? 5.0 : 0.0
buyScoreRaw += buyProxPts
buyScore = math.min(buyScoreRaw, 100.0)

sellScoreRaw = 0.0
sellScoreRaw += eqHighExists ? 15.0 : 0.0
sellScoreRaw += eqHighMitigated ? 5.0 : 10.0
sellScoreRaw += sweepHigh ? 25.0 : 0.0
sellScoreRaw += volumeSpike ? 8.0 : 0.0
sellScoreRaw += upperReject ? 12.0 : 0.0
sellScoreRaw += sellDominance ? 10.0 : 0.0
sellScoreRaw += close < open ? 5.0 : 0.0
sellScoreRaw += not na(eqHighLevel) and close < eqHighLevel ? 5.0 : 0.0
sellScoreRaw += sellProxPts
sellScore = math.min(sellScoreRaw, 100.0)

buyQuality  = f_quality(buyScore)
sellQuality = f_quality(sellScore)

//==================================================================================================
// Nearest liquidity above / below
//==================================================================================================
candAbove1 = eqHighExists and eqHighLevel > close ? eqHighLevel : na
candAbove2 = eqLowExists and eqLowLevel > close ? eqLowLevel : na
nearestAbove = f_pick_min_na(candAbove1, candAbove2)

candBelow1 = eqHighExists and eqHighLevel < close ? eqHighLevel : na
candBelow2 = eqLowExists and eqLowLevel < close ? eqLowLevel : na
nearestBelow = f_pick_max_na(candBelow1, candBelow2)

aboveFromSell = not na(nearestAbove) and not na(eqHighLevel) and nearestAbove == eqHighLevel
aboveFromBuy  = not na(nearestAbove) and not na(eqLowLevel) and nearestAbove == eqLowLevel

belowFromSell = not na(nearestBelow) and not na(eqHighLevel) and nearestBelow == eqHighLevel
belowFromBuy  = not na(nearestBelow) and not na(eqLowLevel) and nearestBelow == eqLowLevel

aboveState = aboveFromSell ? f_state_short(eqHighExists, eqHighMitigated) : aboveFromBuy ? f_state_short(eqLowExists, eqLowMitigated) : "—"
belowState = belowFromSell ? f_state_short(eqHighExists, eqHighMitigated) : belowFromBuy ? f_state_short(eqLowExists, eqLowMitigated) : "—"

aboveSide = aboveFromSell ? "Res " : aboveFromBuy ? "Sup " : ""
belowSide = belowFromSell ? "Res " : belowFromBuy ? "Sup " : ""

aboveDistTxt = f_dist_atr_txt(close, nearestAbove, atr)
belowDistTxt = f_dist_atr_txt(close, nearestBelow, atr)

nearestAboveTxt = na(nearestAbove) ? "—" : aboveSide + f_compact_price(nearestAbove) + " | " + aboveDistTxt + " | " + aboveState
nearestBelowTxt = na(nearestBelow) ? "—" : belowSide + f_compact_price(nearestBelow) + " | " + belowDistTxt + " | " + belowState

//==================================================================================================
// Visual conditions
//==================================================================================================
isUltra    = visualMode == "Ultra Clean"
isStandard = visualMode == "Standard"
isDetailed = visualMode == "Detailed"

showSweepMarkersEff      = showSweepMarkers and not isUltra
showAbsorptionMarkersEff = showAbsorptionMarkers and (isStandard or isDetailed) and not isUltra
showScoreLabelsEff       = showScoreLabels and isDetailed and not isUltra

//==================================================================================================
// Visual markers
//==================================================================================================
plotshape(showSweepMarkersEff and sweepLow, title="Sweep Low / Buy Liquidity", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(buyColor, 0), text="SW↓", textcolor=color.new(color.white, 0), size=size.tiny, display=displayNoStatus)
plotshape(showSweepMarkersEff and sweepHigh, title="Sweep High / Sell Liquidity", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(sellColor, 0), text="SW↑", textcolor=color.new(color.white, 0), size=size.tiny, display=displayNoStatus)

plotshape(showAbsorptionMarkersEff and bullAbsorption, title="Bullish Absorption", style=shape.circle, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(buyColor, 0), text="A", textcolor=color.new(color.white, 0), size=size.tiny, display=displayNoStatus)
plotshape(showAbsorptionMarkersEff and bearAbsorption, title="Bearish Absorption", style=shape.circle, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(sellColor, 0), text="A", textcolor=color.new(color.white, 0), size=size.tiny, display=displayNoStatus)

//==================================================================================================
// Score labels
//==================================================================================================
var label lastBuyScoreLbl = na
var label lastSellScoreLbl = na
var int lastBuyScoreLabelBar = na
var int lastSellScoreLabelBar = na

canPrintBuyScore = showScoreLabelsEff and sweepLow and buyScore >= scoreLabelMinScore and (na(lastBuyScoreLabelBar) or bar_index - lastBuyScoreLabelBar > scoreLabelCooldownBars)
canPrintSellScore = showScoreLabelsEff and sweepHigh and sellScore >= scoreLabelMinScore and (na(lastSellScoreLabelBar) or bar_index - lastSellScoreLabelBar > scoreLabelCooldownBars)

if canPrintBuyScore
    if scoreLabelLatestOnly and not na(lastBuyScoreLbl)
        label.delete(lastBuyScoreLbl)
    buyScoreTxt = "Força C " + str.tostring(math.round(buyScore)) + " | " + buyQuality
    lastBuyScoreLbl := label.new(bar_index, low, buyScoreTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, style=label.style_label_up, textcolor=color.white, color=f_score_color(buyScore, true), size=size.tiny)
    lastBuyScoreLabelBar := bar_index

if canPrintSellScore
    if scoreLabelLatestOnly and not na(lastSellScoreLbl)
        label.delete(lastSellScoreLbl)
    sellScoreTxt = "Força V " + str.tostring(math.round(sellScore)) + " | " + sellQuality
    lastSellScoreLbl := label.new(bar_index, high, sellScoreTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=f_score_color(sellScore, false), size=size.tiny)
    lastSellScoreLabelBar := bar_index

//==================================================================================================
// Compact Operational Panel
//==================================================================================================
panelPos = f_pos(panelPosS)
panelTextSize = f_size(panelTextSizeS)

var table panel = table.new(panelPos, 2, 6, border_width=1, frame_color=color.new(color.gray, 80), border_color=color.new(color.gray, 80))

if showPanel and barstate.islast
    headerBg = color.new(color.blue, 70)
    bg = color.new(color.black, panelBgAlpha)
    txt = color.new(color.white, panelTextAlpha)

    buyTxt  = str.tostring(math.round(buyScore)) + " | " + f_quality_short(buyScore)
    sellTxt = str.tostring(math.round(sellScore)) + " | " + f_quality_short(sellScore)

    eventTxt =
         bullAbsorption ? "Sweep fundo + absorção C" :
         bearAbsorption ? "Sweep topo + absorção V" :
         sweepLow ? "Sweep fundo" :
         sweepHigh ? "Sweep topo" :
         "Sem evento"

    eventColor =
         bullAbsorption ? buyColor :
         bearAbsorption ? sellColor :
         sweepLow ? buyColor :
         sweepHigh ? sellColor :
         neutralColor

    table.cell(panel, 0, 0, "LQZ", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=headerBg, text_size=panelTextSize)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 0, f_visual_pt(visualMode) + " / " + f_profile_pt(profile), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=headerBg, text_size=panelTextSize)

    table.cell(panel, 0, 1, "Força C", text_color=txt, bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 1, buyTxt, text_color=f_score_color(buyScore, true), bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)

    table.cell(panel, 0, 2, "Força V", text_color=txt, bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 2, sellTxt, text_color=f_score_color(sellScore, false), bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)

    table.cell(panel, 0, 3, "Evento", text_color=txt, bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 3, eventTxt, text_color=color.new(eventColor, panelTextAlpha), bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)

    table.cell(panel, 0, 4, "Liq. ↑", text_color=txt, bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 4, nearestAboveTxt, text_color=txt, bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)

    table.cell(panel, 0, 5, "Liq. ↓", text_color=txt, bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 5, nearestBelowTxt, text_color=txt, bgcolor=bg, text_size=panelTextSize)

//==================================================================================================
// Alerts
//==================================================================================================
alertcondition(sweepLow, title="LQZ Sweep Low", message="LQZ: downside liquidity sweep/reclaim detected.")
alertcondition(sweepHigh, title="LQZ Sweep High", message="LQZ: upside liquidity sweep/rejection detected.")
alertcondition(bullAbsorption, title="LQZ Bullish Absorption", message="LQZ: bullish absorption after downside liquidity sweep.")
alertcondition(bearAbsorption, title="LQZ Bearish Absorption", message="LQZ: bearish absorption after upside liquidity sweep.")

var int lastDynamicAlertBar = na
canDynAlert = na(lastDynamicAlertBar) or bar_index - lastDynamicAlertBar > alertCooldownBars

if enableDynamicAlertCalls and canDynAlert
    if sweepLow and buyScore >= alertMinScore
        alert("LQZ BUY: sweep low + reclaim | score " + str.tostring(math.round(buyScore)) + " | " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        lastDynamicAlertBar := bar_index
    else if sweepHigh and sellScore >= alertMinScore
        alert("LQZ SELL: sweep high + rejection | score " + str.tostring(math.round(sellScore)) + " | " + syminfo.ticker, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        lastDynamicAlertBar := bar_index

//@version=4
// Buy Sell signal based on EMA price action for Long Term Trading (Particularly for Index Investing) Keeps you out of the emotions. 
//Script Copyright (c) Bony Mathew 2019-Present

study("Buy/Sell Signal by Bony", overlay=true)

o = security(syminfo.tickerid, timeframe.period, open)
h = security(syminfo.tickerid, timeframe.period, high)
l = security(syminfo.tickerid, timeframe.period, low)
c = security(syminfo.tickerid, timeframe.period, close)

avg_price = (o + h + l + c)/ 4

exponential_moving_average = input(title="1st EMA", type=input.integer, defval=5, minval=5, maxval=250)
exponential2_moving_average = input(title="2nd EMA", type=input.integer, defval=21, minval=10, maxval=250)


ema = ema(close, exponential_moving_average)
ema2 = ema(close, exponential2_moving_average)


sellsignal = (ema > avg_price) and (ema2 > avg_price) and (ema2 > ema)
buysignal = (ema < avg_price) and (ema2 < avg_price) and (ema2 < ema)

sellseries = sellsignal and crossover(ema2, ema)
buyseries = buysignal and crossunder(ema2, ema)

plotshape(series=sellseries, title="Short", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, text="Sell", size=size.small)
plotshape(series=buyseries, title="Long", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, text="Buy", size=size.small)

//@version=6
indicator("MA 6x PRO Unified v3.8.4", shorttitle="MA6x", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

// =====================
// Grupos
// =====================
groupMain       = "Geral"
groupPreset     = "Presets"
groupPeriod     = "Períodos"
groupVisual     = "Visual"
groupColor      = "Cores"
groupTrend      = "Leitura por Tendência"

groupLabel      = "Labels das Médias"

// =====================
// Inputs principais

src    = input.source(close, "Source", group=groupMain, display=display.none)
offset = input.int(0, "Offset", minval=-500, maxval=500, group=groupMain, display=display.none)

maType = input.string(
     "EMA",
     "MA Type",
     options=["SMA", "EMA", "WMA", "SMMA (RMA)", "VWMA"],
     group=groupMain
, display=display.none)

presetMode = input.string(
     "Custom",

     options=["Custom", "Scalp", "Swing", "Macro"],
     group=groupPreset
, display=display.none)

overridePresetVisibility = input.bool(false, "Sobrescrever visibilidade manual nos presets", group=groupPreset, display=display.none)
overridePresetWidth      = input.bool(false, "Sobrescrever espessura manual nos presets", group=groupPreset, display=display.none)

// =====================

len1 = input.int(7,   "Período MA 1", minval=1, group=groupPeriod, display=display.none)

// =====================
// Visual
// =====================
overlayView = input.string(

     "Preset visual do overlay",
     options=["Clean", "Standard", "Detailed"],
     group=groupVisual
, display=display.none)
showMA1 = input.bool(true, "Mostrar MA 1", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showMA2 = input.bool(true, "Mostrar MA 2", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showMA3 = input.bool(true, "Mostrar MA 3", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

widthMA1 = input.int(1, "Espessura MA 1", minval=1, maxval=10, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
widthMA2 = input.int(1, "Espessura MA 2", minval=1, maxval=10, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

widthMA4 = input.int(2, "Espessura MA 4", minval=1, maxval=10, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

widthMA6 = input.int(3, "Espessura MA 6", minval=1, maxval=10, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

fillMode = input.string(
     "Ribbon Core",
     "Modo de Fill",
     options=["Off", "Adjacente", "Fast x Slow", "Ribbon Core"],
     group=groupVisual
, display=display.none)
fillTransparency = input.int(88, "Transparência do Fill", minval=0, maxval=100, group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

// =====================
// Cores
// =====================
colorMA1 = input.color(color.aqua,    "Cor base MA 1", group=groupColor, display=display.none)
colorMA2 = input.color(color.orange,  "Cor base MA 2", group=groupColor, display=display.none)

colorMA6 = input.color(color.fuchsia, "Cor base MA 6", group=groupColor, display=display.none)

// =====================
// Tendência / Semântica
// =====================
trendColorMode = input.string(
     "Off",
     "Coloração por tendência",
     options=["Off", "Slope"],
     group=groupTrend
, display=display.none)

slopeLookback = input.int(2, "Lookback da inclinação", minval=1, maxval=50, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
trendUpColor  = input.color(color.lime, "Cor de alta", group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
trendDnColor  = input.color(color.red,  "Cor de baixa", group=groupTrend, display=display.none)

atrLen               = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=1, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
compressionThreshAtr = input.float(0.50, "Ribbon comprimido abaixo de X ATR", minval=0.05, step=0.05, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
expansionThreshAtr   = input.float(1.10, "Ribbon expandido acima de X ATR", minval=0.10, step=0.05, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
statusConfirmBars    = input.int(2, "Barras mínimas para confirmar status", minval=1, maxval=10, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
strongThreshold      = input.int(68, "Score forte", minval=1, maxval=100, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
mediumThreshold      = input.int(48, "Score favorável", minval=1, maxval=100, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
reversalLocalThreshold = input.int(18, "Limiar local da reversão incipiente", minval=1, maxval=100, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
pullbackThreatThreshold = input.int(22, "Limiar do pullback ameaçando estrutura", minval=1, maxval=100, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)

// =====================
// Projeções
// =====================

// =====================
// Funções
// =====================
f_ma(source, length, maType) =>
    switch maType
        "SMA"         => ta.sma(source, length)
        "EMA"         => ta.ema(source, length)
        "WMA"         => ta.wma(source, length)
        "SMMA (RMA)"  => ta.rma(source, length)
        "VWMA"        => ta.vwma(source, length)

f_resolveColor(baseColor, maValue) =>
    trendColorMode == "Slope" ?
         maValue > maValue[slopeLookback] ? trendUpColor :
         maValue < maValue[slopeLookback] ? trendDnColor :
         baseColor
         : baseColor

f_labelText(slotName, len, value) =>
    labelTextMode == "Período" ?
         slotName + " (" + str.tostring(len) + ")" :
         slotName + " (" + str.tostring(len) + ")  " + str.tostring(value, format.mintick)

f_updateLabel(label lbl, bool enabled, float y, string txt, color txtColor, color bgColor, int barsForward) =>
    label result = lbl
    if enabled and not na(y)
        if na(result)
            result := label.new(
                 x=bar_index + offset + barsForward,
                 y=y,
                 text=txt,
                 xloc=xloc.bar_index,
                 style=label.style_label_left,
                 textcolor=txtColor,
                 color=bgColor,
                 size=size.small
            )
        else
            label.set_x(result, bar_index + offset + barsForward)
            label.set_y(result, y)
            label.set_text(result, txt)
            label.set_textcolor(result, txtColor)
            label.set_color(result, bgColor)
            label.set_style(result, label.style_label_left)
    else
        if not na(result)
            label.delete(result)
            result := na
    result

f_updateChip(label lbl, bool enabled, float y, string txt, color txtColor, color bgColor, int barsForward, bool pointUp) =>
    label result = lbl
    chipStyle = pointUp ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down
    if enabled and not na(y)
        if na(result)
            result := label.new(
                 x=bar_index + offset + barsForward,
                 y=y,
                 text=txt,
                 xloc=xloc.bar_index,
                 style=chipStyle,
                 textcolor=txtColor,
                 color=bgColor,
                 size=size.small
            )
        else
            label.set_x(result, bar_index + offset + barsForward)
            label.set_y(result, y)
            label.set_text(result, txt)
            label.set_textcolor(result, txtColor)
            label.set_color(result, bgColor)
            label.set_style(result, chipStyle)
    else
        if not na(result)
            label.delete(result)
            result := na
    result

f_pickValue(slot, ma1_, ma2_, ma3_, ma4_, ma5_, ma6_) =>
    switch slot
        "MA 1" => ma1_
        "MA 2" => ma2_
        "MA 3" => ma3_
        "MA 4" => ma4_
        "MA 5" => ma5_
        "MA 6" => ma6_
        => na

f_pickColor(slot, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6) =>
    switch slot
        "MA 1" => c1
        "MA 2" => c2
        "MA 3" => c3
        "MA 4" => c4
        "MA 5" => c5
        "MA 6" => c6
        => color.white

f_pickLen(slot, len1_, len2_, len3_, len4_, len5_, len6_) =>
    switch slot
        "MA 1" => len1_
        "MA 2" => len2_
        "MA 3" => len3_
        "MA 4" => len4_
        "MA 5" => len5_
        "MA 6" => len6_
        => 0

f_swapFloat(arr, i, j) =>
    tmp = array.get(arr, i)
    array.set(arr, i, array.get(arr, j))
    array.set(arr, j, tmp)

f_swapInt(arr, i, j) =>
    tmp = array.get(arr, i)
    array.set(arr, i, array.get(arr, j))
    array.set(arr, j, tmp)

f_slotText(slot, len1_, len2_, len3_, len4_, len5_, len6_, ma1_, ma2_, ma3_, ma4_, ma5_, ma6_) =>
    switch slot
        1 => f_labelText("MA 1", len1_, ma1_)
        2 => f_labelText("MA 2", len2_, ma2_)
        3 => f_labelText("MA 3", len3_, ma3_)
        4 => f_labelText("MA 4", len4_, ma4_)
        5 => f_labelText("MA 5", len5_, ma5_)
        6 => f_labelText("MA 6", len6_, ma6_)
        => ""

f_slotColor(slot, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6) =>
    switch slot
        1 => c1
        2 => c2
        3 => c3
        4 => c4
        5 => c5
        6 => c6
        => color.white

f_qualityText(scoreAbs) =>
    scoreAbs >= 80 ? "Muito forte" :
     scoreAbs >= 65 ? "Forte" :
     scoreAbs >= 45 ? "Favorável" :
     scoreAbs >= 25 ? "Em formação" :
     "Fraco"

f_regimeShort(regimeTxt) =>
    regimeTxt == "Tendência em expansão" ? "Expansão" :
     regimeTxt == "Tendência estável" ? "Tendência" :
     regimeTxt == "Tendência cansando" ? "Cansando" :
     regimeTxt == "Transição" ? "Transição" :
     regimeTxt == "Compressão" ? "Compressão" :
     regimeTxt == "Neutro / Ruído" or regimeTxt == "Lateral / Ruído" ? "Lateral / Ruído" :
     regimeTxt

f_exhaustionText(distAtr, scoreAbs) =>
    distAtr >= 2.2 and scoreAbs >= 65 ? "Alta" :
     distAtr >= 1.2 and scoreAbs >= 45 ? "Média" :
     "Baixa"

f_statusText(netScore, regimeTxt, localTxt, textMode) =>
    directionTxt = netScore >= 15 ? "ALTA" : netScore <= -15 ? "BAIXA" : "NEUTRO"
    coreTxt = directionTxt + " | " + f_qualityText(math.abs(netScore)) + " | " + f_regimeShort(regimeTxt)
    textMode == "Detalhado" ? coreTxt + " | " + localTxt : coreTxt

f_scoreColor(netScore) =>
    netScore >= 15 ? color.new(color.lime, 0) :
     netScore <= -15 ? color.new(color.red, 0) :
     color.new(color.orange, 0)

f_safeEta(distance, relativeSpeed, minSpeed) =>
    absSpeed = math.abs(relativeSpeed)
    converging = distance > 0 and relativeSpeed < 0 or distance < 0 and relativeSpeed > 0
    converging and absSpeed >= minSpeed ? math.abs(distance / relativeSpeed) : na

f_maSlope(source, length, maType, lookback) =>
    maValue = f_ma(source, length, maType)
    maValue - maValue[lookback]

f_pairName(lenFast, lenSlow) =>
    str.tostring(lenFast) + "/" + str.tostring(lenSlow)

f_isClassicCrossPair(lenFast, lenSlow) =>
    lenFast == 50 and lenSlow == 200

f_isClassicCrossPairAnyOrder(lenA, lenB) =>
    f_isClassicCrossPair(lenA, lenB) or f_isClassicCrossPair(lenB, lenA)

f_signedArrowText(v) =>
    absTxt = str.tostring(math.round(math.abs(v)))
    v > 0 ? absTxt + "↑" :
     v < 0 ? absTxt + "↓" :
     "0~"

f_crossDirection(validEta, confirmedUp, confirmedDn, diffNow, relSpeedNow) =>
    int result = 0
    if confirmedUp
        result := 1
    else if confirmedDn
        result := -1
    else if validEta
        result := diffNow < 0 and relSpeedNow > 0 ? 1 : diffNow > 0 and relSpeedNow < 0 ? -1 : 0
    result

f_crossPanelValue(validEta, etaValue, confirmedUp, confirmedDn, diffNow, relSpeedNow, isGoldenPair) =>
    string result = "sem ETA"
    int dir = f_crossDirection(validEta, confirmedUp, confirmedDn, diffNow, relSpeedNow)
    if confirmedUp
        result := isGoldenPair ? "Cruz. alta ✓" : "✓ ↑"
    else if confirmedDn
        result := isGoldenPair ? "Cruz. baixa ✓" : "✓ ↓"
    else if validEta
        if isGoldenPair
            result := dir > 0 ? "Cruz. alta ~" + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) :
             dir < 0 ? "Cruz. baixa ~" + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) :
             "~" + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue))
        else
            result := "~" + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) + (dir > 0 ? " ↑" : dir < 0 ? " ↓" : "")
    result

f_crossEventText(name, validEta, etaValue, confirmedUp, confirmedDn, diffNow, relSpeedNow, isGoldenPair) =>
    string result = ""
    int dir = f_crossDirection(validEta, confirmedUp, confirmedDn, diffNow, relSpeedNow)
    if confirmedUp
        result := isGoldenPair ? "Cruzamento de alta confirmado: " + name : "Cruzamento confirmado para alta: " + name
    else if confirmedDn
        result := isGoldenPair ? "Cruzamento de baixa confirmado: " + name : "Cruzamento confirmado para baixa: " + name
    else if validEta
        if isGoldenPair
            result := dir > 0 ? "Cruzamento de alta provável: " + name + " ~ " + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) + " barras" :
             dir < 0 ? "Cruzamento de baixa provável: " + name + " ~ " + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) + " barras" :
             "Cruzamento provável: " + name + " ~ " + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) + " barras"
        else
            result := dir > 0 ? "Cruzamento provável para alta: " + name + " ~ " + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) + " barras" :
             dir < 0 ? "Cruzamento provável para baixa: " + name + " ~ " + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) + " barras" :
             "Cruzamento provável: " + name + " ~ " + str.tostring(math.round(etaValue)) + " barras"
    result

f_crossPriority(baseImportance, validEta, etaValue, confirmedUp, confirmedDn, isGoldenPair) =>
    int result = 0
    if confirmedUp or confirmedDn
        result := (isGoldenPair ? 380 : 240) + baseImportance
    else if validEta
        int etaBonus = maxCrossEtaBars - math.min(maxCrossEtaBars, math.round(etaValue))
        result := (isGoldenPair ? 260 : 140) + baseImportance + etaBonus
    result

f_pos(pos) =>
    switch pos
        "Top Right" => position.top_right
        "Top Left" => position.top_left
        "Bottom Right" => position.bottom_right
        "Bottom Left" => position.bottom_left
        => position.bottom_right

sizeFromString(s) =>
    switch s
        "Tiny" => size.tiny
        "Small" => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal
        "Large" => size.large
        => size.huge

f_probText(score) =>
    score >= 85 ? "Muito alta" :
     score >= 70 ? "Alta" :
     score >= 50 ? "Moderada" :
     score >= 30 ? "Baixa" :
     "Muito baixa"

f_contQualText(score) =>
    score >= 70 ? "Boa" :
     score >= 50 ? "Média" :
     "Fraca"

f_confText(score) =>
    score >= 80 ? "Alta" :
     score >= 60 ? "Boa" :
     score >= 40 ? "Média" :
     "Baixa"

f_riskText(netScore, insideRibbon, compression, mtfAligned, mixedSlopes, confidenceScore) =>
    compression or insideRibbon and math.abs(netScore) < 45 ? "Alto" :
     mixedSlopes or not mtfAligned or confidenceScore < 45 ? "Médio" :
     "Baixo"

f_regimeText(alignmentBull, alignmentBear, widthAtr, widthAtrPrev, compressionThresh, expansionThresh, insideRibbon) =>
    widthAtr < compressionThresh ? "Compressão" :
     alignmentBull or alignmentBear ? (widthAtr > widthAtrPrev ? "Tendência em expansão" : "Tendência") :
     insideRibbon ? "Lateral / Ruído" :
     widthAtr > expansionThresh ? "Expansão sem alinhamento" :
     "Transição"

// =====================
// Visibilidade efetiva
// =====================
presetShow1 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? true  : presetMode == "Swing" ? false : presetMode == "Macro" ? false : showMA1
presetShow2 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? true  : presetMode == "Swing" ? true  : presetMode == "Macro" ? false : showMA2
presetShow3 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? true  : presetMode == "Swing" ? true  : presetMode == "Macro" ? true  : showMA3
presetShow4 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? true  : presetMode == "Swing" ? true  : presetMode == "Macro" ? true  : showMA4
presetShow5 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? false : presetMode == "Swing" ? true  : presetMode == "Macro" ? true  : showMA5
presetShow6 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? false : presetMode == "Swing" ? false : presetMode == "Macro" ? true  : showMA6

show1 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetVisibility ? showMA1 : presetShow1
show2 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetVisibility ? showMA2 : presetShow2
show3 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetVisibility ? showMA3 : presetShow3
show4 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetVisibility ? showMA4 : presetShow4
show5 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetVisibility ? showMA5 : presetShow5
show6 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetVisibility ? showMA6 : presetShow6

// =====================
// Espessura efetiva
// =====================
presetWidth1 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? 2 : presetMode == "Swing" ? 1 : presetMode == "Macro" ? 1 : widthMA1
presetWidth2 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? 2 : presetMode == "Swing" ? 2 : presetMode == "Macro" ? 1 : widthMA2
presetWidth3 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? 2 : presetMode == "Swing" ? 2 : presetMode == "Macro" ? 2 : widthMA3
presetWidth4 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? 1 : presetMode == "Swing" ? 2 : presetMode == "Macro" ? 2 : widthMA4
presetWidth5 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? 1 : presetMode == "Swing" ? 2 : presetMode == "Macro" ? 3 : widthMA5
presetWidth6 = presetMode == "Scalp" ? 1 : presetMode == "Swing" ? 1 : presetMode == "Macro" ? 3 : widthMA6

w1 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetWidth ? widthMA1 : presetWidth1
w2 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetWidth ? widthMA2 : presetWidth2
w3 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetWidth ? widthMA3 : presetWidth3
w4 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetWidth ? widthMA4 : presetWidth4
w5 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetWidth ? widthMA5 : presetWidth5
w6 = presetMode == "Custom" or overridePresetWidth ? widthMA6 : presetWidth6

// =====================
// Cálculo das médias
// =====================
ma1 = f_ma(src, len1, maType)
ma2 = f_ma(src, len2, maType)
ma3 = f_ma(src, len3, maType)
ma4 = f_ma(src, len4, maType)
ma5 = f_ma(src, len5, maType)
ma6 = f_ma(src, len6, maType)

// =====================
// Cores finais
// =====================
plotColor1 = f_resolveColor(colorMA1, ma1)
plotColor2 = f_resolveColor(colorMA2, ma2)
plotColor3 = f_resolveColor(colorMA3, ma3)
plotColor4 = f_resolveColor(colorMA4, ma4)
plotColor5 = f_resolveColor(colorMA5, ma5)
plotColor6 = f_resolveColor(colorMA6, ma6)

// =====================
// Plots
// =====================
pMA1 = plot(show1 ? ma1 : na, title="MA 1", color=plotColor1, linewidth=w1, offset=offset, display=display.all - display.status_line)
pMA2 = plot(show2 ? ma2 : na, title="MA 2", color=plotColor2, linewidth=w2, offset=offset, display=display.all - display.status_line)
pMA3 = plot(show3 ? ma3 : na, title="MA 3", color=plotColor3, linewidth=w3, offset=offset, display=display.all - display.status_line)
pMA4 = plot(show4 ? ma4 : na, title="MA 4", color=plotColor4, linewidth=w4, offset=offset, display=display.all - display.status_line)
pMA5 = plot(show5 ? ma5 : na, title="MA 5", color=plotColor5, linewidth=w5, offset=offset, display=display.all - display.status_line)
pMA6 = plot(show6 ? ma6 : na, title="MA 6", color=plotColor6, linewidth=w6, offset=offset, display=display.all - display.status_line)

// Status line enxuta: mostra apenas os períodos das médias
plot(show1 ? len1 : na, title="MA1", color=plotColor1, display=display.status_line, precision=0)
plot(show2 ? len2 : na, title="MA2", color=plotColor2, display=display.status_line, precision=0)
plot(show3 ? len3 : na, title="MA3", color=plotColor3, display=display.status_line, precision=0)
plot(show4 ? len4 : na, title="MA4", color=plotColor4, display=display.status_line, precision=0)
plot(show5 ? len5 : na, title="MA5", color=plotColor5, display=display.status_line, precision=0)
plot(show6 ? len6 : na, title="MA6", color=plotColor6, display=display.status_line, precision=0)

// =====================
// Métricas estruturais
// =====================
atr = ta.atr(atrLen)

ribbonTop = math.max(math.max(math.max(ma1, ma2), math.max(ma3, ma4)), math.max(ma5, ma6))
ribbonBot = math.min(math.min(math.min(ma1, ma2), math.min(ma3, ma4)), math.min(ma5, ma6))
ribbonMid = (ribbonTop + ribbonBot) * 0.5
ribbonWidth = ribbonTop - ribbonBot
ribbonWidthAtr = atr > 0 ? ribbonWidth / atr : na
ribbonWidthAtrPrev = nz(ribbonWidthAtr[1], ribbonWidthAtr)
distRibbonMidAtr = atr > 0 ? math.abs(close - ribbonMid) / atr : 0.0

s1 = ma1 - ma1[slopeLookback]
s2 = ma2 - ma2[slopeLookback]
s3 = ma3 - ma3[slopeLookback]
s4 = ma4 - ma4[slopeLookback]
s5 = ma5 - ma5[slopeLookback]

study(title="Moving Average Convergence/Divergence Slope", shorttitle="MACD Slope", precision=8)

fastLength = input(12, minval=1), slowLength=input(26,minval=1)
signalLength=input(9,minval=1)

scripts.source:
//@version=5
// This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
// © dman103
// My own interpretation of Multi time frame Moving averages momentum indicator with a variety of moving averages (Default EMA). The indicator checks the difference between two Moving Average and plots it as a Histogram.
// which can indicate the momentum of the current asset. The background does the same but with a higher time frame which can be set in the settings with AUTO (using Multiplier) or User-defined
// How to use the indicator?
// Histogram:
// Green: Momentum of asset is positive and increasing.
// Lighter Green: Momentum of asset is still positive but decreasing and can revert to negative momentum.
// Red: Momentum of asset is negative and increasing.
// Lighter Red: Momentum of asset is still negative but increasing and revert to positive momentum.
// Background:
// Green: HTF (Higher time frame) momentum is positive
// RED: HTF momentum is negative.
//
// Latest Script Updates:
// Added Buy/Sell Alerts. BUY alert when histogram crosses over zero line, SELL alert when histogram crosses under zero line.
// Upgrade to Pinescript v5 from v4.
// Optimized code.
// Improved settings usability. 
//
// Follow to get great upcoming updates & scripts: https://www.tradingview.com/u/dman103/#published-scripts
indicator(title='MA MTF Momentum Histogram', shorttitle='MA MTF Momentum Histogram', precision=3)

// Getting inputs
src = input(title='Source', defval=close)
ma_select = input.string(title='Moving Average Type', defval='SMMA', options=['SMA', 'EMA', 'WMA', 'HMA', 'JMA', 'TMA', 'VAMA', 'SMMA', 'DEMA', 'VMA', 'WWMA', 'EMA_NO_LAG', 'TSF'])  //DEFAULT INDICATOR EMA
fast_length = input(title='Fast Length', defval=4)  //DEFAULT INDICATOR 9
slow_length = input(title='Slow Length', defval=12)  //DEFAULT INDICATOR 12
htf_is_auto = input.string(title='Higher Timeframe Period', defval='Auto', options=['Auto', 'User Defined'], group="Higher Timeframe Main Trend (back color)")
res_multi = input.int(title='Auto Resolution Multiplier', defval=3, minval=1, group="Higher Timeframe Main Trend (back color)")
user_tf = input.timeframe(title='User Defined Timeframe', defval='120', group="Higher Timeframe Main Trend (back color)")

color_bars = input(title='Color bars', defval=false, group="Other Settings")
show_histogram = input(title='Show Histogram', defval=true, group="Other Settings")
show_lines = input(title='Show Lines', defval=true, group="Other Settings")
show_main_trend = input(title='Show main trend', defval=true, group="Other Settings")
volatility_lookback = input(title='Volatility lookback (only for VAMA)', defval=21, group="Other Settings")
///////Moving Averages
MA_selector(src, length) =>
    ma = 0.0
    if ma_select == 'SMA'
        ma := ta.sma(src, length)
        ma

    if ma_select == 'EMA'
        ma := ta.ema(src, length)
        ma

    if ma_select == 'WMA'
        ma := ta.wma(src, length)
        ma
    if ma_select == 'HMA'
        ma := ta.hma(src, length)
        ma
    if ma_select == 'JMA'
        beta = 0.45 * (length - 1) / (0.45 * (length - 1) + 2)
        alpha = beta
        tmp0 = 0.0
        tmp1 = 0.0
        tmp2 = 0.0
        tmp3 = 0.0
        tmp4 = 0.0
        tmp0 := (1 - alpha) * src + alpha * nz(tmp0[1])
        tmp1 := (src - tmp0[0]) * (1 - beta) + beta * nz(tmp1[1])
        tmp2 := tmp0[0] + tmp1[0]
        tmp3 := (tmp2[0] - nz(tmp4[1])) * (1 - alpha) * (1 - alpha) + alpha * alpha * nz(tmp3[1])
        tmp4 := nz(tmp4[1]) + tmp3[0]
        ma := tmp4
        ma
    if ma_select == 'TMA'
        ma := ta.sma(ta.sma(src, math.ceil(length / 2)), math.floor(length / 2) + 1)
        ma

    if ma_select == 'VMA'
        valpha = 2 / (length + 1)
        vud1 = src > src[1] ? src - src[1] : 0
        vdd1 = src < src[1] ? src[1] - src : 0
        vUD = math.sum(vud1, 9)
        vDD = math.sum(vdd1, 9)
        vCMO = nz((vUD - vDD) / (vUD + vDD))
        VAR = 0.0
        VAR := nz(valpha * math.abs(vCMO) * src) + (1 - valpha * math.abs(vCMO)) * nz(VAR[1])
        ma := VAR
        ma

    if ma_select == 'WWMA'
        wwalpha = 1 / length
        WWMA = 0.0
        WWMA := wwalpha * src + (1 - wwalpha) * nz(WWMA[1])
        ma := WWMA
        ma

    if ma_select == 'EMA_NO_LAG'
        EMA1 = ta.ema(src, length)
        EMA2 = ta.ema(EMA1, length)
        Difference = EMA1 - EMA2
        ma := EMA1 + Difference
        ma

    if ma_select == 'TSF'
        lrc = ta.linreg(src, length, 0)
        lrc1 = ta.linreg(src, length, 1)
        lrs = lrc - lrc1
        TSF = ta.linreg(src, length, 0) + lrs
        ma := TSF
        ma

    if ma_select == 'VAMA'  // Volatility Adjusted from @fractured
        mid = ta.ema(src, length)
        dev = src - mid
        vol_up = ta.highest(dev, volatility_lookback)
        vol_down = ta.lowest(dev, volatility_lookback)
        ma := mid + math.avg(vol_up, vol_down)
        ma
    if ma_select == 'SMMA'
        smma = float(0.0)
        smaval = ta.sma(src, length)
        smma := na(smma[1]) ? smaval : (smma[1] * (length - 1) + src) / length
        ma := smma
        ma

    if ma_select == 'DEMA'
        e1 = ta.ema(src, length)
        e2 = ta.ema(e1, length)
        ma := 2 * e1 - e2
        ma
    ma
f_multiple_resolution(_mult) =>
    target_Res_In_Min = timeframe.multiplier * _mult * (timeframe.isseconds ? 1. / 60. : timeframe.isminutes ? 1. : timeframe.isdaily ? 1440. : timeframe.isweekly ? 7. * 24. * 60. : timeframe.ismonthly ? 30.417 * 24. * 60. : na)

    target_Res_In_Min <= 0.0417 ? '1S' : target_Res_In_Min <= 0.167 ? '5S' : target_Res_In_Min <= 0.376 ? '15S' : target_Res_In_Min <= 0.751 ? '30S' : target_Res_In_Min <= 1440 ? str.tostring(math.round(target_Res_In_Min)) : str.tostring(math.round(math.min(target_Res_In_Min / 1440, 365))) + 'D'
res = htf_is_auto == 'Auto' ? f_multiple_resolution(res_multi) : user_tf

//  Colors
col_grow_above = #26A69A
col_grow_below = #FFCDD2
col_fall_above = #AAFFDB
col_fall_below = #EF5350

fast_ma = MA_selector(src, fast_length)
slow_ma = MA_selector(src, slow_length)

ma_diff = fast_ma - slow_ma

outma_diff = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, res, ma_diff[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
bcnt = 0
bcnt := ta.change(time(res)) != 0 ? 1 : nz(bcnt[1]) + 1
//Base MA Momentum
hist_color = ma_diff >= 0 ? ma_diff[1] < ma_diff ? col_grow_above : col_fall_above : ma_diff[1] < ma_diff ? col_grow_below : col_fall_below
plot(show_histogram ? ma_diff :  na, title='ma_diff', color= hist_color, style=plot.style_columns, linewidth=3)
plot(show_lines ? ma_diff: na, color=hist_color, linewidth=2)
//HTF MA Momentum for main trend
hist_color2 = outma_diff >= 0 ? nz(outma_diff[bcnt]) < outma_diff ? col_grow_above : col_fall_above : nz(outma_diff[bcnt]) < outma_diff ? col_grow_below : col_fall_below
bgcolor(show_main_trend ? outma_diff >= 0 ? color.new(color.green,93) : color.new(color.red,93) : na)
plot(0, color= color.new(color.blue,35))
plot(ma_diff >= 0 ? 1 : ma_diff < 0 ? -1 : na, display=display.none, title='Signal 1 or -1')
barcolor(color_bars ? hist_color : na)
long_alert = (ma_diff>=0 and ma_diff[1]<0)
short_alert = (ma_diff<=0 and ma_diff[1]>0)
alertcondition(long_alert, title='MTF Momentum Buy Signal', message='Buy Signal')
alertcondition(short_alert, title='MTF Momentum Sell Signal', message='Sell Signal')

scripts.source:
//@version=6
indicator("Market Structure (HH/HL/LH/LL) [Minimal]", shorttitle="Structure Minimal", overlay=true, max_labels_count=100)

// =====================================================
// Inputs
// =====================================================
groupPivot = "Pivot Settings"
leftBars   = input.int(3, "Pivot Left", minval=1, group=groupPivot)
rightBars  = input.int(3, "Pivot Right", minval=1, group=groupPivot)

groupView = "Display"
showSwingLabels = input.bool(false, "Show Swing Labels (HH/HL/LH/LL)", group=groupView)
showPanel       = input.bool(true, "Show Structure Panel", group=groupView)
panelPos        = input.string("Top Right", "Panel Position", options=["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left"], group=groupView)

groupLogic = "Logic"
rangeTolerancePct = input.float(0.10, "Range Tolerance (%)", minval=0.0, step=0.01, tooltip="Tolerance used to avoid classifying tiny differences as HH/LH/HL/LL", group=groupLogic)

// =====================================================
// Helpers
// =====================================================
f_table_pos(_pos) =>
    _pos == "Top Left" ? position.top_left :
     _pos == "Bottom Right" ? position.bottom_right :
     _pos == "Bottom Left" ? position.bottom_left :
     position.bottom_right

f_classify_high(curr, prev, tolPct) =>
    // Returns "HH" or "LH" (or "H?" if prev not available)
    na(prev) ? "H?" : (curr > prev * (1.0 + tolPct / 100.0) ? "HH" : "LH")

f_classify_low(curr, prev, tolPct) =>
    // Returns "HL" or "LL" (or "L?" if prev not available)
    na(prev) ? "L?" : (curr > prev * (1.0 + tolPct / 100.0) ? "HL" : "LL")

// =====================================================
// Pivot detection
// =====================================================
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, leftBars, rightBars)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, leftBars, rightBars)

phBarIndex = bar_index - rightBars
plBarIndex = bar_index - rightBars

// =====================================================
// Swing memory
// =====================================================
var float lastHigh = na
var float prevHigh = na
var float lastLow  = na
var float prevLow  = na

var int   lastHighBar = na
var int   prevHighBar = na
var int   lastLowBar  = na
var int   prevLowBar  = na

var string lastHighType = "H?"
var string lastLowType  = "L?"

// Update highs
if not na(ph)
    prevHigh    := lastHigh
    prevHighBar := lastHighBar
    lastHigh    := ph
    lastHighBar := phBarIndex
    lastHighType := f_classify_high(lastHigh, prevHigh, rangeTolerancePct)

    if showSwingLabels
        label.new(
             phBarIndex, ph,
             text=lastHighType,
             style=label.style_label_down,
             textcolor=color.white,
             color=lastHighType == "HH" ? color.new(color.green, 0) : color.new(color.red, 0),
             size=size.tiny)

// Update lows
if not na(pl)
    prevLow    := lastLow
    prevLowBar := lastLowBar
    lastLow    := pl
    lastLowBar := plBarIndex
    lastLowType := f_classify_low(lastLow, prevLow, rangeTolerancePct)

    if showSwingLabels
        label.new(
             plBarIndex, pl,
             text=lastLowType,
             style=label.style_label_up,
             textcolor=color.white,
             color=lastLowType == "HL" ? color.new(color.green, 0) : color.new(color.red, 0),
             size=size.tiny)

// =====================================================
// Structure state
// =====================================================
// We classify structure from the latest known high/low swing types.
// UP    => HH + HL
// DOWN  => LH + LL
// TRANS => mixed but directional conflict
// RANGE => insufficient data or noisy/flat behavior
var string structState = "RANGE"

haveHighInfo = (lastHighType == "HH" or lastHighType == "LH")
haveLowInfo  = (lastLowType == "HL" or lastLowType == "LL")

if haveHighInfo and haveLowInfo
    if lastHighType == "HH" and lastLowType == "HL"
        structState := "UP"
    else if lastHighType == "LH" and lastLowType == "LL"
        structState := "DOWN"
    else
        structState := "TRANS"
else
    structState := "RANGE"

// =====================================================
// Optional plot markers (very light) - FIXED
// =====================================================
plot(ph, title="Pivot High", style=plot.style_circles, linewidth=1, color=color.new(color.red, 65), display=display.none)
plot(pl, title="Pivot Low",  style=plot.style_circles, linewidth=1, color=color.new(color.green, 65), display=display.none)

// =====================================================
// Panel
// =====================================================
var table panel = na
if showPanel and na(panel)
    panel := table.new(f_table_pos(panelPos), 1, 5, border_width=1)

if showPanel and not na(panel)
    // Pick color by state
    stateBg =
         structState == "UP"   ? color.new(color.green, 78) :
         structState == "DOWN" ? color.new(color.red, 78) :
         structState == "TRANS"? color.new(color.orange, 78) :
                                 color.new(color.gray, 82)

    stateTxt =
         structState == "UP"   ? "UP (HH/HL)" :
         structState == "DOWN" ? "DOWN (LH/LL)" :
         structState == "TRANS"? "TRANSITION" :
                                 "RANGE"

    table.cell(panel, 0, 0, "STRUCTURE", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0))
    table.cell(panel, 0, 1, stateTxt, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=stateBg)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 2, "High Swing: " + lastHighType, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0))
    table.cell(panel, 0, 3, "Low Swing: " + lastLowType,  text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0))
    table.cell(panel, 0, 4, "Pivot " + str.tostring(leftBars) + "/" + str.tostring(rightBars), text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 0))

// =====================================================
// Alerts (optional, already padronizados)
// =====================================================
isUp    = structState == "UP"
isDown  = structState == "DOWN"
isTrans = structState == "TRANS"
isRange = structState == "RANGE"

upFlip    = isUp and structState[1] != "UP"
downFlip  = isDown and structState[1] != "DOWN"
transFlip = isTrans and structState[1] != "TRANS"
rangeFlip = isRange and structState[1] != "RANGE"

alertcondition(upFlip,    title="STRUCT UP",    message="STRUCT | UP | HH/HL")
alertcondition(downFlip,  title="STRUCT DOWN",  message="STRUCT | DOWN | LH/LL")
alertcondition(transFlip, title="STRUCT TRANS", message="STRUCT | TRANSITION")
alertcondition(rangeFlip, title="STRUCT RANGE", message="STRUCT | RANGE")

// © JuanDeNogoya

//@version=6
indicator('Market Structure MTF [HH/HL/LH/LL + CHoCH + BOS]', overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
//                                  INPUTS
// ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░

pivotLen = input.int(5, 'Pivot Length', minval = 2, maxval = 50, group = 'Structure Settings', 
             tooltip = 'Number of bars on each side to confirm a pivot. Higher = less sensitive.')

// Multi-Timeframe
useMTF = input.bool(false, 'Show HTF Structure', group = 'Multi-Timeframe', 
             tooltip = 'Display structure from a higher timeframe')
htfRes = input.timeframe('D', 'HTF Timeframe', group = 'Multi-Timeframe', 
             tooltip = 'Select the higher timeframe to analyze')

// Visualization
showLocal = input.bool(true, 'Show Local Structure', group = 'Visualization', 
             tooltip = 'Display structure of the current timeframe')
bosBuffer = input.int(1, 'BOS Buffer (bars)', minval = 1, maxval = 20, group = 'Filters', 
             tooltip = 'Minimum bars between BOS signals to avoid repetition in consolidation')

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
//                           LOCAL TIMEFRAME LOGIC
// ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Pivot Detection
phLocal = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLen, pivotLen)
plLocal = ta.pivotlow(low, pivotLen, pivotLen)

// State Variables
var float lastPH = na
var float lastPL = na
var int trend = 0
var int lastBosBar = 0
var int lastBosDir = 0

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// BOS Crossover/Crossunder - MUST BE OUTSIDE CONDITIONAL BLOCKS
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
crossOverLastPH = ta.crossover(close, nz(lastPH))
crossUnderLastPL = ta.crossunder(close, nz(lastPL))

// Process Local Structure
if showLocal
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // PIVOT HIGH CLASSIFICATION
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if not na(phLocal)
        string labelText = ''
        color labelColor = color.gray

        if na(lastPH)
            labelText := 'PH'
            labelColor := color.gray
        else if phLocal > lastPH
            labelText := 'HH'
            labelColor := color.green
            if trend == -1
                labelText := 'CHoCH'
                labelColor := color.orange
            trend := 1
        else
            labelText := 'LH'
            labelColor := color.red
            if trend == 1
                labelText := 'CHoCH'
                labelColor := color.orange
            trend := -1

        label.new(bar_index - pivotLen, phLocal, labelText, 
                  style = label.style_label_down, 
                  color = labelColor, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.small)

        lastPH := phLocal

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // PIVOT LOW CLASSIFICATION
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if not na(plLocal)
        string labelText = ''
        color labelColor = color.gray

        if na(lastPL)
            labelText := 'PL'
            labelColor := color.gray
        else if plLocal > lastPL
            labelText := 'HL'
            labelColor := color.green
        else
            labelText := 'LL'
            labelColor := color.red

        label.new(bar_index - pivotLen, plLocal, labelText, 
                  style = label.style_label_up, 
                  color = labelColor, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.small)

        lastPL := plLocal

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // BOS DETECTION WITH ANTI-REPETITION
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    bosUp = trend == 1 and not na(lastPH) and crossOverLastPH
    bosDown = trend == -1 and not na(lastPL) and crossUnderLastPL

    canShowBosUp = bosUp and bar_index - lastBosBar >= bosBuffer and (lastBosDir != 1 or close > lastPH * 1.001)
    canShowBosDown = bosDown and bar_index - lastBosBar >= bosBuffer and (lastBosDir != -1 or close < lastPL * 0.999)

    if canShowBosUp
        label.new(bar_index, high, 'BOS', 
                  style = label.style_label_down, 
                  color = color.blue, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.tiny)
        lastBosBar := bar_index
        lastBosDir := 1

    if canShowBosDown
        label.new(bar_index, low, 'BOS', 
                  style = label.style_label_up, 
                  color = color.blue, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.tiny)
        lastBosBar := bar_index
        lastBosDir := -1

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
//                         HIGHER TIMEFRAME LOGIC
// ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// HTF Data Requests (must be outside conditional blocks)
htfHigh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfRes, high)
htfLow = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfRes, low)
htfClose = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfRes, close)

phHTF = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfRes, ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLen, pivotLen))
plHTF = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htfRes, ta.pivotlow(low, pivotLen, pivotLen))

// HTF State Variables
var float htfLastPH = na
var float htfLastPL = na
var int htfTrend = 0
var int htfLastBosBar = 0
var int htfLastBosDir = 0

// Detect new HTF pivots
newHTFPivotHigh = not na(phHTF) and (na(phHTF[1]) or phHTF != phHTF[1])
newHTFPivotLow = not na(plHTF) and (na(plHTF[1]) or plHTF != plHTF[1])

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// HTF BOS Crossover/Crossunder - MUST BE OUTSIDE CONDITIONAL BLOCKS
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
htfCrossOverLastPH = ta.crossover(htfClose, nz(htfLastPH))
htfCrossUnderLastPL = ta.crossunder(htfClose, nz(htfLastPL))

// Process HTF Structure (only if enabled)
if useMTF
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // HTF PIVOT HIGH CLASSIFICATION
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if newHTFPivotHigh
        string labelText = ''
        color labelColor = color.gray

        if na(htfLastPH)
            labelText := 'PH'
            labelColor := color.purple
        else if phHTF > htfLastPH
            labelText := 'HH'
            labelColor := color.teal
            if htfTrend == -1
                labelText := 'CHoCH'
                labelColor := color.yellow
            htfTrend := 1
        else
            labelText := 'LH'
            labelColor := color.maroon
            if htfTrend == 1
                labelText := 'CHoCH'
                labelColor := color.yellow
            htfTrend := -1

        label.new(bar_index, phHTF, '(' + htfRes + ') ' + labelText, 
                  style = label.style_label_down, 
                  color = labelColor, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.normal)

        line.new(bar_index - 50, phHTF, bar_index, phHTF, 
                 color = labelColor, 
                 style = line.style_dashed, 
                 width = 1)

        htfLastPH := phHTF

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // HTF PIVOT LOW CLASSIFICATION
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if newHTFPivotLow
        string labelText = ''
        color labelColor = color.gray

        if na(htfLastPL)
            labelText := 'PL'
            labelColor := color.purple
        else if plHTF > htfLastPL
            labelText := 'HL'
            labelColor := color.teal
        else
            labelText := 'LL'
            labelColor := color.maroon

        label.new(bar_index, plHTF, '(' + htfRes + ') ' + labelText, 
                  style = label.style_label_up, 
                  color = labelColor, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.normal)

        line.new(bar_index - 50, plHTF, bar_index, plHTF, 
                 color = labelColor, 
                 style = line.style_dashed, 
                 width = 1)

        htfLastPL := plHTF

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // HTF BOS DETECTION
    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    htfBosUp = htfTrend == 1 and not na(htfLastPH) and htfCrossOverLastPH
    htfBosDown = htfTrend == -1 and not na(htfLastPL) and htfCrossUnderLastPL

    canShowHTFBosUp = htfBosUp and bar_index - htfLastBosBar >= bosBuffer and htfLastBosDir != 1
    canShowHTFBosDown = htfBosDown and bar_index - htfLastBosBar >= bosBuffer and htfLastBosDir != -1

    if canShowHTFBosUp
        label.new(bar_index, high, '(' + htfRes + ') BOS', 
                  style = label.style_label_down, 
                  color = color.navy, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.small)
        htfLastBosBar := bar_index
        htfLastBosDir := 1

    if canShowHTFBosDown
        label.new(bar_index, low, '(' + htfRes + ') BOS', 
                  style = label.style_label_up, 
                  color = color.navy, 
                  textcolor = color.white, 
                  size = size.small)
        htfLastBosBar := bar_index
        htfLastBosDir := -1

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// END OF SCRIPT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
