//Created by TheMightyChicken
//Based on Larry Connors RSI-2 Strategy - Lower RSI edited by ChrisMoody
study(title="Marsi Strategy [TheMightyChicken]", shorttitle="MarsiStrategy", overlay=false)
src = close, 
//RSI Code
up = rma(max(change(src),0),2)
down = rma(-min(change(src),0),2)
rsi = down==0 ? 100 : up==0 ? 0 : 100 - (100/(1+up/down))
//MA Code
ma5 = sma(close,5)
ma200= sma(close,200)
//Color Code
col = close>ma200 and close<ma5 and rsi<10 ? red : close<ma200 and close>ma5 and rsi>90 ? green : silver
//Graphics Code
line100 = plot(100, title="Upper Line 100",style=line, linewidth=1, color=silver)
line90 = plot(90, title="Lower Line 90",style=line, linewidth=1, color=silver)
line10 = plot(10, title="Upper Line 10",style=line, linewidth=1, color=silver)
line0 = plot(0, title="Lower Line 0",style=line, linewidth=1, color=silver)
fill(line90, line10, black, transp=95)
plot(rsi, title="RSI Line", style=line, linewidth=2,color=col)
plot(rsi, title="RSI Dots", style=circles, linewidth=3,color=col)

scripts.name: .[Moving Average Shift]

metadata.scriptName: .[Moving Average Shift]

scripts.source:
// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// Original concept © ChartPrime
// Optimized adaptation for trend/structure/probability reading

//@version=6
indicator("Moving Average Shift Optimized v1.1", "MA Shift Opt v1.1", overlay=false)

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Inputs
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
groupMA = "MA"
typeMA  = input.string("SMA", "Type", options=["SMA", "EMA", "SMMA (RMA)", "WMA", "VWMA"], group=groupMA, display=display.none)
maLen   = input.int(40, "Length", minval=1, inline="ma", group=groupMA, display=display.none)
src     = input.source(hl2, "", inline="ma", group=groupMA, display=display.none)

// Oscillator
groupOsc = "MA Shift Oscillator"
oscLen         = input.int(15, "Length", minval=1, inline="osc", group=groupOsc, display=display.none)
oscThreshold   = input.float(0.5, "Threshold", step=0.1, inline="osc", group=groupOsc, display=display.none)
showSignals    = input.bool(true, "⯁", inline="osc", group=groupOsc, display=display.none)
percentileLen  = input.int(500, "Percentile lookback", minval=50, group=groupOsc, display=display.none)
percentilePct  = input.float(97.5, "Percentile", minval=50.0, maxval=99.9, step=0.5, group=groupOsc, display=display.none)
oscSmoothLen   = input.int(10, "Osc smoothing", minval=1, group=groupOsc, display=display.none)
signalMode     = input.string("Original", "Signal mode", options=["Original", "Zero Cross", "Linha de sinal"], group=groupOsc, display=display.none)
signalLen      = input.int(5, "Signal line length", minval=1, group=groupOsc, display=display.none)

// Trend filters
groupTrend = "Trend / Probability"
useDirectionalFilter = input.bool(true, "Directional filter", group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
useSlopeFilter       = input.bool(true, "MA slope filter", group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
slopeLen             = input.int(3, "Slope lookback", minval=1, group=groupTrend, display=display.none)
useSetupFilter       = input.bool(true, "Setup filter", group=groupTrend,
     tooltip="When enabled, visual signals only print when trend + oscillator state are aligned.", display=display.none)

// Visual
groupVisual = "Visual"
paintBars    = input.bool(true, "Paint bars", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
paintCandles = input.bool(true, "Paint candles", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showMABand   = input.bool(true, "Show MA glow", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)
showSignalLn = input.bool(false, "Show signal line", group=groupVisual, display=display.none)

// Colors
groupColor = "Colors"
oscColUp1   = input.color(#1dd1c2, "Alta acelerando", inline="c1", group=groupColor, display=display.none)
oscColUp2   = input.color(#17a297, "Alta sustentada",  inline="c1", group=groupColor, display=display.none)
oscColDn1   = input.color(color.yellow, "Baixa acelerando", inline="c2", group=groupColor, display=display.none)
oscColDn2   = input.color(color.orange, "Baixa sustentada",  inline="c2", group=groupColor, display=display.none)
neutralCol  = input.color(color.gray, "Neutro", group=groupColor, display=display.none)

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Functions
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
maCalc(_src, _len, _type) =>
    switch _type
        "SMA"        => ta.sma(_src, _len)
        "EMA"        => ta.ema(_src, _len)
        "SMMA (RMA)" => ta.rma(_src, _len)
        "WMA"        => ta.wma(_src, _len)
        => ta.vwma(_src, _len)

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Core calculations
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
maBase = maCalc(src, maLen, typeMA)
maSlope = maBase - maBase[slopeLen]

trendBull = src > maBase and (not useSlopeFilter or maSlope > 0)
trendBear = src < maBase and (not useSlopeFilter or maSlope < 0)
trendNeutral = not trendBull and not trendBear

maPaintColor = trendBull ? oscColUp2 : trendBear ? oscColDn2 : neutralCol

// Normalize by percentile of absolute distance to reduce sign distortions
maDiff = src - maBase
absPercRaw = ta.percentile_linear_interpolation(math.abs(maDiff), percentileLen, percentilePct)
absPercSafe = math.max(nz(absPercRaw, 0.0), syminfo.mintick)
normDiff = maDiff / absPercSafe

osc = ta.hma(ta.change(normDiff, oscLen), oscSmoothLen)
oscSignal = ta.ema(osc, signalLen)

oscCol = osc > 0 ? (osc > osc[1] ? oscColUp1 : oscColUp2) : osc < 0 ? (osc < osc[1] ? oscColDn1 : oscColDn2) : neutralCol

probBull = trendBull and osc > 0 and osc > osc[1]
probBear = trendBear and osc < 0 and osc < osc[1]
setupBull = trendBull and osc > 0
setupBear = trendBear and osc < 0

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Signals
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
origUp = ta.crossover(osc, osc[2]) and osc < -oscThreshold
origDn = ta.crossunder(osc, osc[2]) and osc > oscThreshold
zeroUp = ta.crossover(osc, 0.0)
zeroDn = ta.crossunder(osc, 0.0)
lineUp = ta.crossover(osc, oscSignal) and osc < 0
lineDn = ta.crossunder(osc, oscSignal) and osc > 0

sigUpRaw = switch signalMode
    "Original"   => origUp
    "Zero Cross" => zeroUp
    => lineUp

sigDnRaw = switch signalMode
    "Original"   => origDn
    "Zero Cross" => zeroDn
    => lineDn

sigUp = sigUpRaw
sigDn = sigDnRaw

if useDirectionalFilter
    sigUp := sigUp and trendBull
    sigDn := sigDn and trendBear

if useSetupFilter
    sigUp := sigUp and setupBull
    sigDn := sigDn and setupBear

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Visuals
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot(maBase, "Base MA", color=maPaintColor, force_overlay=true, linewidth=2, display=display.all - display.status_line)
plot(showMABand ? maBase : na, "Base MA Glow", color=color.new(maPaintColor, 80), force_overlay=true, linewidth=7, display=display.all - display.status_line)

barcolor(paintBars ? maPaintColor : na)
plotcandle(
     paintCandles ? open : na,
     paintCandles ? high : na,
     paintCandles ? low  : na,
     paintCandles ? close : na,
     title="Candles de tendência",
     color=maPaintColor,
     wickcolor=maPaintColor,
     bordercolor=maPaintColor,
     force_overlay=true)

plot(osc, "Impulso MA Shift", style=plot.style_columns, color=oscCol)
plot(showSignalLn and signalMode == "Linha de sinal" ? oscSignal : na, "Linha de sinal", color=color.new(color.white, 0), linewidth=2)

pTop  = plot(oscThreshold, "Corte superior", display=display.none, editable=false)
pZero = plot(0, "Zero", display=display.none, editable=false)
pBot  = plot(-oscThreshold, "Corte inferior", display=display.none, editable=false)
fill(pTop, pZero, color=color.new(oscCol, 85))
fill(pBot, pZero, color=color.new(oscCol, 85))

plotshape(showSignals and sigUp, "Sinal C", shape.diamond, location.belowbar, oscColUp1, force_overlay=true, size=size.tiny, text="C", display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plotshape(showSignals and sigDn, "Sinal V", shape.diamond, location.abovebar, oscColDn1, force_overlay=true, size=size.tiny, text="V", display=display.pane + display.data_window)

// Probability guides in oscillator pane
plot(probBull ? osc : na, "Força provável C", color=color.new(oscColUp1, 0), linewidth=3, display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plot(probBear ? osc : na, "Força provável V", color=color.new(oscColDn1, 0), linewidth=3, display=display.pane + display.data_window)

// State markers for easier reading without polluting entries
plotchar(setupBull, "Tendência C", "▲", location.top, color.new(oscColUp2, 0), size=size.tiny, display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plotchar(setupBear, "Tendência V", "▼", location.bottom, color.new(oscColDn2, 0), size=size.tiny, display=display.pane + display.data_window)

//@version=5
indicator(title="Pinbar Indicator", shorttitle="Pinbar", overlay=true, max_bars_back=1000, max_lines_count=400, max_labels_count=400)

to_floatstr(x) =>

if pinbar_type == -1 and pinbar_strength >= min_strength and draw_pinbar

scripts.source:
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © Mohamed3nan

//@version=4

study(title="Pivots High Low (HH/HL/LH/LL)/Trend [Anan] ",shorttitle="Pivots HL/Trend [Anan]", overlay = true)

Period = input(defval = 2 , title="Pivot Point Period", minval = 1)
showPP = input(defval = true, title="Show Pivot Points Labels")
showLabels = input(defval = false, title="Show Bull/Bear Labels")
showCL = input(defval = true, title="Show PP Center Line")
showSR = input(defval = true, title="Show Support/Resistance Level Extensions")
ShowFB = input(true, title="Show Fractal Break Arrows")

/////////////////////////////////
float pivotHigh = na
float pivotLow = na
pivotHigh := pivothigh(Period, Period)
pivotLow := pivotlow(Period, Period)
/////////////////////////////////
// Higher Highs, Lower Highs, Higher Lows, Lower Lows  //
valuewhen_1 = valuewhen(pivotHigh, high[Period], 1)
valuewhen_2 = valuewhen(pivotHigh, high[Period], 0)
higherhigh = na(pivotHigh) ? na : valuewhen_1 < valuewhen_2 ? pivotHigh : na
valuewhen_3 = valuewhen(pivotHigh, high[Period], 1)
valuewhen_4 = valuewhen(pivotHigh, high[Period], 0)
lowerhigh = na(pivotHigh) ? na : valuewhen_3 > valuewhen_4 ? pivotHigh : na
valuewhen_5 = valuewhen(pivotLow, low[Period], 1)
valuewhen_6 = valuewhen(pivotLow, low[Period ], 0)
higherlow = na(pivotLow) ? na : valuewhen_5 < valuewhen_6 ? pivotLow : na
valuewhen_7 = valuewhen(pivotLow, low[Period], 1)
valuewhen_8 = valuewhen(pivotLow, low[Period ], 0)
lowerlow = na(pivotLow) ? na : valuewhen_7 > valuewhen_8 ? pivotLow : na
// Higher Highs, Lower Highs, Higher Lows, Lower Lows  //
/////////////////////////////////
plotshape(showPP ? higherhigh  : na, title='HH', style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.green,50), text="HH",textcolor=color.new(color.green,50),offset = -Period)
plotshape(showPP ? higherlow  : na, title='HL', style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.green,50), text="HL",textcolor=color.new(color.green,50),offset = -Period)
plotshape(showPP ? lowerhigh  : na, title='LH', style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red,50), text="LH",textcolor=color.new(color.red,50),offset = -Period)
plotshape(showPP ? lowerlow  : na, title='LL', style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red,50), text="LL",textcolor=color.new(color.red,50),offset = -Period)
/////////////////////////////////


/////////////////////////////////
float center = na
center := center[1]
float lastpp = pivotHigh ? pivotHigh : pivotLow ? pivotLow : na
if lastpp
    if na(center)
        center := lastpp
    else
        center := (center + center + lastpp) / 3


plot(showCL ? center : na, color = showCL ? center < hl2 ? color.new(color.teal,25) : color.new(color.red,25) : na,title="Center Line",style=plot.style_stepline,linewidth=2)
/////////////////////////////////

float resistance = na
float support = na
support := pivotLow ? pivotLow : support[1]
resistance := pivotHigh ? pivotHigh : resistance[1]

plot(showSR and support ? support : na, color = showSR and support ? color.new(color.teal,50) : na, style = plot.style_circles, offset = -Period)
plot(showSR and resistance ? resistance : na, color = showSR and resistance ? color.new(color.red,50) : na, style = plot.style_circles, offset = -Period)


/////////////////////////////////
bsignal = close>center[1] and close[1]<center[2]
ssignal = close<center[1] and close[1]>center[2]
plotshape(bsignal and showLabels ? center[1] : na, title="Bull", text="Bull", location = location.belowbar, style = shape.labelup, size = size.tiny, color = color.teal, textcolor = color.white, transp = 50)
plotshape(ssignal and showLabels ? center[1] : na, title="Bear", text="Bear", location = location.abovebar, style = shape.labeldown, size = size.tiny, color = color.red, textcolor = color.white, transp = 50)
/////////////////////////////////

//  Fractal Break Alerts
pvthis = 0.0
pvtlos = 0.0
pvthis := na(pivotHigh) ? pvthis[1] : high[Period]
pvtlos := na(pivotLow) ? pvtlos[1] : low[Period]

bull = false
bear = false
bull  := close>pvthis and open<=pvthis 
bear := close<pvtlos and open>=pvtlos 

plotshape(ShowFB and bull?1:na, title="BUY Arrow", color=color.green, style=shape.triangleup,location =location.belowbar)
plotshape(ShowFB and bear?-1:na, title="SELL Arrow", color=color.red, style=shape.triangledown,location =location.abovebar)
/////////////////////////////////

// Alerts//
alertcondition(bull or bear,title="Fractal Break Arrow",message="Alert")
alertcondition(bull,title="Fractal Break BULL",message="BULL")
alertcondition(bear,title="Fractal Break BEAR",message="BEAR")

scripts.source:
//@version=4
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © KivancOzbilgic
//developer: @KivancOzbilgic
//author: @KivancOzbilgic

study("Profit Maximizer","PMax", overlay=true, format=format.price, precision=2, resolution="")
src = input(hl2, title="Source")
Periods = input(title="ATR Length", type=input.integer, defval=10)
Multiplier = input(title="ATR Multiplier", type=input.float, step=0.1, defval=3.0)
mav = input(title="Moving Average Type", defval="EMA", options=["SMA", "EMA", "WMA", "TMA", "VAR", "WWMA", "ZLEMA", "TSF"])
length =input(10, "Moving Average Length", minval=1)
changeATR= input(title="Change ATR Calculation Method ?", type=input.bool, defval=true)
Normalize= input(title="Normalize ATR ?", type=input.bool, defval=false)
showsupport = input(title="Show Moving Average?", type=input.bool, defval=true)
showsignalsk = input(title="Show Crossing Signals?", type=input.bool, defval=true)
showsignalsc = input(title="Show Price/Pmax Crossing Signals?", type=input.bool, defval=false)
highlighting = input(title="Highlighter On/Off ?", type=input.bool, defval=true)
atr2 = sma(tr, Periods)
atr= changeATR ? atr(Periods) : atr2
valpha=2/(length+1)
vud1=src>src[1] ? src-src[1] : 0
vdd1=src<src[1] ? src[1]-src : 0
vUD=sum(vud1,9)
vDD=sum(vdd1,9)
vCMO=nz((vUD-vDD)/(vUD+vDD))
VAR=0.0
VAR:=nz(valpha*abs(vCMO)*src)+(1-valpha*abs(vCMO))*nz(VAR[1])
wwalpha = 1/ length
WWMA = 0.0
WWMA := wwalpha*src + (1-wwalpha)*nz(WWMA[1])
zxLag = length/2==round(length/2) ? length/2 : (length - 1) / 2
zxEMAData = (src + (src - src[zxLag]))
ZLEMA = ema(zxEMAData, length)
lrc = linreg(src, length, 0)
lrc1 = linreg(src,length,1)
lrs = (lrc-lrc1)
TSF = linreg(src, length, 0)+lrs
getMA(src, length) =>
    ma = 0.0
    if mav == "SMA"
        ma := sma(src, length)
        ma

    if mav == "EMA"
        ma := ema(src, length)
        ma

    if mav == "WMA"
        ma := wma(src, length)
        ma

    if mav == "TMA"
        ma := sma(sma(src, ceil(length / 2)), floor(length / 2) + 1)
        ma

    if mav == "VAR"
        ma := VAR
        ma

    if mav == "WWMA"
        ma := WWMA
        ma

    if mav == "ZLEMA"
        ma := ZLEMA
        ma

    if mav == "TSF"
        ma := TSF
        ma
    ma
    
MAvg=getMA(src, length)
longStop = Normalize ? MAvg - Multiplier*atr/close : MAvg - Multiplier*atr
longStopPrev = nz(longStop[1], longStop)
longStop := MAvg > longStopPrev ? max(longStop, longStopPrev) : longStop
shortStop = Normalize ? MAvg + Multiplier*atr/close : MAvg + Multiplier*atr
shortStopPrev = nz(shortStop[1], shortStop)
shortStop := MAvg < shortStopPrev ? min(shortStop, shortStopPrev) : shortStop
dir = 1
dir := nz(dir[1], dir)
dir := dir == -1 and MAvg > shortStopPrev ? 1 : dir == 1 and MAvg < longStopPrev ? -1 : dir
PMax = dir==1 ? longStop: shortStop
plot(showsupport ? MAvg : na, color=#0585E1, linewidth=2, title="Moving Avg Line")
pALL=plot(PMax, color=color.red, linewidth=2, title="PMax", transp=0)
alertcondition(cross(MAvg, PMax), title="Cross Alert", message="PMax - Moving Avg Crossing!")
alertcondition(crossover(MAvg, PMax), title="Crossover Alarm", message="Moving Avg BUY SIGNAL!")
alertcondition(crossunder(MAvg, PMax), title="Crossunder Alarm", message="Moving Avg SELL SIGNAL!")
alertcondition(cross(src, PMax), title="Price Cross Alert", message="PMax - Price Crossing!")
alertcondition(crossover(src, PMax), title="Price Crossover Alarm", message="PRICE OVER PMax - BUY SIGNAL!")
alertcondition(crossunder(src, PMax), title="Price Crossunder Alarm", message="PRICE UNDER PMax - SELL SIGNAL!")
buySignalk = crossover(MAvg, PMax)
plotshape(buySignalk and showsignalsk ? PMax*0.995 : na, title="Buy", text="Buy", location=location.absolute, style=shape.labelup, size=size.tiny, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, transp=0)
sellSignallk = crossunder(MAvg, PMax)
plotshape(sellSignallk and showsignalsk ? PMax*1.005 : na, title="Sell", text="Sell", location=location.absolute, style=shape.labeldown, size=size.tiny, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, transp=0)
buySignalc = crossover(src, PMax)
plotshape(buySignalc and showsignalsc ? PMax*0.995 : na, title="Buy", text="Buy", location=location.absolute, style=shape.labelup, size=size.tiny, color=#0F18BF, textcolor=color.white, transp=0)
sellSignallc = crossunder(src, PMax)
plotshape(sellSignallc and showsignalsc ? PMax*1.005 : na, title="Sell", text="Sell", location=location.absolute, style=shape.labeldown, size=size.tiny, color=#0F18BF, textcolor=color.white, transp=0)
mPlot = plot(ohlc4, title="", style=plot.style_circles, linewidth=0,display=display.none)
longFillColor = highlighting ? (MAvg>PMax ? color.green : na) : na
shortFillColor = highlighting ? (MAvg<PMax ? color.red : na) : na
fill(mPlot, pALL, title="UpTrend Highligter", color=longFillColor)
fill(mPlot, pALL, title="DownTrend Highligter", color=shortFillColor)

metadata.scriptTitle: Volume with Market Buy/Sell and Neutral Volume Split for Realtime Bars

scripts.source:
//@version=6
//@the_MarketWhisperer
//Based on Pinecoders' codebase

// What is it?
// A tool that shows Real-time Volume bars split into 3 components: (1) Market Buy Volume - i.e., the volume that got transacted on upticks; (2) Market Sell Volume - i.e.,  the volume that got transacted on downticks;
// and, (3) Neutral Volume - i.e., the volume that got transacted without a change in price.
// The tool can also be switched to an Up/Down Vol Only mode where it shows the volume split into Up and Down volume only. All neutral volume will be cetegorized into either Up or Down depending on whether
// the last price movement was Up or Down.
// (This feature can be turned off if you want normal volume bars).
// Market delta (i.e., Market Buy Volume - Market Sell Volume) is also displayed above each volume bar. (On by default; can be switched off from Settings)
// The split and Market Delta data are ONLY AVAILABLE FOR REAL-TIME BARS. Historical bars are shown just like regular ones.
// The dotted line marks the start of realtime data (i.e., the bar from which the indicator started collecting and displaying data)
// You will see accurate data for bars to the right of this line. The longer you keep a chart open with the study enabled, the more data it collects and displays.
// and the better your analysis can potentially be.
// Note that the data gets reset everytime any of the options is changed, the market is switched, browser is refreshed, or the script is reloaded
// DATA ISN'T STORED. I.e., every time a new symbol is loaded, previous symbol's data is lost. So if you intend to monitor a symbol closely, you would need to keep it loaded all the time.
// An MA option is also provided so that it can used as a complete replcement of the normal Volume indicator.
// Who is it for?
// For traders who are used to analysing buy/sell activity using market buy/sell volume and market delta information
// Use it in conjunction with "Market Delta Volume for Realtime Bars" indicator to get a better visual representation of the numbers
// 

indicator('Volume with Market Buy/Sell and Neutral Volume Split for Realtime Bars', shorttitle = 'VolMarketBuySellNeutral_MW', overlay = false, max_labels_count = 500)

isMode = input.string('Up/Down/Neutral', 'Mode', options = ['Up/Down/Neutral', 'Up/Down'])
isDisplaySplit = input(true, 'Show Split')
isDisplayStartLine = input.bool(true, 'Show Start Line', tooltip = 'Realtime data starts from the bar to the right of this line')
isDisplayVolumeMA = input.bool(false, 'Show MA |', inline = 'MA')
volumeMAPeriod = input.int(20, 'MA Period', inline = 'MA', minval = 1, maxval = 100)
isDisplayMarketDelta = input(true, 'Show Net Delta Vol Above Bar')
colorDeltaVolUpVal = input.color(color.green, 'Net Delta +ve', inline = 'DeltaNumColor')
colorDeltaVolDnVal = input.color(color.red, 'Net Delta -ve', inline = 'DeltaNumColor')
colorDeltaVolNtVal = input.color(color.gray, 'Net Delta 0', inline = 'DeltaNumColor')
scaleDownFactor = input.int(1, 'Scale Down Factor', options = [1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000], tooltip = 'Display the net delta value scaled down for better readability')
fontSizeUI = input.string('Medium', 'Font Size', options = ['Auto', 'Tiny', 'Small', 'Medium', 'Large', 'Huge'])


UPDOWNNEUTRAL_MODE = 1
UPDOWN_MODE = 2

iMode = isMode == 'Up/Down/Neutral' ? UPDOWNNEUTRAL_MODE : UPDOWN_MODE
fontSize = fontSizeUI == 'Auto' ? size.auto : fontSizeUI == 'Tiny' ? size.tiny : fontSizeUI == 'Small' ? size.small : fontSizeUI == 'Medium' ? size.normal : fontSizeUI == 'Large' ? size.large : size.huge


f_upDnNtVolume(_mode) =>
    //{
    varip float _prevClose = open
    varip float _prevVolume = 0.
    varip float _newVolume = 0.
    varip float _volUp = 0.
    varip float _volDn = 0.
    varip float _volNt = 0.
    varip int _prevPolarity = 0

    if barstate.isnew
        _volUp := 0.
        _volDn := 0.
        _volNt := 0.
        _prevClose := nz(close[1])
        _prevVolume := 0.
        _prevPolarity := nz(_prevPolarity[1])
        _prevPolarity

    _newVolume := volume - _prevVolume

    if close > _prevClose
        _prevPolarity := 1
        _volUp := _volUp + _newVolume
        _volUp
    else if close < _prevClose
        _prevPolarity := -1
        _volDn := _volDn + _newVolume
        _volDn
    else
        if _mode == UPDOWN_MODE
            if _prevPolarity == 1
                _volUp := _volUp + _newVolume
                _volUp
            else if _prevPolarity == -1
                _volDn := _volDn + _newVolume
                _volDn
            else
                _volNt := _volNt + _newVolume
                _volNt
        else
            _volNt := _volNt + _newVolume
            _volNt

    _prevClose := close
    _prevVolume := volume
    [_volUp, _volDn, _volNt]
    //}

//==============================================================================
//==============================================================================
// MAIN
var bool isbarConsidered = false
var bool firstBar = true
[volUp, volDn, volNt] = f_upDnNtVolume(iMode)
deltaVol = volUp - volDn
totVol = volUp + volDn + volNt


isbarConsidered := barstate.isrealtime ? true : isbarConsidered

baseSeriesColor = close > open ? color.blue : close < open ? color.black : color.gray
baseSeries = not isbarConsidered ? volume : not isDisplaySplit ? volume : 0
buySeries = not isbarConsidered ? 0 : isDisplaySplit ? volume : 0
sellSeries = not isbarConsidered ? 0 : isDisplaySplit ? volDn + volNt : 0
neutralSeries = not isbarConsidered ? 0 : isDisplaySplit ? volNt : 0

plot(baseSeries, 'Historic Volume', color = baseSeriesColor, style = plot.style_columns)
plot(buySeries, 'Volume Up', color = color.new(color.green, 0), style = plot.style_columns)
plot(sellSeries, 'Volume Down', color = color.new(color.red, 0), style = plot.style_columns)
plot(volNt, 'Volume Neutral', color = color.new(color.gray, 0), style = plot.style_columns)
plot(isDisplayVolumeMA ? ta.ema(volume, volumeMAPeriod) : 0, 'Volume MA', color = color.new(color.black, 0), style = plot.style_line)

if isbarConsidered
    if firstBar
        if isDisplayStartLine
            line.new(bar_index, volume + 5, bar_index, volume + 6, extend = extend.right, color = color.black, style = line.style_dashed)
        firstBar := false
        firstBar
    if isDisplayMarketDelta
        text_color = volUp - volDn > 0 ? colorDeltaVolUpVal : volUp - volDn < 0 ? colorDeltaVolDnVal : colorDeltaVolNtVal
        label.new(x = bar_index, y = volume, yloc = yloc.price, textcolor = text_color, style = label.style_none, size = fontSize, text = str.tostring(int((volUp - volDn) / scaleDownFactor)))
//==============================================================================
//==============================================================================

scripts.source:
//@version=6
indicator('RSI MTF Tactical OB/OS v1.1.4', overlay=false, precision=2, shorttitle='RSIMTF v1.1.4')

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Define Colors ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
vWhite  = #FFFFFF
vBlue   = #009CDF
vGreen  = #5EBD3E
vYellow = #FFB900
vRed    = #E23838

textColor = color.white

bullishColor = color.rgb(38, 166, 154, 0)   // Used in the display table
bearishColor = color.rgb(239, 83, 79, 0)    // Used in the display table
nomatchColor = color.silver                 // Used in the display table
neutralColor = color.rgb(120, 123, 134, 0) // Used in the display table

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Functions -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TF2txt(TF) =>
    switch TF
        "S"   => "1s"
        "5S"  => "5s"
        "10S" => "10s"
        "15S" => "15s"
        "30S" => "30s"
        "1"   => "1m"
        "3"   => "3m"
        "5"   => "5m"
        "15"  => "15m"
        "30"  => "30m"
        "45"  => "45m"
        "60"  => "1h"
        "120" => "2h"
        "180" => "3h"
        "240" => "4h"
        "480" => "8h"
        "D"   => "1D"
        "1D"  => "1D"
        "2D"  => "2D"
        "3D"  => "3D"
        "W"   => "1W"
        "1W"  => "1W"
        "M"   => "1M"
        "1M"  => "1M"
        "3M"  => "3M"
        "6M"  => "6M"
        "12M" => "12M"
        => "RSI"

rsiStateTxt(val, upperExt, upper, lower, lowerExt) =>
    val >= upperExt ? "C exa." :
     val >= upper ? "C est." :
     val <= lowerExt ? "V exa." :
     val <= lower ? "V est." :
     val >= 50 ? "C+" : "V+"

rsiStateColor(val, upperExt, upper, lower, lowerExt) =>
    val >= upperExt ? color.new(vYellow, 0) :
     val >= upper ? bullishColor :
     val <= lowerExt ? color.new(vRed, 0) :
     val <= lower ? bearishColor :
     val >= 50 ? color.new(vBlue, 55) : neutralColor

bbTxt(bull, bear) =>
    bull ? "C✓" : bear ? "V✓" : "—"

bbColor(bull, bear) =>
    bull ? bullishColor : bear ? bearishColor : nomatchColor

rsiCellTxt(val, upperExt, upper, lower, lowerExt) =>
    str.format(" {0,number,#.##} | {1} ", val, rsiStateTxt(val, upperExt, upper, lower, lowerExt))

newTC(tBox, col, row, txt, width, txtColor, bgColor, txtHA, txtSize) =>
    table.cell(table_id=tBox, column=col, row=row, text=txt, width=width, text_color=txtColor, bgcolor=bgColor, text_halign=txtHA, text_size=txtSize)


tablePositionFromString(pos) =>
    switch pos
        "top_left" => position.top_left
        "top_center" => position.top_center
        "top_right" => position.top_right
        "middle_left" => position.middle_left
        "middle_center" => position.middle_center
        "middle_right" => position.middle_right
        "bottom_left" => position.bottom_left
        "bottom_center" => position.bottom_center
        => position.bottom_right

ma(source, length, type) =>
    switch type
        "SMA" => ta.sma(source, length)
        "Bollinger Bands" => ta.sma(source, length)
        "EMA" => ta.ema(source, length)
        "SMMA (RMA)" => ta.rma(source, length)
        "WMA" => ta.wma(source, length)
        "VWMA" => ta.vwma(source, length)

f_lineup(cur, prev1, prev2, center, buffer, minStep) =>
    bull = cur >= center + buffer and cur > prev1 + minStep and prev1 >= prev2 - minStep
    bear = cur <= center - buffer and cur < prev1 - minStep and prev1 <= prev2 + minStep
    [bull, bear]

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Show/Hide Settings ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rsiShowInput          = input.bool(true, title='Show RSI', group='Show/Hide Settings', display=display.none)
maShowInput           = input.bool(false, title='Show MA', group='Show/Hide Settings', display=display.none)
showRSIMAInput        = input.bool(false, title='Show RSIMA Cloud (kept disabled by default)', group='Show/Hide Settings', display=display.none)
rsiBandShowInput      = input.bool(true, title='Show Oversold/Overbought Lines', group='Show/Hide Settings', display=display.none)
rsiBandExtShowInput   = input.bool(true, title='Show Oversold/Overbought Extended Lines', group='Show/Hide Settings', display=display.none)
rsiHighlightShowInput = input.bool(true, title='Show Oversold/Overbought Highlight', group='Show/Hide Settings', display=display.none)
DivergenceShowInput   = input.bool(false, title='Show RSI Divergence Labels (kept disabled by default)', group='Show/Hide Settings', display=display.none)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Table Settings --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rsiShowTable     = input.bool(true, title='Show RSI Table Information Box', group="RSI Table Settings", display=display.none)
rsiTablePosition = input.string(title='Location', defval='middle_right', options=['top_left', 'top_center', 'top_right', 'middle_left', 'middle_center', 'middle_right', 'bottom_left', 'bottom_center', 'bottom_right'], group="RSI Table Settings", inline='1', display=display.none)
rsiTextSize      = input.string(title=' Size', defval='small', options=['auto', 'tiny', 'small', 'normal', 'large', 'huge'], group="RSI Table Settings", inline='1', display=display.none)

rsiShowTF1 = input.bool(true, title='Show TimeFrame1', group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf1', display=display.none)
rsiTF1     = input.timeframe("15", title=" Time", group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf1', display=display.none)

rsiShowTF2 = input.bool(true, title='Show TimeFrame2', group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf2', display=display.none)
rsiTF2     = input.timeframe("60", title=" Time", group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf2', display=display.none)

rsiShowTF3 = input.bool(true, title='Show TimeFrame3', group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf3', display=display.none)
rsiTF3     = input.timeframe("240", title=" Time", group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf3', display=display.none)

rsiShowTF4 = input.bool(true, title='Show TimeFrame4', group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf4', display=display.none)
rsiTF4     = input.timeframe("D", title=" Time", group="RSI Table Settings", inline='tf4', display=display.none)

rsiShowHist = input.bool(true, title='Show RSI Historical Columns', group="RSI Table Settings", tooltip='Show the information of the 2 previous closed candles', display=display.none)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- RSI Lineup / Alert Polishing -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
mtfCenterBuffer = input.float(2.0, title='Centerline Buffer', minval=0.0, step=0.25, group='RSI Lineup Settings', tooltip='Avoids flipping bullish/bearish susceptibility too close to RSI 50.', display=display.none)
mtfMinStep      = input.float(0.25, title='Min RSI Step Between Bars', minval=0.0, step=0.05, group='RSI Lineup Settings', tooltip='Small minimum change required to call the MTF lineup bullish or bearish.', display=display.none)
dynamicMtfAlert = input.bool(false, title='Dynamic TF1 + TF2 alerts via alert()', group='RSI Alert Settings', tooltip='Use this with Any alert() function call to receive TF1+TF2 alert messages using your current timeframe selections.', display=display.none)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- RSI Input Settings ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rsiSourceInput       = input.source(close, 'Source', group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)
rsiLengthInput       = input.int(14, minval=1, title='RSI Length', group='RSI Settings', tooltip='Main RSI length', display=display.none)
rsiColorInput        = input.color(#26a69a, title="RSI Color", group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)
rsimaColorInput      = input.color(#ef534f, title="RSIMA Color", group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)
rsiBandColorInput    = input.color(#787B86, title="RSI Band Color", group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)
rsiUpperBandExtInput = input.int(title='RSI Overbought Extended Line', defval=80, minval=50, maxval=100, group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)
rsiUpperBandInput    = input.int(title='RSI Overbought Line', defval=70, minval=50, maxval=100, group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)
rsiLowerBandInput    = input.int(title='RSI Oversold Line', defval=30, minval=0, maxval=50, group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)
rsiLowerBandExtInput = input.int(title='RSI Oversold Extended Line', defval=20, minval=0, maxval=50, group='RSI Settings', display=display.none)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- MA Input Settings -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
maTypeInput   = input.string("EMA", title="MA Type", options=["SMA", "Bollinger Bands", "EMA", "SMMA (RMA)", "WMA", "VWMA"], group="MA Settings", display=display.none)
maLengthInput = input.int(14, title="MA Length", group="MA Settings", display=display.none)
maColorInput  = input.color(color.yellow, title="MA Color", group='MA Settings', display=display.none)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Divergence Input Settings (kept for later polishing; disabled by default) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
lbrInput        = input.int(title="Pivot Lookback Right", defval=2, group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)
lblInput        = input.int(title="Pivot Lookback Left", defval=2, group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)
lbRangeMaxInput = input.int(title="Max of Lookback Range", defval=10, group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)
lbRangeMinInput = input.int(title="Min of Lookback Range", defval=2, group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)

plotBullInput       = input.bool(false, title="Plot Bullish (kept disabled by default)", group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)
plotHiddenBullInput = input.bool(false, title="Plot Hidden Bullish (kept disabled by default)", group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)
plotBearInput       = input.bool(false, title="Plot Bearish (kept disabled by default)", group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)
plotHiddenBearInput = input.bool(false, title="Plot Hidden Bearish (kept disabled by default)", group='RSI Divergence Settings', display=display.none)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- RSI Calculation -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rsi = ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)

[rsi1, rsi1_1, rsi1_2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rsiTF1, [ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput), ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[1], ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[2]], barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
[rsi2, rsi2_1, rsi2_2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rsiTF2, [ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput), ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[1], ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[2]], barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
[rsi3, rsi3_1, rsi3_2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rsiTF3, [ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput), ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[1], ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[2]], barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
[rsi4, rsi4_1, rsi4_2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rsiTF4, [ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput), ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[1], ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, rsiLengthInput)[2]], barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

rsiMA = ma(rsi, maLengthInput, maTypeInput)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Stoch RSI Settings + Calculation (kept for later polishing; disabled by default) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
showStochRSI = input.bool(false, title="Show Stochastic RSI (kept disabled by default)", group='Stochastic RSI Settings', display=display.none)
smoothK      = input.int(title="Stochastic K", defval=3, minval=1, maxval=10, group='Stochastic RSI Settings', display=display.none)
smoothD      = input.int(title="Stochastic D", defval=4, minval=1, maxval=10, group='Stochastic RSI Settings', display=display.none)
lengthRSI    = input.int(title="Stochastic RSI Length", defval=14, minval=1, group='Stochastic RSI Settings', display=display.none)
lengthStoch  = input.int(title="Stochastic Length", defval=14, minval=1, group='Stochastic RSI Settings', display=display.none)
colorK       = input.color(color.rgb(41, 98, 255, 0), title="K Color", group='Stochastic RSI Settings', inline="1", display=display.none)
colorD       = input.color(color.rgb(205, 109, 0, 0), title="D Color", group='Stochastic RSI Settings', inline="1", display=display.none)

stochBase = ta.rsi(rsiSourceInput, lengthRSI)
k = ta.sma(ta.stoch(stochBase, stochBase, stochBase, lengthStoch), smoothK)
d = ta.sma(k, smoothD)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Divergence Calculation (kept for later polishing; disabled by default) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
bearColor = color.red
bullColor = color.green
hiddenBullColor = color.new(color.green, 50)
hiddenBearColor = color.new(color.red, 50)
noneColor = color.new(color.white, 100)
osc = rsi

plFound = not na(ta.pivotlow(osc, lblInput, lbrInput))
phFound = not na(ta.pivothigh(osc, lblInput, lbrInput))

_inRange(cond) =>
    bars = ta.barssince(cond)
    lbRangeMinInput <= bars and bars <= lbRangeMaxInput

// Regular Bullish
oscHL   = osc[lbrInput] > ta.valuewhen(plFound, osc[lbrInput], 1) and _inRange(plFound[1])
priceLL = low[lbrInput] < ta.valuewhen(plFound, low[lbrInput], 1)
bullCond = plotBullInput and priceLL and oscHL and plFound

// Hidden Bullish
oscLL        = osc[lbrInput] < ta.valuewhen(plFound, osc[lbrInput], 1) and _inRange(plFound[1])
priceHL      = low[lbrInput] > ta.valuewhen(plFound, low[lbrInput], 1)
hiddenBullCond = plotHiddenBullInput and priceHL and oscLL and plFound

// Regular Bearish
oscLH   = osc[lbrInput] < ta.valuewhen(phFound, osc[lbrInput], 1) and _inRange(phFound[1])
priceHH = high[lbrInput] > ta.valuewhen(phFound, high[lbrInput], 1)
bearCond = plotBearInput and priceHH and oscLH and phFound

// Hidden Bearish
oscHH   = osc[lbrInput] > ta.valuewhen(phFound, osc[lbrInput], 1) and _inRange(phFound[1])
priceLH = high[lbrInput] < ta.valuewhen(phFound, high[lbrInput], 1)
hiddenBearCond = plotHiddenBearInput and priceLH and oscHH and phFound

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Lineup ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[bullTF,  bearTF]  = f_lineup(rsi,  rsi[1],  rsi[2], 50.0, mtfCenterBuffer, mtfMinStep)
[bullTF1, bearTF1] = f_lineup(rsi1, rsi1_1, rsi1_2, 50.0, mtfCenterBuffer, mtfMinStep)
[bullTF2, bearTF2] = f_lineup(rsi2, rsi2_1, rsi2_2, 50.0, mtfCenterBuffer, mtfMinStep)
[bullTF3, bearTF3] = f_lineup(rsi3, rsi3_1, rsi3_2, 50.0, mtfCenterBuffer, mtfMinStep)
[bullTF4, bearTF4] = f_lineup(rsi4, rsi4_1, rsi4_2, 50.0, mtfCenterBuffer, mtfMinStep)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Plot Lines ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rsiColor = rsi >= rsiMA ? rsiColorInput : rsimaColorInput

hline(50, title='RSI Baseline', color=color.new(rsiBandColorInput, 50), linestyle=hline.style_dashed, editable=false)
hline(rsiBandExtShowInput ? rsiUpperBandExtInput : na, title='RSI Upper Extended Band', color=color.new(rsiBandColorInput, 10), linestyle=hline.style_dashed, editable=false)
hline(rsiBandShowInput ? rsiUpperBandInput : na, title='RSI Upper Band', color=color.new(rsiBandColorInput, 10), linestyle=hline.style_dashed, editable=false)
hline(rsiBandShowInput ? rsiLowerBandInput : na, title='RSI Lower Band', color=color.new(rsiBandColorInput, 10), linestyle=hline.style_dashed, editable=false)
hline(rsiBandExtShowInput ? rsiLowerBandExtInput : na, title='RSI Lower Extended Band', color=color.new(rsiBandColorInput, 10), linestyle=hline.style_dashed, editable=false)

bgcolor(rsiHighlightShowInput and rsi >= rsiUpperBandExtInput ? color.new(rsiColorInput, 75) : na, title="Extreme Overbought Highlight", editable=false)
bgcolor(rsiHighlightShowInput and rsi >= rsiUpperBandInput and rsi < rsiUpperBandExtInput ? color.new(#64ffda, 90) : na, title="Overbought Highlight", editable=false)
bgcolor(rsiHighlightShowInput and rsi <= rsiLowerBandInput and rsi > rsiLowerBandExtInput ? color.new(#F43E32, 90) : na, title="Oversold Highlight", editable=false)
bgcolor(rsiHighlightShowInput and rsi <= rsiLowerBandExtInput ? color.new(rsimaColorInput, 75) : na, title="Extreme Oversold Highlight", editable=false)

maPlot = plot(maShowInput ? rsiMA : na, title='MA', color=color.new(maColorInput, 0), linewidth=1, display=display.pane + display.data_window)
rsiMAPlot = plot(showRSIMAInput ? rsiMA : na, title="RSI MA", color=color.new(rsimaColorInput, 0), editable=false, display=display.none)
rsiPlot = plot(rsiShowInput ? rsi : na, title='RSI', color=color.new(rsiColor, 0), linewidth=1, display=display.all - display.price_scale)
fill(rsiPlot, rsiMAPlot, color=color.new(rsiColor, 70), title="RSIMA Cloud")

plot(showStochRSI ? k : na, title='Stochastic K', color=colorK, linewidth=1, display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plot(showStochRSI ? d : na, title='Stochastic D', color=colorD, linewidth=1, display=display.pane + display.data_window)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Plot Divergence (kept alive but disabled by default) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot(plotBullInput and plFound ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência C", linewidth=2, color=(bullCond ? bullColor : noneColor), display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plotshape(DivergenceShowInput and bullCond ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência C Label", text=" Div C ", style=shape.labelup, location=location.absolute, color=bullColor, textcolor=textColor, display=display.pane + display.data_window)

plot(plotHiddenBullInput and plFound ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência oculta C", linewidth=2, color=(hiddenBullCond ? hiddenBullColor : noneColor), display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plotshape(DivergenceShowInput and hiddenBullCond ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência oculta C Label", text=" H Div C ", style=shape.labelup, location=location.absolute, color=bullColor, textcolor=textColor, display=display.pane + display.data_window)

plot(plotBearInput and phFound ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência V", linewidth=2, color=(bearCond ? bearColor : noneColor), display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plotshape(DivergenceShowInput and bearCond ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência V Label", text=" Div V ", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.absolute, color=bearColor, textcolor=textColor, display=display.pane + display.data_window)

plot(plotHiddenBearInput and phFound ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência oculta V", linewidth=2, color=(hiddenBearCond ? hiddenBearColor : noneColor), display=display.pane + display.data_window)
plotshape(DivergenceShowInput and hiddenBearCond ? osc[lbrInput] : na, offset=-lbrInput, title="Divergência oculta V Label", text=" H Div V ", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.absolute, color=bearColor, textcolor=textColor, display=display.pane + display.data_window)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Table -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
width_c0 = 0

var table tBox = na
if rsiShowTable
    if na(tBox)
        tBox := table.new(position=tablePositionFromString(rsiTablePosition), columns=5, rows=6, bgcolor=color.rgb(18, 22, 33, 50), frame_color=color.black, frame_width=1, border_color=color.black, border_width=1)

    newTC(tBox, 0, 1, "Atual", width_c0, color.orange, color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100), text.align_right, rsiTextSize)
    newTC(tBox, 1, 1, rsiCellTxt(rsi, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
    newTC(tBox, 4, 1, bbTxt(bullTF, bearTF), width_c0, vWhite, bbColor(bullTF, bearTF), text.align_center, rsiTextSize)
    if rsiShowHist
        newTC(tBox, 2, 1, rsiCellTxt(rsi[1], rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi[1], rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 3, 1, rsiCellTxt(rsi[2], rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi[2], rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)

    if rsiShowTF1
        newTC(tBox, 0, 2, TF2txt(rsiTF1), width_c0, vWhite, color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100), text.align_right, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 1, 2, rsiCellTxt(rsi1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 4, 2, bbTxt(bullTF1, bearTF1), width_c0, vWhite, bbColor(bullTF1, bearTF1), text.align_center, rsiTextSize)
        if rsiShowHist
            newTC(tBox, 2, 2, rsiCellTxt(rsi1_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi1_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
            newTC(tBox, 3, 2, rsiCellTxt(rsi1_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi1_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)

    if rsiShowTF2
        newTC(tBox, 0, 3, TF2txt(rsiTF2), width_c0, vWhite, color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100), text.align_right, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 1, 3, rsiCellTxt(rsi2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 4, 3, bbTxt(bullTF2, bearTF2), width_c0, vWhite, bbColor(bullTF2, bearTF2), text.align_center, rsiTextSize)
        if rsiShowHist
            newTC(tBox, 2, 3, rsiCellTxt(rsi2_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi2_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
            newTC(tBox, 3, 3, rsiCellTxt(rsi2_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi2_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)

    if rsiShowTF3
        newTC(tBox, 0, 4, TF2txt(rsiTF3), width_c0, vWhite, color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100), text.align_right, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 1, 4, rsiCellTxt(rsi3, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi3, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 4, 4, bbTxt(bullTF3, bearTF3), width_c0, vWhite, bbColor(bullTF3, bearTF3), text.align_center, rsiTextSize)
        if rsiShowHist
            newTC(tBox, 2, 4, rsiCellTxt(rsi3_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi3_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
            newTC(tBox, 3, 4, rsiCellTxt(rsi3_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi3_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)

    if rsiShowTF4
        newTC(tBox, 0, 5, TF2txt(rsiTF4), width_c0, vWhite, color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100), text.align_right, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 1, 5, rsiCellTxt(rsi4, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi4, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
        newTC(tBox, 4, 5, bbTxt(bullTF4, bearTF4), width_c0, vWhite, bbColor(bullTF4, bearTF4), text.align_center, rsiTextSize)
        if rsiShowHist
            newTC(tBox, 2, 5, rsiCellTxt(rsi4_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi4_1, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)
            newTC(tBox, 3, 5, rsiCellTxt(rsi4_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), width_c0, vWhite, rsiStateColor(rsi4_2, rsiUpperBandExtInput, rsiUpperBandInput, rsiLowerBandInput, rsiLowerBandExtInput), text.align_left, rsiTextSize)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//--- Alerts ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
enterOB  = ta.crossover(rsi, rsiUpperBandInput)
enterXOB = ta.crossover(rsi, rsiUpperBandExtInput)
enterOS  = ta.crossunder(rsi, rsiLowerBandInput)
enterXOS = ta.crossunder(rsi, rsiLowerBandExtInput)

exitOB  = ta.crossunder(rsi, rsiUpperBandInput)
exitXOB = ta.crossunder(rsi, rsiUpperBandExtInput)
exitOS  = ta.crossover(rsi, rsiLowerBandInput)
exitXOS = ta.crossover(rsi, rsiLowerBandExtInput)

mtfOB_TF1_TF2 = rsi1 >= rsiUpperBandInput and rsi2 >= rsiUpperBandInput
mtfOS_TF1_TF2 = rsi1 <= rsiLowerBandInput and rsi2 <= rsiLowerBandInput

alertcondition(enterOB,  title="RSI entrou em Esticado C",          message="RSI entrou em zona de esticamento comprador.")
alertcondition(enterXOB, title="RSI entrou em Exaustão C",  message="RSI entrou em zona de exaustão compradora.")
alertcondition(enterOS,  title="RSI entrou em Esticado V",            message="RSI entrou em zona de esticamento vendedor.")
alertcondition(enterXOS, title="RSI entrou em Exaustão V",    message="RSI entrou em zona de exaustão vendedora.")

alertcondition(exitOB,   title="RSI saiu de Esticado C",           message="RSI saiu da zona de esticamento comprador.")
alertcondition(exitXOB,  title="RSI saiu de Exaustão C",   message="RSI saiu da zona de exaustão compradora.")
alertcondition(exitOS,   title="RSI saiu de Esticado V",             message="RSI saiu da zona de esticamento vendedor.")
alertcondition(exitXOS,  title="RSI saiu de Exaustão V",     message="RSI saiu da zona de exaustão vendedora.")

alertcondition(mtfOB_TF1_TF2 and not mtfOB_TF1_TF2[1], title="RSI TF1 + TF2 Esticado C", message="RSI está esticado em compra nos TF1 e TF2. Use alert() dinâmico para os timeframes selecionados.")
alertcondition(mtfOS_TF1_TF2 and not mtfOS_TF1_TF2[1], title="RSI TF1 + TF2 Esticado V",   message="RSI está esticado em venda nos TF1 e TF2. Use alert() dinâmico para os timeframes selecionados.")

if dynamicMtfAlert and barstate.isconfirmed
    if mtfOB_TF1_TF2 and not mtfOB_TF1_TF2[1]
        alert(str.format("RSI esticado em compra em {0} e {1}.", rsiTF1, rsiTF2), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    if mtfOS_TF1_TF2 and not mtfOS_TF1_TF2[1]
        alert(str.format("RSI esticado em venda em {0} e {1}.", rsiTF1, rsiTF2), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

scripts.source:
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © traderharikrishna

//@version=5
indicator("RSITrend")
[plus,minus,adx]=ta.dmi(14,14)
sw=input.bool(true,'Highlight Ranging/Sideways')
showbarcolor=input.bool(true,'Apply Barcolor')
show_Baseline=input.bool(true,'Show Hull Trend')
rsiLengthInput = input.int(14, minval=1, title="RSI Length1", group="RSI Settings")
rsiLengthInput2 = input.int(28, minval=1, title="RSI Length2", group="RSI Settings")
trendlen= input(title='Hull Trend Length', defval=30,group='Hull Trend')
oversold=input.int(30, minval=1, title="Over Sold", group="RSI Settings")
overbought=input.int(70, minval=1, title="Over Bought", group="RSI Settings")
BBMC=ta.hma(close,trendlen)
MHULL = BBMC[0]
SHULL = BBMC[2]
hmac=MHULL > SHULL ?color.new(#00c3ff , 0):color.new(#ff0062, 0)
buysignal=MHULL > SHULL 
sellsignal=MHULL < SHULL
frsi=ta.hma(ta.rsi(close,rsiLengthInput),10)
srsi=ta.hma(ta.rsi(close,rsiLengthInput2),10)
hullrsi1=ta.rsi(MHULL,rsiLengthInput)
hullrsi2=ta.rsi(SHULL,rsiLengthInput)
rsic=frsi>srsi?color.new(#00c3ff , 0):color.new(#ff0062, 0)
barcolor(showbarcolor?hmac:na)
hu1=plot(show_Baseline?hullrsi1:frsi,title='HMA1',color=color.gray,linewidth=1,display=display.none)
hu2=plot(show_Baseline?hullrsi2:srsi,title='HMA2',color=color.gray,linewidth=1,display=display.none)
fill(hu1,hu2,title='HULL RSI TREND',color=show_Baseline?hmac:rsic)
fill(hu1,hu2,title='HULL with Sideways',color=sw and adx<20?color.gray:na)


rsiUpperBand2 = hline(90, "RSI Upper Band(90)", color=color.red,linestyle=hline.style_dotted,display=display.none)
rsiUpperBand = hline(overbought, "RSI Upper Band", color=color.red,linestyle=hline.style_dotted,display=display.none)
fill(rsiUpperBand2,rsiUpperBand,title='Buy Zone',color=color.red,transp=80)
hline(50, "RSI Middle Band", color=color.new(#787B86, 50),linestyle=hline.style_solid)
rsiLowerBand = hline(oversold, "RSI Lower Band", color=color.green,linestyle=hline.style_dotted,display=display.none)
rsiLowerBand2 = hline(10, "RSI Lower Band(10)", color=color.green,linestyle=hline.style_dotted,display=display.none)
fill(rsiLowerBand,rsiLowerBand2,title='Sell Zone',color=color.green,transp=80)

plotshape(buysignal and sellsignal[1] ?hullrsi1 :na, title='Buy', style=shape.triangleup, location=location.absolute,  color=color.new(color.yellow, 0), size=size.tiny, offset=0)
plotshape(sellsignal  and buysignal[1] ?hullrsi1 :na, title='Sell', style=shape.triangledown, location=location.absolute, color=color.new(color.red, 0), size=size.tiny, offset=0)

alertcondition(buysignal and sellsignal[1] ,title='RSI TREND:Buy Signal',message='RSI TREND: Buy Signal')
alertcondition(sellsignal  and buysignal[1],title='RSI TREND:Sell Signal',message='RSI TREND: Sell Signal')

// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/

//@version=5
indicator("RSI Trendlines with Breakouts [HG]", precision = 2, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500)
import HoanGhetti/SimpleTrendlines/3 as tl

g_trendlines    = 'Trendline Settings', g_conditions = 'Conditions',  g_styling = 'Styling', g_timeframe = 'Timeframe'
input_timeframe = input.timeframe(defval = '', title = 'Timeframe', group = g_timeframe)
input_pLen      = input.int(defval = 4, title = 'Lookback Range', minval = 1, group = g_trendlines, tooltip = 'How many bars to determine when a swing high/low is detected.')
input_rLen      = input.int(defval = 14, title = 'RSI Length' , minval = 1, group = g_trendlines)
input_rSrc      = input.source(defval = close, title = 'RSI Source', group = g_trendlines)
input_repaint   = input.string(defval = 'On', title = 'Repainting', group = g_conditions, options = ['On', 'Off: Bar Confirmation'], tooltip = 'Bar Confirmation: Generates alerts when candle closes. (1 Candle Later)')
input_rsiDiff   = input.int(defval = 3, title = 'RSI Difference', group = g_conditions, tooltip = 'The difference between the current RSI value and the breakout value.\n\nHow much higher in value should the current RSI be compared to the breakout value in order to detect a breakout?')
input_rsiCol    = input.color(defval = color.blue, title = 'RSI Color', group = g_styling)
input_width     = input.int(defval = 2, title = 'Line Width', minval = 1, group = g_styling)
input_lblType   = input.string(defval = 'Simple', title = 'Label Type', group = g_styling, options = ['Full', 'Simple'])
input_lblSize   = input.string(defval = size.small, title = 'Label Size', group = g_styling, options = [size.huge, size.large, size.normal, size.small, size.tiny])
input_pLowCol   = input.color(defval = color.red, title = 'Pivot Low', inline = 'col', group = g_styling)
input_pHighCol  = input.color(defval = #089981, title = 'Pivot High', inline = 'col', group = g_styling)
input_override  = input.bool(defval = false, title = 'Override Text Color', group = g_styling, inline = 'override')
input_overCol   = input.color(defval = color.white, title = ' ', group = g_styling, inline = 'override')

lblText = switch input_lblType
    'Simple' => 'Br'
    'Full'   => 'Break'
repaint = switch input_repaint
    'On' => true
    'Off: Bar Confirmation' => false

rsi_v = ta.rsi(input_rSrc, input_rLen) 
rsi = input_timeframe == '' ? rsi_v : request.security(syminfo.tickerid, input_timeframe, rsi_v, lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

pl = fixnan(ta.pivotlow(rsi, 1, input_pLen))
ph = fixnan(ta.pivothigh(rsi, 1, input_pLen))

pivot(float pType) =>
    pivot = pType == pl ? pl : ph
    xAxis = ta.valuewhen(ta.change(pivot), bar_index, 0) - ta.valuewhen(ta.change(pivot), bar_index, 1)
    prevPivot = ta.valuewhen(ta.change(pivot), pivot, 1)
    pivotCond = ta.change(pivot) and (pType == pl ? pivot > prevPivot : pivot < prevPivot)
    pData = tl.new(x_axis = xAxis, offset = input_pLen, strictMode = true, strictType = pType == pl ? 0 : 1)
    pData.drawLine(pivotCond, prevPivot, pivot, rsi)
    pData

breakout(tl.Trendline this, float pType) =>
    var bool hasCrossed = false
    if ta.change(this.lines.startline.get_y1())
        hasCrossed := false
    this.drawTrendline(not hasCrossed)
    condType = (pType == pl ? rsi < this.lines.trendline.get_y2() - input_rsiDiff : rsi > this.lines.trendline.get_y2() + input_rsiDiff) and not hasCrossed
    condition = repaint ? condType : condType and barstate.isconfirmed
    if condition
        hasCrossed := true
        this.lines.startline.set_xy2(this.lines.trendline.get_x2(), this.lines.trendline.get_y2())
        this.lines.trendline.set_xy2(na, na)
        this.lines.startline.copy()
        label.new(
             bar_index, 
             this.lines.startline.get_y2(), 
             text = lblText, color = pType == pl ? color.new(input_pLowCol, 50) : color.new(input_pHighCol, 50), 
             size = input_lblSize, style = pType == pl ? label.style_label_lower_left : label.style_label_upper_left, 
             textcolor = pType == pl ? (input_override ? input_overCol : input_pLowCol) : input_override ? input_overCol : input_pHighCol)
    hasCrossed

method style(tl.Trendline this, color col) =>
    this.lines.startline.set_color(col)
    this.lines.startline.set_width(input_width)
    this.lines.trendline.set_color(col)
    this.lines.trendline.set_width(input_width)
    this.lines.trendline.set_style(line.style_dashed)

plData = pivot(pl)
phData = pivot(ph)
plData.style(input_pLowCol)
phData.style(input_pHighCol)
cu = breakout(plData, pl)
co = breakout(phData, ph)

hline(70, title = 'Overbought', color = input_pHighCol, linestyle = hline.style_dotted)
hline(30, title = 'Oversold', color = input_pLowCol, linestyle = hline.style_dotted)
plot(rsi, title = 'Relative Strength Index', linewidth = 2, color = input_rsiCol)
alertcondition(ta.change(plData.lines.startline.get_y1()), 'New Pivot Low Trendline')
alertcondition(ta.change(cu) and cu, 'Pivot Low Breakout')
alertcondition(ta.change(phData.lines.startline.get_y1()), 'New Pivot High Trendline')
alertcondition(ta.change(co) and co, 'Pivot High Breakout')
