scripts.source:
//@version=6
strategy(
     title="Scalping PullBack Tool Strategy v2.3 5m 15m",
     shorttitle="SPBStr2.3",
     overlay=true,
     scale=scale.none,
     explicit_plot_zorder=true,
     pyramiding=0,
     process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent,
     commission_value=0.0,
     initial_capital=10000)

// =====================================================
// Scalping PullBack Tool Strategy v2.2
//
// Goals of v2.3:
// - Keep the PullBack identity intact for continuation + optional reversal
// - Adapt the strategy specifically for 5m / 15m scalp usage
// - Add 5m / 15m presets without forcing the user to tune core lengths manually
// - Keep safe HTF bias focused on 5m -> 15m
// - Preserve the operational layer and visual fixes
// =====================================================

// === CORE / VISUAL INPUTS ===
HiLoLenIn        = input.int(34, minval=2, title="Custom High Low PAC channel Length")
fastEMAlengthIn  = input.int(89, minval=2, title="Custom Fast EMA Length")
mediumEMAlengthIn = input.int(200, minval=2, title="Custom Medium EMA Length")
slowEMAlengthIn  = input.int(600, minval=2, title="Custom Slow EMA Length")
ShowFastEMA      = input.bool(true, title="Show Fast EMA")
ShowMediumEMA    = input.bool(true, title="Show Medium EMA")
ShowSlowEMA      = input.bool(false, title="Show Slow EMA")
ShowHHLL         = input.bool(false, title="Show HH/LL")
ShowFractals     = input.bool(true, title="Show Fractals")
filterBW         = input.bool(false, title="Show Ideal Fractals Only")
ShowBarColor     = input.bool(true, title="Show coloured Bars around PAC")
ShowBuySell      = input.bool(true, title="Show Buy/Sell Trigger Markers")
LookbackIn       = input.int(3, minval=1, title="Custom Pullback Lookback")
DelayArrow       = input.bool(true, title="Operate / Show Markers Only on Closed Candles")
ShowTrendBGcolor = input.bool(true, title="Show Trend BG Color")
UseHAcandles     = input.bool(false, title="Use Heikin Ashi Candles in Algo Calculations")

// === V2.0 REGIME / TRIGGER INPUTS ===
useSlopeFilter   = input.bool(true, title="Use Local Slope Filter")
slopeLookbackIn  = input.int(3, minval=1, title="Custom Slope Lookback")
triggerCloseFracIn = input.float(0.60, minval=0.50, maxval=0.95, step=0.05, title="Custom Trigger Candle Close Fraction")
usePrevBreakFilt = input.bool(true, title="Require Trigger Candle to Beat Previous Candle")
entryStopTicksIn = input.int(1, minval=0, title="Custom Entry Stop Offset (ticks)")
entryExpiryBarsIn = input.int(2, minval=1, title="Custom Entry Order Expiry (bars)")

// === OPTIONAL HTF BIAS ===
useHTFBiasInput  = input.bool(true, title="Use HTF Bias Filter")
mtfBiasProfile   = input.string("Auto", options=["Auto", "Off", "5m -> 15m", "Custom"], title="MTF Bias Profile")
htfTimeframeIn   = input.timeframe("15", title="Custom HTF Bias Timeframe")
useHTFSlopeFilter = input.bool(true, title="Use HTF Slope Filter")

// === OPERATIONAL LAYER ===
mode             = input.string("Conservative", options=["Conservative", "Flip"], title="Execution Mode")
stopMode         = input.string("Swing", options=["Swing", "PAC", "Hybrid"], title="Stop Method")
exitOnPacCenter  = input.bool(true, title="Exit on PAC Center Failure")
swingPadPct      = input.float(0.10, minval=0.0, step=0.01, title="Swing Stop Buffer %")
pacPadPct        = input.float(0.05, minval=0.0, step=0.01, title="PAC Stop Buffer %")
showDebugMarks   = input.bool(false, title="Show Debug Marks")

// === V2.2 REVERSAL MODULE ===
enableReversalModule = input.bool(false, title="Enable Post-Failure Reversal Module")
reversalRequireOppLocal = input.bool(true, title="Reversal Require Opposite Local Regime")
reversalAllowHTFNeutral = input.bool(true, title="Reversal Allow Neutral HTF Bias")

scalpPreset      = input.string("15m Balanced", options=["5m Fast", "5m Balanced", "15m Fast", "15m Balanced", "Custom"], title="Scalp Preset (5m / 15m)")

Delay = DelayArrow ? 1 : 0

// === EFFECTIVE 5M / 15M PRESET VALUES ===
int HiLoLen = HiLoLenIn
int fastEMAlength = fastEMAlengthIn
int mediumEMAlength = mediumEMAlengthIn
int slowEMAlength = slowEMAlengthIn
int Lookback = LookbackIn
int slopeLookback = slopeLookbackIn
float triggerCloseFrac = triggerCloseFracIn
int entryStopTicks = entryStopTicksIn
int entryExpiryBars = entryExpiryBarsIn

if scalpPreset == "5m Fast"
    HiLoLen := 13
    fastEMAlength := 34
    mediumEMAlength := 89
    slowEMAlength := 233
    Lookback := 2
    slopeLookback := 2
    triggerCloseFrac := 0.65
    entryStopTicks := 1
    entryExpiryBars := 1
else if scalpPreset == "5m Balanced"
    HiLoLen := 21
    fastEMAlength := 55
    mediumEMAlength := 144
    slowEMAlength := 377
    Lookback := 2
    slopeLookback := 2
    triggerCloseFrac := 0.60
    entryStopTicks := 1
    entryExpiryBars := 2
else if scalpPreset == "15m Fast"
    HiLoLen := 13
    fastEMAlength := 34
    mediumEMAlength := 89
    slowEMAlength := 233
    Lookback := 2
    slopeLookback := 3
    triggerCloseFrac := 0.60
    entryStopTicks := 1
    entryExpiryBars := 2
else if scalpPreset == "15m Balanced"
    HiLoLen := 21
    fastEMAlength := 55
    mediumEMAlength := 144
    slowEMAlength := 377
    Lookback := 3
    slopeLookback := 3
    triggerCloseFrac := 0.60
    entryStopTicks := 1
    entryExpiryBars := 2

effectiveUseHTFBias = useHTFBiasInput
resolvedHTF = htfTimeframeIn
if mtfBiasProfile == "Auto"
    if scalpPreset == "5m Fast" or scalpPreset == "5m Balanced"
        resolvedHTF := "15"
    else
        effectiveUseHTFBias := false
else if mtfBiasProfile == "Off"
    effectiveUseHTFBias := false
else if mtfBiasProfile == "5m -> 15m"
    resolvedHTF := "15"

// === SOURCE SERIES ===
haTicker = ticker.heikinashi(syminfo.tickerid)
sourceTicker = UseHAcandles ? haTicker : syminfo.tickerid
srcClose = UseHAcandles ? request.security(haTicker, timeframe.period, close) : close
srcOpen  = UseHAcandles ? request.security(haTicker, timeframe.period, open)  : open
srcHigh  = UseHAcandles ? request.security(haTicker, timeframe.period, high)  : high
srcLow   = UseHAcandles ? request.security(haTicker, timeframe.period, low)   : low

// === FRACTAL FUNCTIONS ===
isRegularFractal(modeFractal) =>
    modeFractal == 1 ? (high[4] < high[3] and high[3] < high[2] and high[2] > high[1] and high[1] > high[0]) :
     modeFractal == -1 ? (low[4] > low[3] and low[3] > low[2] and low[2] < low[1] and low[1] < low[0]) : false

isBWFractal(modeFractal) =>
    modeFractal == 1 ? (high[4] < high[2] and high[3] <= high[2] and high[2] >= high[1] and high[2] > high[0]) :
     modeFractal == -1 ? (low[4] > low[2] and low[3] >= low[2] and low[2] <= low[1] and low[2] < low[0]) : false

// === CORE SERIES ===
fastEMA   = ta.ema(srcClose, fastEMAlength)
mediumEMA = ta.ema(srcClose, mediumEMAlength)
slowEMA   = ta.ema(srcClose, slowEMAlength)
pacC      = ta.ema(srcClose, HiLoLen)
pacL      = ta.ema(srcLow,   HiLoLen)
pacU      = ta.ema(srcHigh,  HiLoLen)

// === STRUCTURAL VISUAL SUPPORT ===
filteredTop = filterBW ? isRegularFractal(1) : isBWFractal(1)
filteredBot = filterBW ? isRegularFractal(-1) : isBWFractal(-1)

valuewhen_H0 = ta.valuewhen(filteredTop, high[2], 0)
valuewhen_H1 = ta.valuewhen(filteredTop, high[2], 1)
valuewhen_H2 = ta.valuewhen(filteredTop, high[2], 2)
valuewhen_L0 = ta.valuewhen(filteredBot, low[2], 0)
valuewhen_L1 = ta.valuewhen(filteredBot, low[2], 1)
valuewhen_L2 = ta.valuewhen(filteredBot, low[2], 2)

higherhigh = filteredTop ? (valuewhen_H1 < valuewhen_H0 and valuewhen_H2 < valuewhen_H0) : false
lowerhigh  = filteredTop ? (valuewhen_H1 > valuewhen_H0 and valuewhen_H2 > valuewhen_H0) : false
higherlow  = filteredBot ? (valuewhen_L1 < valuewhen_L0 and valuewhen_L2 < valuewhen_L0) : false
lowerlow   = filteredBot ? (valuewhen_L1 > valuewhen_L0 and valuewhen_L2 > valuewhen_L0) : false

lastTop = ta.valuewhen(filteredTop, high[2], 0)
lastBot = ta.valuewhen(filteredBot, low[2], 0)

// === LOCAL REGIME ===
trendBase = 0
if fastEMA > mediumEMA and pacL > mediumEMA
    trendBase := 1
else if fastEMA < mediumEMA and pacU < mediumEMA
    trendBase := -1

fastSlopeUp   = fastEMA > fastEMA[slopeLookback]
fastSlopeDown = fastEMA < fastEMA[slopeLookback]
medSlopeUp    = mediumEMA > mediumEMA[slopeLookback]
medSlopeDown  = mediumEMA < mediumEMA[slopeLookback]

localRegime = 0
if trendBase == 1
    localRegime := useSlopeFilter ? (fastSlopeUp and medSlopeUp ? 1 : 0) : 1
else if trendBase == -1
    localRegime := useSlopeFilter ? (fastSlopeDown and medSlopeDown ? -1 : 0) : -1

// === OPTIONAL NON-REPAINT HTF BIAS ===

htfFastEMA   = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(close, fastEMAlength)[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
htfMediumEMA = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(close, mediumEMAlength)[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
htfPacL      = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(low, HiLoLen)[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
htfPacU      = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(high, HiLoLen)[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

htfFastSlopeUp   = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(close, fastEMAlength)[1] > ta.ema(close, fastEMAlength)[1 + slopeLookback], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
htfFastSlopeDown = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(close, fastEMAlength)[1] < ta.ema(close, fastEMAlength)[1 + slopeLookback], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
htfMedSlopeUp    = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(close, mediumEMAlength)[1] > ta.ema(close, mediumEMAlength)[1 + slopeLookback], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
htfMedSlopeDown  = request.security(sourceTicker, resolvedHTF, ta.ema(close, mediumEMAlength)[1] < ta.ema(close, mediumEMAlength)[1 + slopeLookback], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

htfBase = 0
if htfFastEMA > htfMediumEMA and htfPacL > htfMediumEMA
    htfBase := 1
else if htfFastEMA < htfMediumEMA and htfPacU < htfMediumEMA
    htfBase := -1

htfBias = 0
if htfBase == 1
    htfBias := useHTFSlopeFilter ? (htfFastSlopeUp and htfMedSlopeUp ? 1 : 0) : 1
else if htfBase == -1
    htfBias := useHTFSlopeFilter ? (htfFastSlopeDown and htfMedSlopeDown ? -1 : 0) : -1

trendRegime = 0
if localRegime == 1
    trendRegime := effectiveUseHTFBias ? (htfBias == 1 ? 1 : 0) : 1
else if localRegime == -1
    trendRegime := effectiveUseHTFBias ? (htfBias == -1 ? -1 : 0) : -1

// === PULLBACK SETUP + TRIGGER ===
barsSinceBelowPacC = ta.barssince(srcClose < pacC)
barsSinceAbovePacC = ta.barssince(srcClose > pacC)

pullbackSetupLong  = trendRegime == 1 and barsSinceBelowPacC <= Lookback and (srcLow <= pacU or srcOpen < pacU)
pullbackSetupShort = trendRegime == -1 and barsSinceAbovePacC <= Lookback and (srcHigh >= pacL or srcOpen > pacL)

rangeNow  = srcHigh - srcLow
closeFrac = rangeNow > 0 ? (srcClose - srcLow) / rangeNow : 0.5

closeStrongLong  = srcClose > srcOpen and srcClose > pacU and closeFrac >= triggerCloseFrac
closeStrongShort = srcClose < srcOpen and srcClose < pacL and closeFrac <= (1.0 - triggerCloseFrac)

beatPrevLong  = not usePrevBreakFilt or srcHigh > srcHigh[1]
beatPrevShort = not usePrevBreakFilt or srcLow < srcLow[1]

triggerLong  = pullbackSetupLong and closeStrongLong and beatPrevLong
triggerShort = pullbackSetupShort and closeStrongShort and beatPrevShort

// === SIGNAL ENGINE (UPDATED V2.0 CORE) ===
var int tradeDirection = 0
prevTradeDirection = nz(tradeDirection[1], 0)
longPacFailBar  = prevTradeDirection == 1 and srcClose < pacC
shortPacFailBar = prevTradeDirection == -1 and srcClose > pacC

newTradeDirection = prevTradeDirection
if longPacFailBar
    newTradeDirection := 0
else if shortPacFailBar
    newTradeDirection := 0
else if prevTradeDirection == 0 and triggerLong
    newTradeDirection := 1
else if prevTradeDirection == 0 and triggerShort
    newTradeDirection := -1

tradeDirection := newTradeDirection

longEvent  = prevTradeDirection == 0 and tradeDirection == 1
shortEvent = prevTradeDirection == 0 and tradeDirection == -1

// === OPTIONAL REVERSAL MODULE (SEPARATE FROM CONTINUATION) ===
reversalCloseStrongLong  = srcClose > srcOpen and srcClose > pacC and closeFrac >= triggerCloseFrac
reversalCloseStrongShort = srcClose < srcOpen and srcClose < pacC and closeFrac <= (1.0 - triggerCloseFrac)

reversalBeatPrevLong  = not usePrevBreakFilt or srcHigh > srcHigh[1]
reversalBeatPrevShort = not usePrevBreakFilt or srcLow < srcLow[1]

reversalLocalLongOK  = reversalRequireOppLocal ? localRegime == 1 : srcClose > mediumEMA
reversalLocalShortOK = reversalRequireOppLocal ? localRegime == -1 : srcClose < mediumEMA

reversalHTFLongOK  = not effectiveUseHTFBias or (reversalAllowHTFNeutral ? htfBias >= 0 : htfBias == 1)
reversalHTFShortOK = not effectiveUseHTFBias or (reversalAllowHTFNeutral ? htfBias <= 0 : htfBias == -1)

reversalLongEvent  = enableReversalModule and shortPacFailBar and reversalCloseStrongLong and reversalBeatPrevLong and reversalLocalLongOK and reversalHTFLongOK
reversalShortEvent = enableReversalModule and longPacFailBar and reversalCloseStrongShort and reversalBeatPrevShort and reversalLocalShortOK and reversalHTFShortOK

entryLongEvent  = longEvent or reversalLongEvent
entryShortEvent = shortEvent or reversalShortEvent

// === STOP ENGINE ===
longStopSwingRaw  = nz(lastBot) * (1.0 - swingPadPct / 100.0)
shortStopSwingRaw = nz(lastTop) * (1.0 + swingPadPct / 100.0)
longStopPacRaw    = pacL * (1.0 - pacPadPct / 100.0)
shortStopPacRaw   = pacU * (1.0 + pacPadPct / 100.0)

longStopSwing  = na(lastBot) ? longStopPacRaw : longStopSwingRaw
shortStopSwing = na(lastTop) ? shortStopPacRaw : shortStopSwingRaw

longStopCandidate = stopMode == "Swing" ? longStopSwing : stopMode == "PAC" ? longStopPacRaw : math.min(longStopSwing, longStopPacRaw)
shortStopCandidate = stopMode == "Swing" ? shortStopSwing : stopMode == "PAC" ? shortStopPacRaw : math.max(shortStopSwing, shortStopPacRaw)

// === EXECUTION STATE ===
var bool armLongOrder = false
var bool armShortOrder = false
var float armLongEntry = na
var float armShortEntry = na
var float armLongStop = na
var float armShortStop = na
var int armLongBar = na
var int armShortBar = na
var string armLongReason = ""
var string armShortReason = ""

var float activeLongStop = na
var float activeShortStop = na

canOperate = not DelayArrow or barstate.isconfirmed

longEntryStopPrice = srcHigh + entryStopTicks * syminfo.mintick
shortEntryStopPrice = srcLow - entryStopTicks * syminfo.mintick

// === ARM / CANCEL HELPERS ===
if entryLongEvent and canOperate
    strategy.cancel("Short")
    armShortOrder := false
    armShortEntry := na
    armShortStop := na
    armShortBar := na
    armShortReason := ""

    if mode == "Conservative"
        if strategy.position_size < 0
            strategy.close("Short", comment="Opp Signal Close")
            armLongOrder := true
            armLongEntry := longEntryStopPrice
            armLongStop := longStopCandidate
            armLongBar := bar_index
            armLongReason := reversalLongEvent ? "REV" : "CONT"
        else if strategy.position_size == 0
            armLongOrder := true
            armLongEntry := longEntryStopPrice
            armLongStop := longStopCandidate
            armLongBar := bar_index
            armLongReason := reversalLongEvent ? "REV" : "CONT"
    else
        if strategy.position_size < 0
            strategy.close("Short", comment="Flip to Long")
        armLongOrder := true
        armLongEntry := longEntryStopPrice
        armLongStop := longStopCandidate
        armLongBar := bar_index
        armLongReason := reversalLongEvent ? "REV" : "CONT"

if entryShortEvent and canOperate
    strategy.cancel("Long")
    armLongOrder := false
    armLongEntry := na
    armLongStop := na
    armLongBar := na
    armLongReason := ""

    if mode == "Conservative"
        if strategy.position_size > 0
            strategy.close("Long", comment="Opp Signal Close")
            armShortOrder := true
            armShortEntry := shortEntryStopPrice
            armShortStop := shortStopCandidate
            armShortBar := bar_index
            armShortReason := reversalShortEvent ? "REV" : "CONT"
        else if strategy.position_size == 0
            armShortOrder := true
            armShortEntry := shortEntryStopPrice
            armShortStop := shortStopCandidate
            armShortBar := bar_index
            armShortReason := reversalShortEvent ? "REV" : "CONT"
    else
        if strategy.position_size > 0
            strategy.close("Long", comment="Flip to Short")
        armShortOrder := true
        armShortEntry := shortEntryStopPrice
        armShortStop := shortStopCandidate
        armShortBar := bar_index
        armShortReason := reversalShortEvent ? "REV" : "CONT"

// === ORDER EXPIRY ===
longExpired = armLongOrder and not na(armLongBar) and bar_index - armLongBar > entryExpiryBars
shortExpired = armShortOrder and not na(armShortBar) and bar_index - armShortBar > entryExpiryBars

if longExpired or entryShortEvent
    strategy.cancel("Long")
    if longExpired
        armLongOrder := false
        armLongEntry := na
        armLongStop := na
        armLongBar := na
        armLongReason := ""

if shortExpired or entryLongEvent
    strategy.cancel("Short")
    if shortExpired
        armShortOrder := false
        armShortEntry := na
        armShortStop := na
        armShortBar := na
        armShortReason := ""

// === SUBMIT STOP ORDERS ===
if canOperate and armLongOrder and strategy.position_size == 0 and not na(armLongEntry)
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, stop=armLongEntry, comment=armLongReason == "REV" ? "Long Reversal" : "Long Trigger")

if canOperate and armShortOrder and strategy.position_size == 0 and not na(armShortEntry)
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, stop=armShortEntry, comment=armShortReason == "REV" ? "Short Reversal" : "Short Trigger")

// === CAPTURE FILLS / FREEZE STOPS ===
posPrev = nz(strategy.position_size[1], 0)
posNow = strategy.position_size

newLongFill = posNow > 0 and posPrev <= 0
newShortFill = posNow < 0 and posPrev >= 0
flatNow = posNow == 0 and posPrev != 0

if newLongFill
    activeLongStop := armLongStop
    activeShortStop := na
    armLongOrder := false
    armLongEntry := na
    armLongBar := na
    armLongReason := ""
    strategy.cancel("Short")
    armShortOrder := false
    armShortEntry := na
    armShortStop := na
    armShortBar := na
    armShortReason := ""

if newShortFill
    activeShortStop := armShortStop
    activeLongStop := na
    armShortOrder := false
    armShortEntry := na
    armShortBar := na
    armShortReason := ""
    strategy.cancel("Long")
    armLongOrder := false
    armLongEntry := na
    armLongStop := na
    armLongBar := na
    armLongReason := ""

if flatNow
    activeLongStop := na
    activeShortStop := na

// === EXITS ===
if strategy.position_size > 0 and not na(activeLongStop)
    strategy.exit("L-SL", from_entry="Long", stop=activeLongStop, comment="Long Stop")

if strategy.position_size < 0 and not na(activeShortStop)
    strategy.exit("S-SL", from_entry="Short", stop=activeShortStop, comment="Short Stop")

if canOperate and exitOnPacCenter and strategy.position_size > 0 and srcClose < pacC
    strategy.close("Long", comment="PAC Fail")
    armLongOrder := false
    armLongEntry := na
    armLongStop := na
    armLongBar := na
    armLongReason := ""

if canOperate and exitOnPacCenter and strategy.position_size < 0 and srcClose > pacC
    strategy.close("Short", comment="PAC Fail")
    armShortOrder := false
    armShortEntry := na
    armShortStop := na
    armShortBar := na
    armShortReason := ""

// === VISUALS ===
plotPacL = plot(pacL, color=color.new(color.gray, 50), linewidth=1, title="High PAC EMA", force_overlay=true)
plotPacU = plot(pacU, color=color.new(color.gray, 50), linewidth=1, title="Low PAC EMA", force_overlay=true)
plotPacC = plot(pacC, color=color.red, linewidth=2, title="Close PAC EMA", force_overlay=true)
fill(plotPacL, plotPacU, color=color.new(color.gray, 90), title="Fill HiLo PAC")

barCol = srcClose > pacU ? color.blue : srcClose < pacL ? color.red : color.gray
barcolor(ShowBarColor ? barCol : na, title="Bar Colours")

bgCol = trendRegime == 1 ? color.green : trendRegime == -1 ? color.red : color.yellow
bgcolor(ShowTrendBGcolor ? color.new(bgCol, 90) : na, title="Trend BG Color", force_overlay=true)

plot(ShowFastEMA ? fastEMA : na, color=color.new(color.green, 20), linewidth=2, title="fastEMA", force_overlay=true)
plot(ShowMediumEMA ? mediumEMA : na, color=color.new(color.blue, 20), linewidth=3, title="mediumEMA", force_overlay=true)
plot(ShowSlowEMA ? slowEMA : na, color=color.new(color.black, 20), linewidth=4, title="slowEMA", force_overlay=true)

plotshape(ShowFractals and filteredTop, title="Filtered Top Fractals", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, offset=-2, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(ShowFractals and filteredBot, title="Filtered Bottom Fractals", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.lime, offset=-2, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)

plotshape(ShowHHLL and higherhigh, title="Higher High", style=shape.square, location=location.abovebar, color=color.maroon, text="[HH]", offset=-2, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(ShowHHLL and lowerhigh, title="Lower High", style=shape.square, location=location.abovebar, color=color.maroon, text="[LH]", offset=-2, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(ShowHHLL and higherlow, title="Higher Low", style=shape.square, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, text="[HL]", offset=-2, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(ShowHHLL and lowerlow, title="Lower Low", style=shape.square, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, text="[LL]", offset=-2, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)

longMarker = ShowBuySell and longEvent
shortMarker = ShowBuySell and shortEvent
reversalLongMarker = ShowBuySell and reversalLongEvent
reversalShortMarker = ShowBuySell and reversalShortEvent
plotshape(longMarker, title="Buy Trigger", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(shortMarker, title="Sell Trigger", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.maroon, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(reversalLongMarker, title="Reversal Long Trigger", style=shape.labelup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.orange, text="RL", textcolor=color.black, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(reversalShortMarker, title="Reversal Short Trigger", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.orange, text="RS", textcolor=color.black, size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)

plotshape(showDebugMarks and pullbackSetupLong, title="Pullback Setup Long", style=shape.circle, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.green, 50), size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(showDebugMarks and pullbackSetupShort, title="Pullback Setup Short", style=shape.circle, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red, 50), size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(showDebugMarks and triggerLong, title="Trigger Long Debug", style=shape.labelup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, text="TL", size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(showDebugMarks and triggerShort, title="Trigger Short Debug", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.maroon, text="TS", size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(showDebugMarks and armLongOrder, title="Armed Long", style=shape.flag, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.green, 0), text="AL", size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(showDebugMarks and armShortOrder, title="Armed Short", style=shape.flag, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0), text="AS", size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(showDebugMarks and reversalLongEvent, title="Reversal Long Debug", style=shape.labelup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.orange, text="RL", size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)
plotshape(showDebugMarks and reversalShortEvent, title="Reversal Short Debug", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.orange, text="RS", size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true)

// === INFO TABLE ===
var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 15, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 78), frame_color=color.new(color.gray, 70), border_width=1)
if barstate.islast
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "Mode", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, mode, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 1, "HA Algo", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 1, UseHAcandles ? "ON" : "OFF", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 2, "Stop", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 2, stopMode, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 3, "PAC Exit", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 3, exitOnPacCenter ? "ON" : "OFF", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 4, "Local Regime", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 4, localRegime == 1 ? "UP" : localRegime == -1 ? "DOWN" : "TRANS", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 5, "MTF Profile", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 5, effectiveUseHTFBias ? mtfBiasProfile : "OFF", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 6, "HTF TF", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 6, effectiveUseHTFBias ? resolvedHTF : "-", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 7, "HTF Bias", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 7, effectiveUseHTFBias ? (htfBias == 1 ? "UP" : htfBias == -1 ? "DOWN" : "TRANS") : "OFF", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 8, "Trend Regime", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 8, trendRegime == 1 ? "UP" : trendRegime == -1 ? "DOWN" : "TRANS", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 9, "Trigger", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 9, longEvent ? "LONG" : shortEvent ? "SHORT" : reversalLongEvent ? "REV-L" : reversalShortEvent ? "REV-S" : "-", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 10, "Arm", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 10, armLongOrder ? ("LONG-" + armLongReason) : armShortOrder ? ("SHORT-" + armShortReason) : "-", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 11, "Long Stop", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 11, na(activeLongStop) ? str.tostring(longStopCandidate, format.mintick) : str.tostring(activeLongStop, format.mintick), text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 12, "Short Stop", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 12, na(activeShortStop) ? str.tostring(shortStopCandidate, format.mintick) : str.tostring(activeShortStop, format.mintick), text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 13, "Rev Module", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 13, enableReversalModule ? "ON" : "OFF", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 14, "PAC Fail", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 14, longPacFailBar ? "LONG FAIL" : shortPacFailBar ? "SHORT FAIL" : "-", text_color=color.white)

scripts.source:
//@version=6
indicator("SignalGate Dashboard v4.9.1", shorttitle="SGD v4.9.1", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=50)
sgDashVer = "4.9.1"


//====================================================
// GROUP: 1) Profiles & Timeframes
//====================================================
group_profile = "1) Profiles & Timeframes"

profile      = input.string("Balanced", "Profile", options=["Sniper","Balanced","Aggressive"], group=group_profile, display=display.none)

// Timeframes
tf_bias1     = input.timeframe("240", "Bias TF #1 (4H)", group=group_profile, display=display.none)
tf_bias2     = input.timeframe("D",   "Bias TF #2 (Daily)", group=group_profile, display=display.none)
tf_struct    = input.timeframe("240", "Structure TF (MTF swings)", group=group_profile, display=display.none)
autoStructTF  = input.bool(true, "Auto Structure TF (recommended)", group=group_profile, display=display.none)

autoTriggerTF = input.bool(true, "Auto Trigger TF (recommended)", group=group_profile, display=display.none)
tf_trigger   = input.timeframe("60",  "Trigger TF (manual)", group=group_profile, display=display.none)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 2) Core Parameters
//====================================================
group_core = "2) Core Parameters"

atrLen       = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=5, group=group_core, display=display.none)
rangeLen     = input.int(40, "Range Window (Trigger TF)", minval=20, group=group_core, display=display.none)
pivotL       = input.int(3,  "Pivot Left (Structure TF)", minval=1, maxval=10, group=group_core, display=display.none)
pivotR       = input.int(3,  "Pivot Right (Structure TF)", minval=1, maxval=10, group=group_core, display=display.none)

useWeeklyVW  = input.bool(true, "Use Weekly Anchored VWAP", group=group_core, display=display.none)
useMonthlyVW = input.bool(true, "Use Monthly Anchored VWAP", group=group_core, display=display.none)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 3) Gates & Thresholds
//====================================================
group_gates = "3) Gates & Thresholds (reset on Profile change)"

enableManualThresholds = input.bool(false, "Enable manual thresholds (advanced)", group=group_gates, tooltip="If OFF, GO/WATCH thresholds use the Profile presets. If ON, you can set them below. Effective values still reset when Profile changes.", display=display.none)
goTh_in   = input.int(8, "GO threshold", minval=1, maxval=20, group=group_gates, display=display.none)
watchTh_in= input.int(6, "WATCH threshold", minval=1, maxval=20, group=group_gates, display=display.none)
enableEarlyState = input.bool(true, "Enable EARLY state", group=group_gates, tooltip="Shows pre-GO directional readiness when score is just below GO and trigger/bias are aligned.", display=display.none)
earlyGapPts = input.int(1, "EARLY gap below GO", minval=1, maxval=4, group=group_gates, display=display.none)
requireTriggerForEarly = input.bool(true, "EARLY requires Trigger/IN_PLAY", group=group_gates, display=display.none)
g5SpaceATR_in = input.float(1.20, "G5 Space min (x ATR)", minval=0.10, step=0.05, group=group_gates, display=display.none)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 4) Trigger Engine
//====================================================
group_trigger = "4) Trigger Engine (reset on Profile change)"

retestTolATR_in = input.float(0.2, "Retest tolerance (x ATR on trigger TF)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=group_trigger, display=display.none)
inPlayBars_in   = input.int(6, "IN_PLAY duration (trigger bars)", minval=1, group=group_trigger, display=display.none)
fakeoutBars_in  = input.int(3, "Fakeout window (trigger bars)", minval=1, group=group_trigger, display=display.none)
invalidExtraATR_in = input.float(0.10, "Invalid extra buffer (x ATR on trigger TF)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=group_trigger, display=display.none)

useMSSFilter = input.bool(true, "MSS Filter (ATR displacement)", group=group_trigger, display=display.none)
mssAtrMult   = input.float(0.6, "MSS min displacement (x ATR)", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=group_trigger, display=display.none)

stateHoldBars_in = input.int(8, "State color hold (bars)", minval=1, group=group_trigger, display=display.none)
flashBars_in     = input.int(6, "Fakeout flash bars", minval=1, group=group_trigger, display=display.none)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 5) Panel UI
//====================================================
group_panel = "5) Panel UI"

showPanel      = input.bool(true, "Show Panel", group=group_panel, display=display.none)
panelPos       = input.string("Top Right", "Panel position",
     options=["Top Right","Top Left","Bottom Right","Bottom Left","Middle Right","Middle Left","Top Center","Bottom Center"], group=group_panel, display=display.none)
panelCompact   = input.bool(true, "Panel Compact Mode (6 lines)", group=group_panel, display=display.none)
panelTextSize  = input.string("Small", "Panel text size", options=["Tiny","Small","Normal"], group=group_panel, display=display.none)

panelBgAlpha   = input.int(85, "Panel background alpha (0 opaque → 100 transparent)", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_panel, display=display.none)
panelTextAlpha = input.int(0,  "Panel text alpha (0 opaque → 100 transparent)", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_panel, display=display.none)

//====================================================
// GROUP: 6) Chart Visuals
//====================================================
group_vis = "6) Chart Visuals"

showBiasLines    = input.bool(true, "Show Bias Lines (EMA200 4H/D)", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
showAnchoredVWAP = input.bool(true, "Show Anchored VWAP (W/M)", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
showStructure    = input.bool(true, "Show Structure (levels + markers)", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
showTriggerBox   = input.bool(true, "Show Trigger Range (Lines/Fill)", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
fillRangeArea    = input.bool(false, "Fill Range Area (transparent)", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
showRangeLines   = input.bool(true, "Range Lines", group=group_vis, display=display.none)

paintGO          = input.bool(true, "Paint Background on GO", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
goBgAlpha        = input.int(92, "GO background tint alpha", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_vis, display=display.none)

showInPlayLine   = input.bool(true, "Show IN_PLAY level line", group=group_vis, display=display.none)

signalTextAlpha  = input.int(0,  "Marker text alpha (0 opaque → 100 transparent)", minval=0, maxval=100, group=group_vis, display=display.none)
showSignalsOnlyWhenRelevant = input.bool(true, "Show markers only on WATCH/GO", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
markerSizeSmall = input.bool(false, "Marker size: Small (else Tiny)", group=group_vis, display=display.none)


// BOS display controls (visual-only; core logic untouched)
bosDisplayMode = input.string("Auto by Mode", "BOS display mode", options=["Always ON","Always OFF","Auto by Mode"], group=group_vis, tooltip="Always ON: show all BOS markers. Always OFF: hide BOS markers. Auto by Mode: show BOS in Mode A; in Modes B/C keep only the most recent N BOS bars.", display=display.none)
bosKeepBars    = input.int(50, "Keep last BOS bars (Auto by Mode)", minval=1, maxval=500, group=group_vis, display=display.none)
bosMinMoveATR  = input.float(0.0, "bosMinMoveATR (x ATR) — anti-spam (display only)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=group_vis, tooltip="Filters BOS marker display only. 0.0 = no filtering. Try 0.1–0.3 for less noise.", display=display.none)

biasColor4H    = input.color(color.orange, "EMA200 4H color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
biasColorD     = input.color(color.red,    "EMA200 D color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
vwapColorW     = input.color(color.aqua,   "aVWAP Weekly color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
vwapColorM     = input.color(color.purple, "aVWAP Monthly color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)

structResColor = input.color(color.new(color.blue, 0), "Structure RES line color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
structSupColor = input.color(color.new(color.teal, 0), "Structure SUP line color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
structLineStyle= input.string("Solid",  "Structure line style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], group=group_vis, display=display.none)

rangeNormalHi  = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "Range High normal", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
rangeNormalLo  = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "Range Low normal", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
rangeBreakHi   = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 0), "Range High on Break", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
rangeBreakLo   = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 0), "Range Low on Break", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
rangeRetHi     = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "Range High on Retest", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
rangeRetLo     = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "Range Low on Retest", group=group_vis, display=display.none)

rangeLineStyle = input.string("Dashed", "Range line style", options=["Solid","Dashed","Dotted"], group=group_vis, display=display.none)

inPlayColor    = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "IN_PLAY line color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)
fakeoutColor   = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0), "Fakeout flash color", group=group_vis, display=display.none)

//====================================================
// Profile Presets (reset-on-profile-change behavior)
//====================================================
var string prevProfile = na

// Presets (effective when no manual override is active)
var float retestTolATR_p = na
var int   inPlayBars_p   = na
var int   fakeoutBars_p  = na
var int   stateHoldBars_p= na
var int   flashBars_p    = na
var int   goThPreset     = na
var int   watchThPreset  = na

// Manual override latch:
// - After a Profile switch: overrides are OFF (presets take over)
// - If you change any override input: overrides turn ON until next Profile switch
var bool overridesOn = false
var float last_retestTol = na
var int   last_inPlayBars = na
var int   last_fakeoutBars = na
var int   last_stateHold = na
var int   last_flashBars = na
var int   last_goTh = na
var int   last_watchTh = na

// Apply presets when profile changes (or first run)
profileChanged = na(prevProfile) or profile != prevProfile
if profileChanged
    overridesOn := false

    if profile == "Sniper"
        retestTolATR_p := 0.15
        inPlayBars_p   := 5
        fakeoutBars_p  := 3
        stateHoldBars_p:= 10
        flashBars_p    := 8
        goThPreset     := 9
        watchThPreset  := 7
    else if profile == "Aggressive"
        retestTolATR_p := 0.25
        inPlayBars_p   := 8
        fakeoutBars_p  := 2
        stateHoldBars_p:= 7
        flashBars_p    := 5
        goThPreset     := 7
        watchThPreset  := 5
    else
        // Balanced
        retestTolATR_p := 0.20
        inPlayBars_p   := 6
        fakeoutBars_p  := 3
        stateHoldBars_p:= 8
        flashBars_p    := 6
        goThPreset     := 8
        watchThPreset  := 6

    // Sync "last seen" inputs so switching profile doesn't instantly count as a manual edit
    last_retestTol := retestTolATR_in
    last_inPlayBars := inPlayBars_in
    last_fakeoutBars := fakeoutBars_in
    last_stateHold := stateHoldBars_in
    last_flashBars := flashBars_in
    last_goTh := goTh_in
    last_watchTh := watchTh_in

    prevProfile := profile

// Detect manual edits (latch ON)
if not overridesOn
    edited = (retestTolATR_in != last_retestTol) or (inPlayBars_in != last_inPlayBars) or (fakeoutBars_in != last_fakeoutBars) or (stateHoldBars_in != last_stateHold) or (flashBars_in != last_flashBars)
    edited := edited or (enableManualThresholds and ((goTh_in != last_goTh) or (watchTh_in != last_watchTh)))
    if edited
        overridesOn := true

// Update last seen inputs (always)
last_retestTol := retestTolATR_in
last_inPlayBars := inPlayBars_in
last_fakeoutBars := fakeoutBars_in
last_stateHold := stateHoldBars_in
last_flashBars := flashBars_in
last_goTh := goTh_in
last_watchTh := watchTh_in

// Effective values
retestTolATR = overridesOn ? retestTolATR_in : retestTolATR_p
inPlayBars   = overridesOn ? inPlayBars_in   : inPlayBars_p
fakeoutBars  = overridesOn ? fakeoutBars_in  : fakeoutBars_p
stateHoldBars= overridesOn ? stateHoldBars_in: stateHoldBars_p
flashBars    = overridesOn ? flashBars_in    : flashBars_p

goTh    = (enableManualThresholds and overridesOn) ? goTh_in : goThPreset
watchTh = (enableManualThresholds and overridesOn) ? watchTh_in : watchThPreset
invalidExtraATR = invalidExtraATR_in
g5SpaceATR = g5SpaceATR_in
//====================================================
// Helpers
//====================================================
f_sec(_tf, _expr) =>
    request.security(syminfo.tickerid, _tf, _expr, barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

string tf_trigger_eff = tf_trigger
if autoTriggerTF
    if timeframe.isintraday
        tf_trigger_eff := "60"
    else if timeframe.isdaily
        tf_trigger_eff := "240"
    else
        tf_trigger_eff := "D"

// Auto structure TF mapping
string tf_struct_eff = tf_struct
if autoStructTF
    if timeframe.isintraday
        tf_struct_eff := "240"
    else if timeframe.isdaily
        tf_struct_eff := "D"
    else if timeframe.isweekly
        tf_struct_eff := "W"
    else
        // monthly and higher
        tf_struct_eff := "M"

// Panel position mapping
pos = position.top_right
if panelPos == "Top Left"
    pos := position.top_left
else if panelPos == "Bottom Right"
    pos := position.bottom_right
else if panelPos == "Bottom Left"
    pos := position.bottom_left
else if panelPos == "Middle Right"
    pos := position.middle_right
else if panelPos == "Middle Left"
    pos := position.middle_left
else if panelPos == "Top Center"
    pos := position.top_center
else if panelPos == "Bottom Center"
    pos := position.bottom_center

pTextSize = panelTextSize == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : panelTextSize == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.small
mSizeSmall = markerSizeSmall
f_lstyle(_s) =>
    _s == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : _s == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid

var float[] swingHighHist = array.new_float()
var float[] swingLowHist  = array.new_float()

f_push_unique(_arr, _v, _cap) =>
    if not na(_v)
        _n = array.size(_arr)
        _same = _n > 0 and array.get(_arr, _n - 1) == _v
        if not _same
            array.push(_arr, _v)
            if array.size(_arr) > _cap
                array.shift(_arr)

f_next_above(_arr, _px) =>
    float _best = na
    _n = array.size(_arr)
    if _n > 0
        for i = 0 to _n - 1
            _v = array.get(_arr, i)
            if _v > _px
                if na(_best) or _v < _best
                    _best := _v
    _best

f_next_below(_arr, _px) =>
    float _best = na
    _n = array.size(_arr)
    if _n > 0
        for i = 0 to _n - 1
            _v = array.get(_arr, i)
            if _v < _px
                if na(_best) or _v > _best
                    _best := _v
    _best

rngStyle = f_lstyle(rangeLineStyle)
stStyle  = f_lstyle(structLineStyle)

//====================================================
// Anchored VWAP
//====================================================
f_anchored_vwap(_anchorTf) =>
    pid = time(_anchorTf)
    var int lastPid = na
    var float cumPV = na
    var float cumV  = na
    newPeriod = na(lastPid) or pid != lastPid
    lastPid := pid
    if newPeriod or na(cumPV) or na(cumV)
        cumPV := hlc3 * volume
        cumV  := volume
    else
        cumPV += hlc3 * volume
        cumV  += volume
    cumPV / math.max(cumV, 1)

//====================================================
// Gate 1: Bias
//====================================================
ema200_4h = f_sec(tf_bias1, ta.ema(close, 200))
ema200_d  = f_sec(tf_bias2, ta.ema(close, 200))

wvwap = (useWeeklyVW  ? f_anchored_vwap("W") : na)
mvwap = (useMonthlyVW ? f_anchored_vwap("M") : na)

biasLong  = close > ema200_4h and close > ema200_d
biasShort = close < ema200_4h and close < ema200_d

vwapLong  = (not useWeeklyVW or close > wvwap) and (not useMonthlyVW or close > mvwap)
vwapShort = (not useWeeklyVW or close < wvwap) and (not useMonthlyVW or close < mvwap)

//====================================================
// Gate 2: Structure
//====================================================
ph_s = f_sec(tf_struct_eff, ta.pivothigh(high, pivotL, pivotR))
pl_s = f_sec(tf_struct_eff, ta.pivotlow(low,  pivotL, pivotR))

var float lastSwingHigh = na
var float lastSwingLow  = na
if not na(ph_s)
    lastSwingHigh := ph_s
    f_push_unique(swingHighHist, ph_s, 120)
if not na(pl_s)
    lastSwingLow := pl_s
    f_push_unique(swingLowHist, pl_s, 120)

bosUp   = not na(lastSwingHigh) and close > lastSwingHigh
bosDown = not na(lastSwingLow)  and close < lastSwingLow


// BOS events (true only on the first bar of a break)
bosUpEvt   = bosUp   and not bosUp[1]
bosDownEvt = bosDown and not bosDown[1]

// BOS events (use events for range logic)

// Structure state (st) and CHoCH must be computed against the PREVIOUS state.
// Otherwise CHoCH can never trigger because st is already updated on the same bar.
var int st = 0
int prevSt = st
if bosUp
    st := 1
else if bosDown
    st := -1

chochUp_raw   = (prevSt == -1) and bosUp
chochDown_raw = (prevSt == 1)  and bosDown

atr    = ta.atr(atrLen)
atrPct = atr / close
ema50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
trendFlat = math.abs(ta.change(ema50, 10)) / close < 0.005
isRange   = (atrPct < 0.015) and trendFlat and (not bosUpEvt) and (not bosDownEvt)

disp  = math.abs(close - close[1])
mssOk = disp >= (mssAtrMult * atr)

chochUp   = useMSSFilter ? (chochUp_raw and mssOk) : chochUp_raw
chochDown = useMSSFilter ? (chochDown_raw and mssOk) : chochDown_raw

modeB = isRange
modeC = chochUp or chochDown

chochUpEvt   = chochUp and not chochUp[1]
chochDownEvt = chochDown and not chochDown[1]

string mssStatus = "—"
if useMSSFilter
    if chochUp_raw or chochDown_raw
        mssStatus := mssOk ? "PASS" : "BLOCK"
    else
        mssStatus := "IDLE"
else
    mssStatus := "OFF"

//====================================================
// Gate 3: Trigger + IN_PLAY + Fakeout
//====================================================
atr_t       = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.atr(atrLen))
rangeHigh_t = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.highest(high, rangeLen))
rangeLow_t  = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.lowest(low,  rangeLen))

close_t  = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, close)
high_t   = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, high)
low_t    = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, low)
time_t   = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, time)

rh_prev     = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.highest(high, rangeLen)[1])
rl_prev     = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, ta.lowest(low,  rangeLen)[1])
close_prev  = f_sec(tf_trigger_eff, close[1])

breakUp   = close_t > rh_prev and close_prev <= rh_prev
breakDown = close_t < rl_prev and close_prev >= rl_prev

breakUpEvt    = breakUp and not breakUp[1]
breakDownEvt  = breakDown and not breakDown[1]

// Fixed breakout levels for retest (avoid drifting rangeHigh_t/rangeLow_t after the breakout)
var float brokenHigh = na
var float brokenLow  = na
if breakUpEvt
    brokenHigh := rh_prev
if breakDownEvt
    brokenLow := rl_prev

tol = retestTolATR * atr_t
retestUp   = (not na(brokenHigh)) and (low_t <= (brokenHigh + tol)) and (close_t > brokenHigh)
retestDown = (not na(brokenLow))  and (high_t >= (brokenLow - tol)) and (close_t < brokenLow)

retestUpEvt   = retestUp and not retestUp[1]
retestDownEvt = retestDown and not retestDown[1]

var int lastTrigTime = na
newTrigBar = na(lastTrigTime) or time_t != lastTrigTime
if newTrigBar
    lastTrigTime := time_t

var int   inDir = 0
var float inLvl = na
var int   inTTL = 0
var int   inFakeTTL = 0

if newTrigBar
    if inTTL > 0
        inTTL -= 1
    if inFakeTTL > 0
        inFakeTTL -= 1
    if inTTL <= 0
        inDir := 0
        inLvl := na
        inFakeTTL := 0

if breakUpEvt or retestUpEvt
    inDir := 1
    inLvl := brokenHigh
    inTTL := inPlayBars
    inFakeTTL := fakeoutBars

if breakDownEvt or retestDownEvt
    inDir := -1
    inLvl := brokenLow
    inTTL := inPlayBars
    inFakeTTL := fakeoutBars

fakeout = false
invalid = false
invBuf = atr_t * invalidExtraATR

fakeoutLong = inDir == 1 and not na(inLvl) and inFakeTTL > 0 and close_t < inLvl
fakeoutShort = inDir == -1 and not na(inLvl) and inFakeTTL > 0 and close_t > inLvl
invalidLong = inDir == 1 and not na(inLvl) and close_t < (inLvl - invBuf)
invalidShort = inDir == -1 and not na(inLvl) and close_t > (inLvl + invBuf)

fakeout := (fakeoutLong and not invalidLong) or (fakeoutShort and not invalidShort)
invalid := invalidLong or invalidShort

if invalid
    inDir := 0
    inLvl := na
    inTTL := 0
    inFakeTTL := 0

triggerLong  = (breakUp or retestUp) or (inDir == 1)
triggerShort = (breakDown or retestDown) or (inDir == -1)

string inPlayStatus = (inDir == 1) ? ("LONG(" + str.tostring(inTTL) + ")") : (inDir == -1) ? ("SHORT(" + str.tostring(inTTL) + ")") : "OFF"

//====================================================
// Gate 4: Momentum
//====================================================
[macdLine, signalLine, hist] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
histSlope = hist - hist[1]
rsi = ta.rsi(close, 14)

momLong  = (hist > 0 and histSlope > 0) and (rsi >= 50)
momShort = (hist < 0 and histSlope < 0) and (rsi <= 50)

//====================================================
// Gate 5: Zones + Space
//====================================================
nearestRes = lastSwingHigh
nearestSup = lastSwingLow

nextWallRes = f_next_above(swingHighHist, close)
nextWallSup = f_next_below(swingLowHist, close)

distToResATR = not na(nextWallRes) ? math.abs(nextWallRes - close) / atr : na
distToSupATR = not na(nextWallSup) ? math.abs(close - nextWallSup) / atr : na

spaceLong  = not na(nextWallRes) ? ((nextWallRes > close) and ((nextWallRes - close) / atr >= g5SpaceATR)) : true
spaceShort = not na(nextWallSup) ? ((nextWallSup < close) and ((close - nextWallSup) / atr >= g5SpaceATR)) : true

//====================================================
// Scoring
//====================================================
int scoreLong  = 0
int scoreShort = 0

scoreLong  += biasLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += biasShort ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += vwapLong  ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += vwapShort ? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += (st == 1)  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += (st == -1) ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += (modeC and chochUp)   ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += (modeC and chochDown) ? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += triggerLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += triggerShort ? 2 : 0
scoreLong  += (inDir == 1) ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += (inDir == -1)? 1 : 0

scoreLong  += momLong  ? 2 : 0
scoreShort += momShort ? 2 : 0

scoreLong  += spaceLong  ? 1 : 0
scoreShort += spaceShort ? 1 : 0

if fakeout
    scoreLong  := math.max(scoreLong - 2, 0)
    scoreShort := math.max(scoreShort - 2, 0)

conflict = (biasLong and st == -1) or (biasShort and st == 1)
conflictPenalty = profile == "Sniper" ? 2 : 1
if conflict
    scoreLong  := math.max(scoreLong  - conflictPenalty, 0)
    scoreShort := math.max(scoreShort - conflictPenalty, 0)

maxScore = math.max(scoreLong, scoreShort)


//====================================================

rawVerdict = "NO-TRADE"
if scoreLong >= scoreShort and scoreLong >= goTh
    rawVerdict := "LONG"
else if scoreShort > scoreLong and scoreShort >= goTh
    rawVerdict := "SHORT"

var string verdict = "NO-TRADE"
prevVerdict = verdict[1]

holdLong  = rawVerdict == "NO-TRADE" and prevVerdict == "LONG"  and scoreLong >= watchTh  and scoreShort < goTh
holdShort = rawVerdict == "NO-TRADE" and prevVerdict == "SHORT" and scoreShort >= watchTh and scoreLong  < goTh

verdict := rawVerdict != "NO-TRADE" ? rawVerdict : holdLong ? "LONG" : holdShort ? "SHORT" : "NO-TRADE"

earlyTh = math.max(watchTh, goTh - earlyGapPts)
readyPctLong  = goTh > 0 ? math.min(100.0, (scoreLong  * 100.0) / goTh) : 0.0
readyPctShort = goTh > 0 ? math.min(100.0, (scoreShort * 100.0) / goTh) : 0.0

earlyLong  = enableEarlyState and verdict == "NO-TRADE" and scoreLong > scoreShort and scoreLong >= earlyTh and biasLong  and st != -1 and (not requireTriggerForEarly or triggerLong  or inDir == 1)
earlyShort = enableEarlyState and verdict == "NO-TRADE" and scoreShort > scoreLong and scoreShort >= earlyTh and biasShort and st != 1  and (not requireTriggerForEarly or triggerShort or inDir == -1)

string state = "⛔ NO-TRADE"
if verdict != "NO-TRADE"
    state := "✅ GO"
else if earlyLong
    state := "🟡 EARLY LONG"
else if earlyShort
    state := "🟡 EARLY SHORT"
else if maxScore >= watchTh
    state := "⚠️ WATCH"

string quality = "—"
if maxScore >= (goTh + 2)
    quality := "EXCELENTE"
else if maxScore >= goTh
    quality := "BOM"
else if earlyLong or earlyShort
    quality := "EARLY"
else if maxScore >= watchTh
    quality := "REGULAR"

string mode = "A (CONTINUAÇÃO)"
if modeC
    mode := "C (REVERSÃO)"
else if modeB or breakUpEvt or breakDownEvt or retestUpEvt or retestDownEvt or (inDir != 0)
    mode := "B (BREAKOUT)"

relevant = (not showSignalsOnlyWhenRelevant) or (state != "⛔ NO-TRADE")

// Visuals
//====================================================
bgLong  = paintGO and verdict == "LONG"
bgShort = paintGO and verdict == "SHORT"
bgcolor(bgLong ? color.new(color.green, goBgAlpha) : na)
bgcolor(bgShort ? color.new(color.red, goBgAlpha) : na)

plot(showBiasLines ? ema200_4h : na, "EMA200 4H", linewidth=2, color=biasColor4H, display=display.all - display.status_line)
plot(showBiasLines ? ema200_d  : na, "EMA200 D",  linewidth=2, color=biasColorD, display=display.all - display.status_line)

plot(showAnchoredVWAP and useWeeklyVW  ? wvwap : na, "aVWAP Weekly", linewidth=1, color=vwapColorW, display=display.all - display.status_line)
plot(showAnchoredVWAP and useMonthlyVW ? mvwap : na, "aVWAP Monthly", linewidth=1, color=vwapColorM, display=display.all - display.status_line)

// Structure levels
var line lnRes = na
var line lnSup = na

if barstate.islast and showStructure
    if na(lnRes)
        lnRes := line.new(bar_index-200, nearestRes, bar_index, nearestRes, extend=extend.right, style=stStyle, color=structResColor)
    else
        line.set_xy1(lnRes, bar_index-200, nearestRes)
        line.set_xy2(lnRes, bar_index, nearestRes)
        line.set_extend(lnRes, extend.right)
        line.set_style(lnRes, stStyle)
        line.set_color(lnRes, structResColor)

    if na(lnSup)
        lnSup := line.new(bar_index-200, nearestSup, bar_index, nearestSup, extend=extend.right, style=stStyle, color=structSupColor)
    else
        line.set_xy1(lnSup, bar_index-200, nearestSup)
        line.set_xy2(lnSup, bar_index, nearestSup)
        line.set_extend(lnSup, extend.right)
        line.set_style(lnSup, stStyle)
        line.set_color(lnSup, structSupColor)
else if barstate.islast and not showStructure
    if not na(lnRes)
        line.delete(lnRes), lnRes := na
    if not na(lnSup)
        line.delete(lnSup), lnSup := na


//====================================================
// Stacked markers (B/C/K/R) + BOS display mode (visual-only)
//====================================================

// We use labels to allow vertical stacking (no overlap) and to allow pruning BOS history in Auto mode.
var label[] allLabs = array.new<label>()
var label[] bosLabs = array.new<label>()
var int[]   bosBars = array.new<int>()

f_bos_prune_all() =>
    _n = math.min(array.size(bosLabs), array.size(bosBars))
    if _n > 0
        for i = _n - 1 to 0
            lb = array.get(bosLabs, i)
            if not na(lb)
                label.delete(lb)
    array.clear(bosLabs)
    array.clear(bosBars)

f_bos_prune_window(_keepBars) =>
    // Keep only BOS labels whose bar_index is within the last _keepBars bars (relative to the current bar).
    _n = math.min(array.size(bosLabs), array.size(bosBars))
    if _n > 0
        cutoff = bar_index - _keepBars
        for i = _n - 1 to 0
            b = array.get(bosBars, i)
            if b < cutoff
                lb = array.get(bosLabs, i)
                if not na(lb)
                    label.delete(lb)
                array.remove(bosLabs, i)
                array.remove(bosBars, i)

f_bos_limit(_maxKeep) =>
    // Hard cap to avoid hitting label limits.
    while array.size(bosLabs) > _maxKeep and array.size(bosBars) > 0
        lb = array.shift(bosLabs)
        _  = array.shift(bosBars)
        if not na(lb)
            label.delete(lb)

    // Safety resync in case arrays ever diverge.
    while array.size(bosLabs) > array.size(bosBars)
        lb = array.pop(bosLabs)
        if not na(lb)
            label.delete(lb)

    while array.size(bosBars) > array.size(bosLabs)
        _ = array.pop(bosBars)

// BOS display policy (applied on last bar to avoid rewriting core history logic)

bosShowAllowed = bosDisplayMode != "Always OFF"
bosAuto = bosDisplayMode == "Auto by Mode"

bosDownMoveOk = bosMinMoveATR <= 0.0 or (not na(lastSwingLow)  and (lastSwingLow - close)  >= (bosMinMoveATR * atr))

// Label factory (stacked)
f_mk(_isAbove, _y, _txt, _bg) =>
    lb = label.new(bar_index, _y, _txt,
      xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price,
      style=_isAbove ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up,
      color=_bg,
      textcolor=color.new(color.black, signalTextAlpha),
      size=mSizeSmall ? size.small : size.tiny)
    array.push(allLabs, lb)
    lb

// Per-bar stacking counters (reset each bar)
int aboveN = 0
int belowN = 0
gap = atr * 0.60

// --- Order is fixed: B then C then K then R ---

if relevant
    // ===== B (BOS) =====
    if showStructure and bosShowAllowed
        if bosUpEvt and (bosDisplayMode != "Always OFF") and bosUpMoveOk
            aboveN += 1
            y = high + gap * aboveN
            lb = f_mk(true, y, "B↑", color.new(color.white, 0))
            array.push(bosLabs, lb), array.push(bosBars, bar_index)
        if bosDownEvt and (bosDisplayMode != "Always OFF") and bosDownMoveOk
            belowN += 1
            y = low - gap * belowN
            lb = f_mk(false, y, "B↓", color.new(color.white, 0))
            array.push(bosLabs, lb), array.push(bosBars, bar_index)

    // ===== C (CHoCH) =====
    if showStructure
        if chochUpEvt
            aboveN += 1
            y = high + gap * aboveN
            _ = f_mk(true, y, "C↑", color.new(color.yellow, 0))
        if chochDownEvt
            belowN += 1
            y = low - gap * belowN
            _ = f_mk(false, y, "C↓", color.new(color.yellow, 0))

    if showTriggerBox
        // K = Break
        if breakUpEvt
            aboveN += 1
            y = high + gap * aboveN
            _ = f_mk(true, y, "K↑", color.new(color.yellow, 0))
        if breakDownEvt
            belowN += 1
            y = low - gap * belowN
            _ = f_mk(false, y, "K↓", color.new(color.yellow, 0))

        if retestDownEvt

stateTxt = state == "🟡 EARLY LONG" ? "Compra preparando" : state == "🟡 EARLY SHORT" ? "Venda preparando" : state == "⚠️ WATCH" ? "Atenção" : state == "⛔ NO-TRADE" ? "Sem trade" : state
biasTxtPanel = biasLong ? "Alta" : biasShort ? "Baixa" : "Neutro"
structTxtPanel = st==1 ? "Alta" : st==-1 ? "Baixa" : "—"
rangeTxtPanel = modeB ? "Sim" : "Não"
inPlayTxtPanel = inDir!=0 ? "Ativo" : "—"
mini = "Tend.:" + biasTxtPanel + " | Estr.:" + structTxtPanel + " | Gatilho:" + (((sideLong ? triggerLong : sideShort ? triggerShort : (inDir != 0)) ? "ON" : "OFF")) + " | Exec.:" + inPlayTxtPanel

// Mini summary

if barstate.islast and showPanel
    if panelCompact
        // 6-line compact (gate order)
        table.cell(t, 0, 0, "Perfil: " + profileTxt + " | TF: " + tf_trigger_eff + " | Operação: " + verdictTxt + " | " + stateTxt + " | Qual.: " + quality, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 1, "Modo: " + mode + " | Em execução: " + inPlayStatus + (fakeout ? " | Falso romp." : ""), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 2, "G1 Tendência: " + biasTxtPanel + " | aVWAP C/V: " + sAvwapL + " / " + sAvwapS, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 3, "G2 Estrutura: " + structTxtPanel + " | MSS: " + mssStatus + " | Range: " + rangeTxtPanel, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 4, "G3 Gatilho: " + trigType + " | C/V: " + sTrigL + " / " + sTrigS + " | Exec.: " + inPlayTxtPanel, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 5, "Força C/V: " + str.tostring(scoreLong) + " / " + str.tostring(scoreShort) + " | Pronto C/V: " + str.tostring(readyPctLong, "#") + "% / " + str.tostring(readyPctShort, "#") + "% | Mom. C/V: " + sMomL + " / " + sMomS, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        for r = 6 to 9
            table.cell(t, 0, r, "", text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
    else
        // Normal (9 lines) – canonic order: TF → verdict → G1..G5 → scores → conflict → mini
        table.cell(t, 0, 0, "Perfil: " + profileTxt + " | Modo: " + mode, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 1, "Operação: " + verdictTxt + " | " + stateTxt + " | Qual.: " + quality, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 2, "G1 Tendência: " + biasTxtPanel + " | EMA200: " + (biasLong or biasShort ? "OK" : "—") + " | aVWAP C/V: " + sAvwapL + " / " + sAvwapS, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 3, "G2 Estrutura: " + structTxtPanel + " | BOS/CHoCH: " + (bosUpEvt or bosDownEvt or chochUpEvt or chochDownEvt ? "Evento" : "—") + " | MSS: " + mssStatus + " | Range: " + rangeTxtPanel, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 4, "G3 Gatilho: " + trigType + " | C/V: " + sTrigL + " / " + sTrigS + " | Exec.: " + inPlayStatus + (fakeout ? " | Falso romp." : ""), text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 5, "G4 Momento C/V: " + sMomL + " / " + sMomS, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 6, "G5 Espaço ATR (Res/Sup): " + str.tostring(distToResATR, "#.##") + " / " + str.tostring(distToSupATR, "#.##") + " | Espaço C/V: " + sSpaceL + " / " + sSpaceS, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 7, "Força C/V: " + str.tostring(scoreLong) + " / " + str.tostring(scoreShort) + " | Pronto C/V: " + str.tostring(readyPctLong, "#") + "% / " + str.tostring(readyPctShort, "#") + "% | Conflito: " + cStr, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 8, tfLine, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)
        table.cell(t, 0, 9, mini, text_color=panelTxt, bgcolor=panelBg, text_size=pTextSize)

//====================================================
// Alerts — Dashboard (macro / verdict-driven)
//====================================================
groupAD = "Alerts — Dashboard"

// Core (recommended ON)
alGO     = input.bool(true,  "GO alerts (verdict LONG/SHORT)", group=groupAD, display=display.none)
alEarly  = input.bool(true,  "EARLY LONG/SHORT alerts",       group=groupAD, display=display.none)
alWATCH  = input.bool(false, "WATCH alerts",                  group=groupAD, display=display.none)
alFlip   = input.bool(true,  "Verdict flip alerts",           group=groupAD, display=display.none)

// Optional macro debug (recommended OFF)
alMode   = input.bool(false, "Mode change alerts (A/B/C)",    group=groupAD, display=display.none)
alKR     = input.bool(false, "K/R alerts (break/retest)",      group=groupAD, display=display.none)
alFake   = input.bool(false, "Fakeout alerts",                group=groupAD, display=display.none)
alIP     = input.bool(false, "IN_PLAY start/end alerts",      group=groupAD, display=display.none)

// ── Helper: state changes
goLongEvt   = (verdict == "LONG")  and (verdict[1] != "LONG")
goShortEvt  = (verdict == "SHORT") and (verdict[1] != "SHORT")
earlyLongEvt  = (state == "🟡 EARLY LONG")  and (state[1] != "🟡 EARLY LONG")
earlyShortEvt = (state == "🟡 EARLY SHORT") and (state[1] != "🟡 EARLY SHORT")

watchEvt    = (state == "⚠️ WATCH") and (state[1] != "⚠️ WATCH")
noTradeEvt  = (state == "⛔ NO-TRADE") and (state[1] != "⛔ NO-TRADE")

verdictFlip = (verdict != verdict[1])

modeChg     = (mode != mode[1])

ipStartEvt  = (inDir != 0) and (inDir[1] == 0)
ipEndEvt    = (inDir == 0) and (inDir[1] != 0)

// ── GO (entry compass)
alertcondition(alGO and goLongEvt,  "SGD: Compra liberada",  "SGD: ✅ Compra liberada")
alertcondition(alGO and goShortEvt, "SGD: Venda liberada", "SGD: ✅ Venda liberada")

// ── EARLY (pre-GO readiness)
alertcondition(alEarly and earlyLongEvt,  "SGD: Compra preparando",  "SGD: 🟡 Compra preparando")
alertcondition(alEarly and earlyShortEvt, "SGD: Venda preparando", "SGD: 🟡 Venda preparando")

// ── WATCH / NO-TRADE (optional)
alertcondition(alWATCH and watchEvt,   "SGD: Atenção",   "SGD: ⚠️ Atenção")
alertcondition(alWATCH and noTradeEvt, "SGD: Sem trade", "SGD: ⛔ Sem trade")

// ── Verdict flip (macro direction change)
alertcondition(alFlip and verdictFlip, "SGD: Virada de operação", "SGD: Operação mudou")

// ── Mode change (optional)
alertcondition(alMode and modeChg, "SG Dash: Mode Change", "SG Dashboard: Mode changed (A/B/C)")

// ── K/R events from Trigger Engine (optional)
// (your script already has breakUpEvt/breakDownEvt and retestUpEvt/retestDownEvt)
alertcondition(alKR and breakUpEvt,   "SGD: Rompimento ↑",   "SGD: Rompimento para cima")
alertcondition(alKR and breakDownEvt, "SGD: Rompimento ↓", "SGD: Rompimento para baixo")
alertcondition(alKR and retestUpEvt,  "SGD: Reteste ↑",   "SGD: Reteste para alta")
alertcondition(alKR and retestDownEvt,"SGD: Reteste ↓", "SGD: Reteste para baixa")

// ── Fakeout (optional)
alertcondition(alFake and fakeout, "SGD: Falso rompimento", "SGD: Falso rompimento detectado")

// ── IN_PLAY (optional)
alertcondition(alIP and ipStartEvt, "SGD: Execução iniciada", "SGD: Em execução iniciado")
alertcondition(alIP and ipEndEvt,   "SGD: Execução encerrada",   "SGD: Em execução encerrado")

//====================================================
// TELEMETRIA (KV) — Dashboard v4.9.0
// Crie um alerta no TradingView: "Any alert() function call"
//====================================================
groupLOG = "Logs — Dashboard (KV)"
logOn         = input.bool(true,  "Enable KV logs (alert())", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)
logKR         = input.bool(false, "Log K/R (break/retest)", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)
logGO         = input.bool(true,  "Log GO LONG/SHORT", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)
logWatchNT    = input.bool(false, "Log WATCH/NO-TRADE", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)
logModeFlip   = input.bool(false, "Log Mode/Verdict flips", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)
logIP         = input.bool(false, "Log IN_PLAY start/end", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)
logFakeout    = input.bool(false, "Log Fakeout", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)
logHeartbeat  = input.bool(false, "Log HEARTBEAT (debug)", group=groupLOG, display=display.none)

// Helpers
fmt(_x) => na(_x) ? "null" : str.tostring(_x, format.mintick)
b2s(_b) => _b ? "true" : "false"

// Local events (don't depend on alertconditions)
goLongEvt_d   = (verdict == "LONG")  and (verdict[1] != "LONG")
goShortEvt_d  = (verdict == "SHORT") and (verdict[1] != "SHORT")
watchEvt_d    = (state == "⚠️ WATCH")   and (state[1] != "⚠️ WATCH")
noTradeEvt_d  = (state == "⛔ NO-TRADE") and (state[1] != "⛔ NO-TRADE")

verdictFlip_d = (verdict != verdict[1])
modeFlip_d    = (mode != mode[1])

ipStartEvt_d  = (inDir != 0) and (inDir[1] == 0)
ipEndEvt_d    = (inDir == 0) and (inDir[1] != 0)

// LOG builder (single line) — KV via str.format (Pine-safe)
esc(_s) =>
    str.replace_all(_s, "|", "/")

mkDash(_evt) =>
    "SG|SRC=DASH|VER=" + sgDashVer + str.format(
     "|ALFREQ=BARCLOSE|EVT={0}|SYM={1}|EX={2}|TF={3}|T={4}|PX={5}|PROFILE={6}|STATE={7}|VERDICT={8}|QUAL={9}|MODE={10}|SCL={11}|SCS={12}|GOTH={13}|WTH={14}|BIASL={15}|BIASS={16}|ST={17}|TRIGTF={18}|STRUCTTF={19}|INDIR={20}|INTTL={21}|INLVL={22}|FAKE={23}|INV={24}",
     esc(_evt),
     esc(syminfo.ticker),
     esc(syminfo.prefix),
     esc(timeframe.period),
     str.tostring(time),
     str.tostring(close, format.mintick),
     esc(profile),
     esc(state),
     esc(verdict),
     esc(quality),
     esc(mode),
     str.tostring(scoreLong),
     str.tostring(scoreShort),
     str.tostring(goTh),
     str.tostring(watchTh),
     biasLong ? "1" : "0",
     biasShort ? "1" : "0",
     str.tostring(st),
     esc(tf_trigger_eff),
     esc(tf_struct_eff),
     str.tostring(inDir),
     str.tostring(inTTL),
     na(inLvl) ? "na" : str.tostring(inLvl, format.mintick),
     fakeout ? "1" : "0",
     invalid ? "1" : "0"
    )

if logOn
    if logHeartbeat
        alert(mkDash("HEARTBEAT"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    // State/Verdict (macro)
    if logGO
        if goLongEvt_d
            alert(mkDash("GO_LONG"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        if goShortEvt_d
            alert(mkDash("GO_SHORT"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    if logWatchNT
        if watchEvt_d
            alert(mkDash("WATCH"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        if noTradeEvt_d
            alert(mkDash("NO_TRADE"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

    // Mode/Verdict flips (macro)
    if logModeFlip
        if verdictFlip_d
            alert(mkDash("VERDICT_FLIP"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        if modeFlip_d
            alert(mkDash("MODE_FLIP"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

    // K/R events (trigger engine)
    if logKR
        if breakUpEvt
            alert(mkDash("K_UP"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        if breakDownEvt
            alert(mkDash("K_DOWN"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        if retestUpEvt
            alert(mkDash("R_UP"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        if retestDownEvt
            alert(mkDash("R_DOWN"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

    // IN_PLAY start/end
    if logIP
        if ipStartEvt_d
            alert(mkDash("IN_PLAY_START"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
        if ipEndEvt_d
            alert(mkDash("IN_PLAY_END"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

    // Fakeout
    if logFakeout and fakeout and not fakeout[1]
        alert(mkDash("FAKEOUT"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

metadata.scriptName: .SMC Market Structure (HH/HL/LH/LL + BOS/CHoCH/MSS) de CptRedd copiar

scripts.source:
//@version=5
indicator("SMC Market Structure (HH/HL/LH/LL + BOS/CHoCH/MSS)", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Inputs
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
swingLen      = input.int(5, "Swing length (pivot left/right)", minval=1)
breakConfirm  = input.string("Wick", "Break confirmation", options=["Wick", "Close"])

showSwings    = input.bool(true, "Show HH/HL/LH/LL (swing labels)")
showBOS       = input.bool(true, "Show BOS")
showCHoCH     = input.bool(true, "Show CHoCH")
showMSS       = input.bool(true, "Show MSS (displacement CHoCH)")
showEQ        = input.bool(false, "Show EQH/EQL (optional)")

atrLen        = input.int(14, "ATR length (MSS filter)", minval=1)
dispMult      = input.float(1.5, "Displacement: body > ATR ×", step=0.1)

labelPos      = input.string("Middle", "BOS/CHoCH/MSS label position", options=["Middle", "Break bar"])
textOffsetTk  = input.int(10, "Text offset (ticks)", minval=0)

maxStructObjs = input.int(80, "Max structure objects kept", minval=20, maxval=500)
maxSwingLbls  = input.int(200, "Max swing labels kept", minval=50, maxval=2000)

bullCol       = input.color(color.new(color.aqua, 0), "Bullish structure color")
bearCol       = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0), "Bearish structure color")
swingCol      = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 0), "Swing label color")

lineW         = input.int(1, "Line width", minval=1, maxval=4)
lineStyleIn   = input.string("Solid", "Line style", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"])
lineStyle     = lineStyleIn == "Solid" ? line.style_solid : lineStyleIn == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : line.style_dotted

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers (object management)
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var line[]  structLines  = array.new_line()
var label[] structLabels = array.new_label()
var label[] swingLabels  = array.new_label()

f_trim_lines(line[] arr, int maxCount) =>
    while array.size(arr) > maxCount
        line.delete(array.shift(arr))

f_trim_labels(label[] arr, int maxCount) =>
    while array.size(arr) > maxCount
        label.delete(array.shift(arr))

f_add_struct(int x1, float level, int x2, string txt, color col, bool isHighLevel) =>
    if not na(level) and not na(x1)
        // Line
        line ln = line.new(x1, level, x2, level, xloc=xloc.bar_index, extend=extend.none, color=col, width=lineW, style=lineStyle)
        array.push(structLines, ln)

        // Label position
        int xTxt = labelPos == "Middle" ? int(math.round((x1 + x2) / 2.0)) : x2
        float off = syminfo.mintick * textOffsetTk
        float yTxt = isHighLevel ? (level + off) : (level - off)

        label lb = label.new(xTxt, yTxt, txt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_none, textcolor=col, size=size.tiny)
        array.push(structLabels, lb)

        // Trim
        f_trim_lines(structLines, maxStructObjs)
        f_trim_labels(structLabels, maxStructObjs)

f_add_swing(int x, float y, string txt, bool isHigh) =>
    float off = syminfo.mintick * textOffsetTk
    float yy  = isHigh ? (y + off) : (y - off)
    label lb  = label.new(x, yy, txt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_none, textcolor=swingCol, size=size.tiny)
    array.push(swingLabels, lb)
    f_trim_labels(swingLabels, maxSwingLbls)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Swing detection (pivots)
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, swingLen, swingLen)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low,  swingLen, swingLen)

var float lastHigh = na
var int   lastHighBar = na
var float lastLow  = na
var int   lastLowBar  = na

var bool  highBroken = false
var bool  lowBroken  = false

// Trend state:  1 = bullish, -1 = bearish, 0 = unknown
var int trend = 0

bool gotPH = not na(ph)
bool gotPL = not na(pl)

if gotPH
    float prevHigh = lastHigh
    lastHigh := ph
    lastHighBar := bar_index - swingLen
    highBroken := false

    if showSwings and not na(prevHigh)
        string t = ph > prevHigh ? "HH" : ph < prevHigh ? "LH" : (showEQ ? "EQH" : "")
        if t != ""
            f_add_swing(lastHighBar, lastHigh, t, true)

if gotPL
    float prevLow = lastLow
    lastLow := pl
    lastLowBar := bar_index - swingLen
    lowBroken := false

    if showSwings and not na(prevLow)
        string t = pl > prevLow ? "HL" : pl < prevLow ? "LL" : (showEQ ? "EQL" : "")
        if t != ""
            f_add_swing(lastLowBar, lastLow, t, false)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Break logic (BOS / CHoCH / MSS)
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
atrV = ta.atr(atrLen)
body = math.abs(close - open)

// "Displacement" candle direction + size filter (used for MSS)
bullDisp = close > open and body > atrV * dispMult
bearDisp = close < open and body > atrV * dispMult

// Break conditions (choose wick vs close)
breakUpClose   = not na(lastHigh) and close > lastHigh and close[1] <= lastHigh
breakDownClose = not na(lastLow)  and close < lastLow  and close[1] >= lastLow

breakUpWick    = not na(lastHigh) and high  > lastHigh and high[1]  <= lastHigh
breakDownWick  = not na(lastLow)  and low   < lastLow  and low[1]   >= lastLow

breakUp   = breakConfirm == "Close" ? breakUpClose   : breakUpWick
breakDown = breakConfirm == "Close" ? breakDownClose : breakDownWick

// Prevent duplicate breaks on same watched swing level
breakUp   := breakUp   and not highBroken and not gotPH
breakDown := breakDown and not lowBroken  and not gotPL

if breakUp
    bool reversal = trend == -1
    string txt = ""
    if reversal
        bool isMSS = showMSS and bullDisp and breakUpClose  // MSS requires CLOSE break + displacement
        txt := isMSS ? "MSS" : (showCHoCH ? "CHoCH" : "")
    else
        txt := showBOS ? "BOS" : ""

    if txt != ""
        f_add_struct(lastHighBar, lastHigh, bar_index, txt, bullCol, true)

    highBroken := true
    trend := 1

if breakDown
    bool reversal = trend == 1
    string txt = ""
    if reversal
        bool isMSS = showMSS and bearDisp and breakDownClose // MSS requires CLOSE break + displacement
        txt := isMSS ? "MSS" : (showCHoCH ? "CHoCH" : "")
    else
        txt := showBOS ? "BOS" : ""

    if txt != ""
        f_add_struct(lastLowBar, lastLow, bar_index, txt, bearCol, false)

    lowBroken := true
    trend := -1
